portal.name: usefulapi
portal.tagline: Hosted MCP servers for the tools you already use.

servers.name: Ably
servers.description: MCP server for Ably — channel history, presence, occupancy, stats, publish, and app management.

tools.name: ably_get_channel_history
tools.title: Get channel history
tools.description: Retrieve the historical messages published to a channel, filterable by time window and direction, newest-first by default.

tools.name: ably_get_presence
tools.title: Get presence
tools.description: List the members currently present on a channel — who is online right now — optionally filtered by clientId or connectionId.

tools.name: ably_get_presence_history
tools.title: Get presence history
tools.description: Retrieve the historical presence events (enter, leave, update) for a channel over a chosen time window.

tools.name: ably_get_channel_details
tools.title: Get channel details
tools.description: Get the live status and occupancy metrics for a single channel, including connection, publisher, subscriber, and presence-member counts.

tools.name: ably_list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: Enumerate the channels currently active in the app, optionally filtered by name prefix and returned as ids or full detail.

tools.name: ably_get_stats
tools.title: Get stats
tools.description: Retrieve message, connection, and channel usage statistics for the app tied to the API key, bucketed by minute, hour, day, or month.

tools.name: ably_get_service_time
tools.title: Get service time
tools.description: Return the current Ably service time in milliseconds since epoch, useful for aligning history and stats windows to the server clock.

tools.name: ably_whoami
tools.title: Whoami
tools.description: Return the account, user, and capabilities the configured Control API token belongs to — a good first call to confirm control-plane access.

tools.name: ably_list_apps
tools.title: List apps
tools.description: List every app in the account with its id, name, status, and TLS-only flag, resolving the account id automatically from the control token.

tools.name: ably_list_keys
tools.title: List keys
tools.description: List an app's API keys along with the capabilities granted to each, without exposing the full key secret.

tools.name: ably_list_namespaces
tools.title: List namespaces
tools.description: List the channel namespaces (channel-rule prefixes) configured for an app, including their persistence and push settings.

tools.name: ably_list_queues
tools.title: List queues
tools.description: List the Ably Queues (AMQP/STOMP message queues) provisioned for an app, with their state and messaging statistics.

tools.name: ably_list_rules
tools.title: List rules
tools.description: List the integration rules (reactor webhooks and AWS, Kafka, Pulsar, and similar targets) configured for an app.

tools.name: ably_get_account_stats
tools.title: Get account stats
tools.description: Retrieve aggregated usage statistics across the entire account, bucketed by minute, hour, day, or month.

tools.name: ably_publish_message
tools.title: Publish message
tools.description: Publish a message to a channel so every connected subscriber receives it in real time — a real outward-facing side effect, so confirm the channel and payload first.

tools.name: ably_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: ably_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Ably tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Accelo
servers.description: Manage Accelo companies, contacts, jobs, tasks, tickets and time.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies (client organizations). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/companies. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Fetch a single company (client organization). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/companies/{id}. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people at companies). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/contacts. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Fetch a single contact (a person). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/contacts/{id}. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs (projects)
tools.description: List jobs — Accelo "jobs" are projects. Accelo API: GET /api/v0/jobs. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Get a job (project)
tools.description: Fetch a single job (project). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/jobs/{id}. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (units of work logged against an object such as a job or company). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/tasks. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Fetch a single task. Accelo API: GET /api/v0/tasks/{id}. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List activities — notes, emails, calls, and meetings logged against objects. Accelo API: GET /api/v0/activities. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: get_activity
tools.title: Get an activity
tools.description: Fetch a single activity (note/email/call/meeting). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/activities/{id}. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices. Accelo API: GET /api/v0/invoices. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Fetch a single invoice. Accelo API: GET /api/v0/invoices/{id}. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: list_prospects
tools.title: List prospects (sales)
tools.description: List prospects — sales opportunities in the pipeline. Accelo API: GET /api/v0/prospects. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: get_prospect
tools.title: Get a prospect (sale)
tools.description: Fetch a single prospect (sales opportunity). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/prospects/{id}. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List staff (Accelo users in your deployment). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/staff. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: get_staff
tools.title: Get a staff member
tools.description: Fetch a single staff member. Accelo API: GET /api/v0/staff/{id}. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.title: List issues (tickets)
tools.description: List issues — support/service tickets. Accelo API: GET /api/v0/issues. Supports _page/_limit/_fields/_filters/_search. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.title: Get an issue (ticket)
tools.description: Fetch a single issue (support/service ticket). Accelo API: GET /api/v0/issues/{id}. Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: accelo_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Accelo API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the host, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/api/v0/companies?_limit=1&_filters=status(1)" or "/api/v0/tasks/123". Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: create_company
tools.title: Create a company
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new company (client organization). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/companies (form-encoded). Returns { meta, response } with the created company. (Accelo has no separate delete tool here; to UPDATE, POST to /api/v0/companies/{id}.)

tools.name: create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new contact (a person). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/contacts (form-encoded). NOTE: a contact's company affiliation is set separately via an affiliation (POST /api/v0/contacts/{id}/affiliations), not on creation. Returns { meta, response } with the created contact.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new task. Accelo tasks are always logged AGAINST an object (a job, company, issue, etc.), so against_type + against_id are required. Accelo API: POST /api/v0/tasks (form-encoded). Returns { meta, response }.

tools.name: create_activity
tools.title: Create an activity (log a note/email/call)
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: logs an activity (a note, email, call, or meeting) against an object. This is the highest-value safe write — e.g. add a note/comment to a job or company. against_type + against_id say what it is logged against (required). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/activities (form-encoded). Returns { meta, response }.

servers.name: Acuity Scheduling
servers.description: Read appointments, types, calendars and availability; create, cancel or reschedule bookings.

tools.name: acuity_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments scheduled on the account, with optional filters. Acuity REST: GET /appointments.

tools.name: acuity_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: Get a single appointment by its id. Acuity REST: GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: acuity_list_appointment_types
tools.title: List appointment types
tools.description: List the account's appointment types (services and classes), including price, duration and calendars. Acuity REST: GET /appointment-types.

tools.name: acuity_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List the account's calendars (staff/resources appointments can be booked on). Acuity REST: GET /calendars.

tools.name: acuity_availability_dates
tools.title: Get available dates
tools.description: List dates in a month that have availability for an appointment type. Acuity REST: GET /availability/dates.

tools.name: acuity_availability_times
tools.title: Get available times
tools.description: List available time slots on a given date for an appointment type. Acuity REST: GET /availability/times.

tools.name: acuity_availability_classes
tools.title: Get available classes
tools.description: List group class time slots (for class-type appointment types) in a month. Acuity REST: GET /availability/classes.

tools.name: acuity_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients on the account, optionally filtered by a search string (name/email/phone). Acuity REST: GET /clients.

tools.name: acuity_list_forms
tools.title: List intake forms
tools.description: List the account's custom intake forms and their fields. Acuity REST: GET /forms.

tools.name: acuity_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the account's products / packages / gift certificates for sale. Acuity REST: GET /products.

tools.name: acuity_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List store orders (product / package / gift-certificate purchases). Acuity REST: GET /orders.

tools.name: acuity_list_blocks
tools.title: List blocked-off times
tools.description: List blocked-off (unavailable) time ranges on the account's calendars. Acuity REST: GET /blocks.

tools.name: acuity_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List the appointment labels (colored tags) defined on the account. Acuity REST: GET /labels.

tools.name: acuity_get_me
tools.title: Get account info
tools.description: Get the authenticated Acuity account's profile (name, email, timezone, plan, currency). Acuity REST: GET /me.

tools.name: acuity_create_appointment
tools.title: Create appointment
tools.description: CREATES a new appointment (books a client into a time slot). This MODIFIES the calendar and, unless suppressed, may send confirmation emails. Acuity REST: POST /appointments.

tools.name: acuity_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel appointment
tools.description: CANCELS an existing appointment. This MODIFIES the calendar and, unless suppressed, may send cancellation emails. Acuity REST: PUT /appointments/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: acuity_reschedule_appointment
tools.title: Reschedule appointment
tools.description: RESCHEDULES an existing appointment to a new time (and optionally a new calendar). This MODIFIES the calendar and, unless suppressed, may send update emails. Acuity REST: PUT /appointments/{id}/reschedule.

tools.name: acuity_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: CREATES a new client record in the account's client list. This ADDS data to the account. Acuity REST: POST /clients.

tools.name: acuity_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: acuity_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Acuity Scheduling tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Aircall
servers.description: Read calls, contacts, users, teams and numbers; tag calls and create or update contacts.

tools.name: aircall_ping
tools.title: Ping
tools.description: Health check — verify the API is reachable and the credentials are valid. Aircall REST: GET /ping.

tools.name: aircall_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get details of the authenticated Aircall company (name, plan, usage). Aircall REST: GET /company.

tools.name: aircall_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (agents) in the Aircall company (id, name, email, availability). Aircall REST: GET /users.

tools.name: aircall_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get a single user (agent) by id. Aircall REST: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: List calls, optionally filtered by a creation-date window and ordered. Aircall REST: GET /calls.

tools.name: aircall_get_call
tools.title: Get call
tools.description: Get a single call by id. Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_search_calls
tools.title: Search calls
tools.description: Search calls by a free-text term (e.g. phone number, tag, direction). Aircall REST: GET /calls/search.

tools.name: aircall_list_numbers
tools.title: List numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers owned by the company (id, name, digits, country). Aircall REST: GET /numbers.

tools.name: aircall_get_number
tools.title: Get number
tools.description: Get a single phone number by id. Aircall REST: GET /numbers/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the shared address book, optionally by creation-date window and order. Aircall REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: aircall_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id. Aircall REST: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by a free-text term (e.g. name, phone number, email). Aircall REST: GET /contacts/search.

tools.name: aircall_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the company's call tags (id, name, color). Aircall REST: GET /tags.

tools.name: aircall_get_tag
tools.title: Get tag
tools.description: Get a single tag by id. Aircall REST: GET /tags/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the company's teams and their members. Aircall REST: GET /teams.

tools.name: aircall_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Get a single team by id. Aircall REST: GET /teams/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_transcription
tools.title: Get call transcription
tools.description: Get the AI-generated transcription of a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/transcription.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_sentiments
tools.title: Get call sentiments
tools.description: Get the AI-generated sentiment analysis of a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/sentiments.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_topics
tools.title: Get call topics
tools.description: Get the AI-detected topics of a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/topics.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_summary
tools.title: Get call summary
tools.description: Get the AI-generated summary of a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/summary.

tools.name: aircall_get_call_action_items
tools.title: Get call action items
tools.description: Get the AI-extracted action items / follow-ups from a call (Aircall AI Voice feature). Aircall REST: GET /calls/{id}/action_items.

tools.name: aircall_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in the shared address book. Aircall typically requires at least one of first_name / last_name / company_name. Aircall REST: POST /contacts.

tools.name: aircall_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact. Only provided fields are changed. Aircall REST: PUT /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: aircall_add_call_comment
tools.title: Add call comment
tools.description: Add a comment / note to a call. Aircall REST: POST /calls/{id}/comments.

tools.name: aircall_tag_call
tools.title: Tag call
tools.description: Apply tags to a call by tag id (get ids from aircall_list_tags). Aircall REST: POST /calls/{id}/tags.

tools.name: aircall_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: aircall_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: All Quiet
servers.description: Manage incidents and on-call: list/create/update incidents, who is on call, on-call overrides.

tools.name: allquiet_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: Search/list incidents with filters (status, severity, team, user, search term, archived/snoozed, date range) and pagination. All Quiet: GET /v1/incident/search/list.

tools.name: allquiet_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by its id. All Quiet: GET /v1/incident/search/{incidentId}.

tools.name: allquiet_get_incident_markdown
tools.title: Get incident as markdown
tools.description: Get a markdown rendering of a single incident by its id (useful for pasting into a doc or chat). All Quiet: GET /v1/incident/search/{incidentId}/markdown.

tools.name: allquiet_who_is_on_call
tools.title: Who is on call
tools.description: Get who is currently (or at a given point in time) on call, optionally filtered by team/user. All Quiet: GET /v1/on-call.

tools.name: allquiet_on_call_report
tools.title: On-call report
tools.description: Get a summed on-call duration report over a time window, optionally filtered by user/team/escalation tier. All Quiet: GET /v1/on-call-report/sum.

tools.name: allquiet_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: Search/list teams, optionally filtered by display name. All Quiet: GET /v1/team/search/list.

tools.name: allquiet_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: Search/list users, optionally filtered by email or display name. All Quiet: GET /v1/user/search/list.

tools.name: allquiet_list_on_call_overrides
tools.title: List on-call overrides
tools.description: Search/list on-call overrides for a given user. All Quiet: GET /v1/on-call-override/search/list.

tools.name: allquiet_create_incident
tools.title: Create incident
tools.description: Creates a new incident on the LIVE account (may trigger alerting/paging). status and severity are free-form strings the API validates against your account configuration (common severity values include Warning, Minor, Major, Critical; status reflects the incident lifecycle, e.g. Open/Resolved) — confirm the valid values for your account before calling. All Quiet: POST /v1/incident.

tools.name: allquiet_update_incident
tools.title: Update incident
tools.description: Applies an operation to an existing LIVE incident: change its severity and/or append an intent (a lifecycle action such as acknowledge/resolve/reopen/snooze — a status transition). At least one of changeSeverity or appendIntent is required. All Quiet: PATCH /v1/incident/{incidentId}.

tools.name: allquiet_create_on_call_override
tools.title: Create on-call override
tools.description: Creates an on-call override for a user on the LIVE account (temporarily changes who is on call). type is a free-form override kind and start/end govern the override window — confirm the valid type values for your account. All Quiet: POST /v1/on-call-override.

tools.name: allquiet_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: allquiet_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED All Quiet tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Amberflo
servers.description: Query and manage Amberflo metering & billing: customers, meters, usage, plans, invoices, prepaid.

tools.name: amberflo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List every customer registered in your Amberflo account with their ids, names, emails, traits and enabled status — the usual first call to discover customer ids.

tools.name: amberflo_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by its Amberflo customerId, returning that customer's full profile and traits.

tools.name: amberflo_list_meters
tools.title: List meters
tools.description: List all meter definitions in your account (id, meterApiName, label, type and aggregation) so you know which meters the usage tools can target.

tools.name: amberflo_get_usage
tools.title: Get usage
tools.description: Query aggregated usage for a single meter over a time range, optionally grouped by dimension, filtered, and limited to the top N groups.

tools.name: amberflo_get_all_usage
tools.title: Get all usage
tools.description: Get total usage across all meters over a time range, optionally grouped by customer or restricted to a single customer.

tools.name: amberflo_explain_usage
tools.title: Explain usage
tools.description: Drill into the raw meter events behind a meter's usage over a time range to debug why an aggregated number looks off.

tools.name: amberflo_get_customer_plan
tools.title: Get customer plan
tools.description: Get a customer's latest assigned pricing product plan so you can see exactly what they are currently billed on.

tools.name: amberflo_list_customer_plan_history
tools.title: List customer plan history
tools.description: List the full history of pricing product plans assigned to a customer over time.

tools.name: amberflo_list_customer_invoices
tools.title: List customer invoices
tools.description: List all invoices for a customer, optionally scoped to one product, each with its payment status.

tools.name: amberflo_get_customer_invoice
tools.title: Get customer invoice
tools.description: Get a single customer invoice — either the current open invoice or a specific past one addressed by plan, year, month and day.

tools.name: amberflo_list_prepaid_orders
tools.title: List prepaid orders
tools.description: List a customer's active prepaid credit orders for a given product.

tools.name: amberflo_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Register a new customer in Amberflo (id and name required, plus optional email, enabled flag and traits) and optionally auto-create it in Stripe.

tools.name: amberflo_assign_customer_plan
tools.title: Assign customer plan
tools.description: Attach a pricing product plan to a customer, changing what that customer is billed on going forward.

tools.name: amberflo_ingest_usage
tools.title: Ingest usage
tools.description: Record a single usage meter event to Amberflo's ingestion host, writing billable usage data for a customer.

tools.name: amberflo_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: amberflo_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Amberflo tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Anvil
servers.description: Hosted MCP server for Anvil — fill & generate PDFs and run Etch e-signature packets for AI agents.

tools.name: anvil_current_user
tools.title: Current user
tools.description: Get the authenticated Anvil user behind the API key plus every organization they belong to (eid, name, slug) — the best first call to discover the org identifiers other tools need.

tools.name: anvil_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Fetch an organization by slug or eid together with its PDF templates (casts) and workflows (welds), so you can browse what is available to fill or submit.

tools.name: anvil_get_cast
tools.title: Get cast
tools.description: Fetch a cast — an Anvil PDF template — by eid, returning its title, version number, and template flag; its eid is what you pass to anvil_fill_pdf.

tools.name: anvil_get_etch_packet
tools.title: Get etch packet
tools.description: Fetch an Etch e-signature packet by eid, including its status, details URL, document group, and every signer's name, email, routing order, and signing status — the way to check signature progress.

tools.name: anvil_get_weld
tools.title: Get weld
tools.description: Fetch a weld — an Anvil workflow — by eid along with its forges, the individual form steps (eid, name, slug).

tools.name: anvil_get_weld_data
tools.title: Get weld data
tools.description: Fetch a single weldData submission to a weld by eid, reporting its completion state, test flag, and creation time.

tools.name: anvil_fill_pdf
tools.title: Fill pdf
tools.description: Fill an Anvil PDF template (cast) with a map of field aliases to values and return the finished PDF as base64, ready to download or forward.

tools.name: anvil_generate_pdf
tools.title: Generate pdf
tools.description: Generate a brand-new PDF from raw HTML or Markdown and return it as base64, with optional CSS styling and embedded title metadata.

tools.name: anvil_create_etch_packet
tools.title: Create etch packet
tools.description: Create an Etch e-signature packet from documents and signers; it defaults to a safe draft that sends nothing, and only emails signers when you set isDraft=false.

tools.name: anvil_generate_etch_sign_url
tools.title: Generate etch sign url
tools.description: Generate a one-time embedded signing URL for a specific signer in an Etch packet, for iframe or redirect signing flows.

tools.name: anvil_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)

servers.name: Basis Theory
servers.description: Read token metadata, applications, audit logs, proxies and usage in the PCI vault.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_tokens
tools.title: List tokens
tools.description: List vault tokens as METADATA — id, type, container, fingerprint, metadata and timestamps. Does not return the underlying card number or PII. Basis Theory: GET /v2/tokens.

tools.name: basis_theory_search_tokens
tools.title: Search tokens
tools.description: Search tokens with Basis Theory's query syntax over metadata, e.g. metadata.customer_id:"cus_1". Returns metadata only. Read-only despite being a POST — the query goes in the body. Basis Theory: POST /v2/tokens/search.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_token
tools.title: Get one token
tools.description: Fetch a single token by id. Returns metadata, container, fingerprint and timestamps. WARNING: if the configured API key carries a reveal permission, the response also contains the token's plaintext data — issue this server a read-only management key instead. Basis Theory: GET /tokens/{id}.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List the applications (API-key holders) in the tenant, with their types and permissions. Basis Theory: GET /applications.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_application
tools.title: Get one application
tools.description: Fetch a single application with its type and permission list. Basis Theory: GET /applications/{id}.

tools.name: basis_theory_whoami
tools.title: Identify the configured key
tools.description: Return the application the configured BT-API-KEY belongs to — the fastest way to check which permissions this server actually has. Basis Theory: GET /applications/key.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_logs
tools.title: List audit logs
tools.description: List audit-log entries — who did what to which entity and when. The tool for answering 'who touched this token?'. Basis Theory: GET /logs.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_log_entity_types
tools.title: List log entity types
tools.description: List the entity types the audit log records — the valid values for entity_type. Basis Theory: GET /logs/entity-types.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_proxies
tools.title: List proxies
tools.description: List the proxies that forward requests to third parties, detokenizing in flight. Basis Theory: GET /proxies.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_proxy
tools.title: Get one proxy
tools.description: Fetch a single proxy with its destination URL and transform configuration. Basis Theory: GET /proxies/{id}.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_reactors
tools.title: List reactors
tools.description: List reactors — the serverless functions that run against detokenized data inside the vault. Basis Theory: GET /reactors.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_reactor
tools.title: Get one reactor
tools.description: Fetch a single reactor with its configuration. Basis Theory: GET /reactors/{id}.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_permissions
tools.title: List permissions
tools.description: List the permissions that can be granted to an application, optionally for one application type. Basis Theory: GET /permissions.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles available for tenant members. Basis Theory: GET /roles.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_tenant
tools.title: Get the tenant
tools.description: Fetch the current tenant — name, id and settings. Basis Theory: GET /tenants/self.

tools.name: basis_theory_get_tenant_usage
tools.title: Get the tenant usage report
tools.description: Fetch the tenant's usage report — token counts by type and container, and monthly API call volume. Basis Theory: GET /tenants/self/reports/usage.

tools.name: basis_theory_list_tenant_members
tools.title: List tenant members
tools.description: List the people with access to the tenant, and their roles. Basis Theory: GET /tenants/self/members.

servers.name: Bettermode

tools.name: bettermode_get_network
tools.title: Get network
tools.description: Get top-level info about the Bettermode community ("network") this token belongs to — id, name, primary domain/subdomain, status, creation date, and total member count. No arguments. Bettermode GraphQL query: network.

tools.description: List spaces (the containers for posts — e.g. discussions, Q&A, articles) in the community, with pagination. tools.name: bettermode_get_space
tools.title: Get space
tools.description: Get a single space by its `id` OR its `slug` (provide exactly one). Returns the space's name, slug, description, type, creation date, and member/post counts. Bettermode GraphQL query: space.

tools.name: bettermode_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List members of the community, with pagination. Optionally filter by a search term (`query`, matches name/username/email), by role (`roleIds`), order (`orderBy`), and reverse. Returns edges[].node (with role) plus pageInfo and totalCount. Bettermode GraphQL query: members.

tools.name: bettermode_get_member
tools.title: Get member
tools.description: Get a single community member by their `id`. Returns name, username, email, status, creation date, role, and tagline. Bettermode GraphQL query: member.

tools.name: bettermode_list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List posts across the community, with pagination. Optionally scope to one or more spaces (`spaceIds`), order (`orderBy`, passed through as a plain string), and reverse. Returns edges[].node (title, shortContent, space, owner) plus pageInfo and totalCount. Bettermode GraphQL query: posts.

tools.name: bettermode_get_post
tools.title: Get post
tools.description: Get a single post by its `id`. Returns title, shortContent, creation date, space, owner (member), and reaction/reply counts. Bettermode GraphQL query: post.

tools.name: bettermode_search
tools.title: Search

tools.name: braintree_search_transactions
tools.title: Search transactions
tools.description: Search transactions by created-at date range, status, and/or customer. Builds a TransactionSearchInput (operators: status `in`, createdAt `greaterThanOrEqualTo`/`lessThanOrEqualTo`, customer.id `is`). Returns a page of transaction nodes (id, legacyId, amount, status, createdAt). GraphQL `search { transactions }`.

tools.name: braintree_find_customer
tools.title: Find a customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer by GraphQL global Customer ID via the `node` query. Returns id, legacyId, name, company, and created-at. To also enumerate stored cards/PayPal accounts use braintree_customer_payment_methods.

tools.name: braintree_customer_payment_methods

tools.name: braintree_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List a customer's subscription activity
tools.description: List a customer's recurring / subscription payment activity. IMPORTANT: Braintree's GraphQL API does NOT expose native Subscription objects (recurring-billing management is still legacy-API only — see braintree/graphql-api issue #1). This tool therefore returns the customer's transactions (the observable evidence of subscription charges) via a TransactionSearchInput scoped to the customer; inspect each node's status/amount/createdAt to trace recurring charges. For full subscription CRUD you must use Braintree's legacy server SDK / REST API.

tools.name: braintree_refund_transaction
tools.title: Refund a transaction
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Refund a SETTLED (or settling) transaction, returning money to the customer. Use the GraphQL global transaction ID. Omit `amount` for a full refund, or pass a decimal string for a partial refund. GraphQL mutation `refundTransaction`. For transactions not yet settled, use braintree_void_transaction instead.

tools.name: braintree_void_transaction
tools.title: Void a transaction
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Void (cancel) a transaction that has NOT yet settled — e.g. an authorization or one submitted-for-settlement. Use the GraphQL global transaction ID. GraphQL mutation `voidTransaction`. For already-settled transactions use braintree_refund_transaction instead.

tools.name: codecov_list_commits

servers.name: DailyMed
servers.description: Search DailyMed drug labels, SPLs, NDCs and packaging.

tools.name: dailymed_search_labels
tools.title: Search FDA drug labels (SPLs)
tools.description: Search Structured Product Labels (SPLs) — one label per marketed drug product. Filter by drug name, NDC, RxCUI, UNII, application (NDA/ANDA) number, marketing category, or publish date. Returns setid, title, spl_version and published_date for each match (use the setid with dailymed_get_label and the label_* tools). DailyMed v2: GET /spls.

tools.name: dailymed_get_label
tools.title: Get full SPL label document (XML)
tools.description: Fetch the complete Structured Product Label for a SETID as HL7 v3 SPL XML — the full FDA-approved labeling: indications, dosage, warnings, boxed warning, adverse reactions, active/inactive ingredients, etc. NOTE: DailyMed serves the full document only as XML (there is no JSON form), so this returns raw XML text. Use dailymed_search_labels first to find the setid. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}.xml.

tools.name: dailymed_label_history
tools.title: Get label version history
tools.description: List every published version (spl_version + published_date) of a label for a SETID — useful to see how a drug's labeling has changed over time. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}/history.

tools.name: dailymed_label_ndcs
tools.title: Get NDC codes for a label
tools.description: List the National Drug Codes (package-level NDCs) associated with a label's current version, for a SETID. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}/ndcs.

tools.name: dailymed_label_media
tools.title: Get label media (images)
tools.description: List media assets (product/packaging images, with mime_type and URL) for a label's current version, for a SETID. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}/media.

tools.name: dailymed_label_packaging
tools.title: Get label packaging & ingredients
tools.description: Get packaging descriptions plus product names and active ingredients (name + strength) for each product in a label, by SETID. DailyMed v2: GET /spls/{setid}/packaging.

tools.name: dailymed_list_drug_names
tools.title: List / search drug names
tools.description: List drug names in DailyMed (name + name_type B=brand/G=generic). Pass drug_name to filter by a substring — a fast way to discover exact spellings before searching labels. DailyMed v2: GET /drugnames.

tools.name: dailymed_list_ndcs
tools.title: List all NDC codes
tools.description: List National Drug Codes across all labels in DailyMed (paginated; the full set is large). DailyMed v2: GET /ndcs.

tools.name: dailymed_list_rxcuis
tools.title: List product-level RxCUIs
tools.description: List product-level RxNorm concept identifiers (rxcui + rxstring + rxtty term type) known to DailyMed (paginated). DailyMed v2: GET /rxcuis.

tools.name: dailymed_list_uniis
tools.title: List UNII active moieties
tools.description: List FDA UNII codes and their active-moiety names (paginated). Use a unii_code to filter labels in dailymed_search_labels. DailyMed v2: GET /uniis.

tools.name: dailymed_list_drug_classes
tools.title: List drug classes
tools.description: List pharmacologic drug classes linked to labels (code, coding system, type — e.g. EPC Established Pharmacologic Class — and name). DailyMed v2: GET /drugclasses.

tools.name: dailymed_list_application_numbers
tools.title: List FDA application numbers
tools.description: List FDA application numbers (NDA/ANDA/BLA) with their marketing category code, across all labels (paginated). DailyMed v2: GET /applicationnumbers.

tools.name: documenso_create_folder

servers.name: Ecwid
servers.description: Read store products, orders, customers, categories and coupons; adjust inventory and update orders.

tools.name: ecwid_get_store_profile
tools.title: Get store profile
tools.description: Get the store's profile — general info (store id, name, currency), company details, and settings. Ecwid REST: GET /profile.

tools.name: ecwid_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search / list the store's products with optional filters (keyword, SKU, category, stock, price range) and sorting. Returns a paged collection ({total, count, offset, limit, items}). Ecwid REST: GET /products.

tools.name: ecwid_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get a single product by its id, including price, stock, options, images, and category assignments. Ecwid REST: GET /products/{productId}.

tools.name: ecwid_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search / list the store's orders with optional filters (keyword, customer email/id, payment & fulfillment status, coupon, created-date range). Returns a paged collection. Ecwid REST: GET /orders.

tools.name: ecwid_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get a single order by its order number, including line items, totals, customer, and payment/fulfillment status. Ecwid REST: GET /orders/{orderNumber}.

tools.name: ecwid_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Search / list the store's customers with optional filters (keyword, email, name, customer group). Returns a paged collection. Ecwid REST: GET /customers.

tools.name: ecwid_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get a single customer by id, including contact details, addresses, and customer group. Ecwid REST: GET /customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: ecwid_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the store's product categories, optionally scoped to a parent category and including hidden ones. Returns a paged collection. Ecwid REST: GET /categories.

tools.name: ecwid_get_category
tools.title: Get category
tools.description: Get a single category by id, including its name, parent, product ids, and images. Ecwid REST: GET /categories/{categoryId}.

tools.name: ecwid_list_discount_coupons
tools.title: List discount coupons
tools.description: List the store's discount coupons with optional filters (coupon code, discount type, availability). Returns a paged collection. Ecwid REST: GET /discount_coupons.

tools.name: ecwid_adjust_product_inventory
tools.title: Adjust product inventory
tools.description: ADJUSTS a product's in-stock quantity by a delta — this MODIFIES live store data. Positive increases stock, negative decreases it. Ecwid REST: PUT /products/{productId}/inventory with JSON body {quantityDelta}. Returns {updateCount, warning?}.

tools.name: ecwid_update_order
tools.title: Update order
tools.description: UPDATES an order — its payment status, fulfillment status, and/or tracking number. This MODIFIES live store data and may trigger customer notifications. Ecwid REST: PUT /orders/{orderNumber}. Provide only the fields you want to change. Returns {updateCount}.

tools.name: ecwid_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: ecwid_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Ecwid tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: EmailOctopus
servers.description: Manage lists, contacts and campaigns, and read campaign performance reports on EmailOctopus.

tools.name: emailoctopus_list_lists
tools.title: List lists
tools.description: List all lists in the account. Returns {data:[...],paging:{...}} — each list's id, name, contact counts by status, and created_at. Paginate with `limit` (max 100) and `starting_after` (cursor from the previous page). EmailOctopus: GET /lists.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_list
tools.title: Get list
tools.description: Get a single list by its id. Returns the list's full state — name, contact counts by status, and created_at. EmailOctopus: GET /lists/{list_id}.

tools.name: emailoctopus_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts in a list. Returns {data:[...],paging:{...}} — each contact's id, email_address, fields, tags, status, and created_at. Paginate with `limit` (max 100) and `starting_after`. EmailOctopus: GET /lists/{list_id}/contacts.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact in a list. Returns email_address, fields, tags, status, and created_at. `contact_id` is the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the `id` returned by emailoctopus_list_contacts. EmailOctopus: GET /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: emailoctopus_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List all campaigns in the account. Returns {data:[...],paging:{...}} — each campaign's id, name, status, subject, and created_at. Paginate with `limit` (max 100) and `starting_after`. EmailOctopus: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: Get a single campaign by its id. Returns the campaign's full state — name, status, subject, from, content, and created_at. EmailOctopus: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_campaign_report
tools.title: Get campaign report
tools.description: Get a campaign's aggregate performance report — sent, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed, complained, and related counts. EmailOctopus: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/reports/summary.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_campaign_links_report
tools.title: Get campaign links report
tools.description: Get a campaign's per-link click report — for each link in the campaign, the URL and its click counts. EmailOctopus: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/reports/links.

tools.name: emailoctopus_create_list
tools.title: Create list
tools.description: CREATES a new list — this MODIFIES live data. Provide a `name`. EmailOctopus: POST /lists. Returns the created list.

tools.name: emailoctopus_update_list
tools.title: Update list
tools.description: UPDATES an existing list by id — this MODIFIES live data. Sets the list's `name`. EmailOctopus: PUT /lists/{list_id}. Returns the updated list.

tools.name: emailoctopus_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: CREATES a new contact in a list — this MODIFIES live data (adds a subscriber). `email_address` is required; optionally set `fields` (keyed by field tag), `tags`, and `status`. EmailOctopus: POST /lists/{list_id}/contacts. Returns the created contact.

tools.name: emailoctopus_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: UPDATES an existing contact in a list — this MODIFIES live data. Send only the fields you want to change (email_address, fields, tags, status). `contact_id` is the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the id from list_contacts. EmailOctopus: PUT /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}. Returns the updated contact.

tools.name: emailoctopus_delete_contact
tools.title: Delete contact
tools.description: PERMANENTLY REMOVES a contact from a list — this MODIFIES live data and cannot be undone. `contact_id` is the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the id from list_contacts. EmailOctopus: DELETE /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: emailoctopus_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: emailoctopus_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED EmailOctopus tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Estuary Flow
servers.description: Inspect Estuary Flow captures, materializations, collections and stats.

tools.name: estuary_list_catalog
tools.title: List catalog entities
tools.description: List live catalog entities (captures, collections, materializations, tests) the user can read, with connector + last-publication metadata. Optionally filter by a catalog-name prefix and spec_type. Estuary control-plane view live_specs_ext. PostgREST: GET /live_specs_ext.

tools.name: estuary_get_catalog_spec
tools.title: Get catalog spec
tools.description: Get one live catalog entity by its exact catalog_name, including the full serialized `spec` and compiled `built_spec`. Estuary control-plane view live_specs_ext. PostgREST: GET /live_specs_ext?catalog_name=eq.<name>&limit=1.

tools.name: estuary_get_catalog_stats
tools.title: Get catalog stats
tools.description: Get usage/throughput stats for one catalog entity — bytes & docs read/written (both directions), usage_seconds, warnings/errors/failures, and txn_count — per time grain. Optionally bound by a timestamp range. Estuary control-plane view catalog_stats. PostgREST: GET /catalog_stats.

tools.name: estuary_list_connectors
tools.title: List connectors
tools.description: List the connector catalog — available capture/materialization Docker connectors, with titles, descriptions, and logos. Optionally filter to recommended connectors. Estuary control-plane table connectors. PostgREST: GET /connectors.

tools.name: estuary_list_connector_versions
tools.title: List connector versions
tools.description: List available versions (image tags) of connectors, with protocol and documentation URL. Optionally filter by connector_id. Estuary control-plane table connector_tags. PostgREST: GET /connector_tags.

tools.name: estuary_list_drafts
tools.title: List drafts
tools.description: List the user's draft workspaces (staging areas for catalog edits before publishing). Estuary control-plane table drafts. PostgREST: GET /drafts.

tools.name: estuary_list_draft_specs
tools.title: List draft specs
tools.description: List the staged spec entries within a draft (each an insert/replace of a catalog entity pending publication). Estuary control-plane table draft_specs. PostgREST: GET /draft_specs.

tools.name: estuary_list_publications
tools.title: List publications
tools.description: List publication history/status — each publish attempt of a draft; job_status carries the queued/success/failed outcome. Estuary control-plane table publications. PostgREST: GET /publications.

tools.name: estuary_list_discovers
tools.title: List discovers
tools.description: List connector discovery jobs (auto-detecting bindings/resources for a capture). Estuary control-plane table discovers. PostgREST: GET /discovers.

tools.name: estuary_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles/capabilities the current credential is granted — which catalog prefixes it can read/write/admin. Read-only RPC. Estuary control-plane: POST /rpc/auth_roles.

tools.name: estuary_get_tenant
tools.title: Get tenant
tools.description: Get the user's tenant(s) — quotas (tasks/collections), billing tiers, recurring charge, trial start, and payment provider. Estuary control-plane table tenants. PostgREST: GET /tenants.

tools.name: estuary_view_task_logs
tools.title: View task logs
tools.description: Fetch the log lines for a job by its logs_token (a UUID found on a publication, discover, or connector-tag record). Optionally page from a last-seen timestamp. Read-only RPC. Estuary control-plane: POST /rpc/view_logs.

tools.name: estuary_create_draft
tools.title: Create draft
tools.description: WRITE: create a new empty draft workspace (a staging area for catalog changes; does not affect live pipelines). Estuary control-plane: POST /drafts. Returns the created row.

tools.name: estuary_upsert_draft_spec
tools.title: Upsert draft spec
tools.description: WRITE: stage (insert or replace) a catalog spec inside a draft. Edits only the draft — live pipelines are unaffected until the draft is published. Estuary control-plane: POST /draft_specs (upsert on draft_id,catalog_name). Returns the staged row.

tools.name: estuary_publish_draft
tools.title: Publish draft
tools.description: WRITE (DESTRUCTIVE when dry_run=false): publish a draft. dry_run=true (default) only VALIDATES the draft without changing anything. dry_run=false APPLIES the draft to the LIVE catalog — this can create, modify, or DELETE running data pipelines and their data. Set dry_run=false only when you intend to change live infrastructure. Estuary control-plane: POST /publications. Returns the publication row.

servers.name: fal.ai
servers.description: Run fal.ai models, poll the inference queue and read model schemas.

tools.name: falai_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List or search fal.ai models in the registry (paginated). fal.ai API: GET /models (query: keywords, page, total).

tools.name: falai_get_model_schema
tools.title: Get model schema
tools.description: Get the OpenAPI 3 schema for a model — its input/output fields (components.schemas). Use this to learn what inputs a model accepts before submitting. fal.ai API: GET /openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id={model_id}.

tools.name: falai_get_request_status
tools.title: Get request status
tools.description: Get the status of a queued request (IN_QUEUE | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED). fal.ai queue: GET {queue}/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}/status (optional logs=1).

tools.name: falai_get_request_result
tools.title: Get request result
tools.description: Get the final output of a COMPLETED queued request. fal.ai queue: GET {queue}/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}.

tools.name: falai_submit_request
tools.title: Submit request
tools.description: Submit an inference request to the queue and return immediately (async — does NOT wait for completion). Returns { request_id, response_url, status_url, cancel_url, queue_position }. Consumes fal credits when the model runs. fal.ai queue: POST {queue}/{model_id} with body = the model input.

tools.name: falai_run_model
tools.title: Run model (subscribe)
tools.description: Convenience 'subscribe': submit a request, poll its status until COMPLETED, then return the result. Consumes fal credits. If it does not complete within the wait budget, returns a { status, request_id, status_url, note } object (NOT an error) so you can keep polling with falai_get_request_status / falai_get_request_result.

tools.name: falai_cancel_request
tools.title: Cancel request
tools.description: Request cancellation of a queued (not-yet-started) request. Returns 202 { status: 'CANCELLATION_REQUESTED' }. fal.ai queue: PUT {queue}/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}/cancel.

tools.name: finnhub_company_news

tools.name: finnhub_market_news

tools.name: finnhub_basic_financials

tools.name: finnhub_recommendation_trends

tools.name: finnhub_earnings_surprises

tools.name: finnhub_price_target
tools.title: Price target

tools.name: finnhub_peers
tools.title: Company peers

tools.name: finnhub_insider_transactions

tools.name: finnhub_stock_symbols

tools.name: finnhub_market_status
tools.title: Market status
tools.description: Current market open/closed status and session for an exchange. Finnhub REST: GET /stock/market-status.

tools.name: finnhub_earnings_calendar
tools.title: Earnings calendar
tools.description: Upcoming and historical earnings release calendar, optionally filtered by date range and/or symbol. Finnhub REST: GET /calendar/earnings.

tools.name: finnhub_ipo_calendar

tools.name: fitbit_get_devices
