tools.name: fitbit_food_log
tools.title: Food log
tools.description: Food/nutrition log for a date — logged foods and daily nutrition totals (calories, macros). Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/foods/log/date/{date}.json.

tools.name: fitbit_water_log
tools.title: Water log
tools.description: Water intake log for a date. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/foods/log/water/date/{date}.json.

tools.name: fitbit_spo2
tools.title: SpO2
tools.description: Blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) summary for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/spo2/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

tools.name: fitbit_hrv
tools.title: HRV
tools.description: Heart rate variability (HRV) summary for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/hrv/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

tools.name: fitbit_breathing_rate
tools.title: Breathing rate
tools.description: Breathing (respiratory) rate summary for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/br/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

tools.name: fitbit_cardio_score
tools.title: Cardio score
tools.description: Cardio fitness score (VO2 max estimate) for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/cardioscore/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

tools.name: fitbit_skin_temperature
tools.title: Skin temperature
tools.description: Skin temperature (relative to baseline) for a date or range. Fitbit REST: GET /1/user/-/temp/skin/date/{date}[/{endDate}].json.

servers.name: Folk
servers.description: Read and write Folk CRM people, companies, groups and notes.

tools.name: folk_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Get the user associated with the current Folk API key. Folk REST: GET /v1/users/me.

tools.name: folk_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the Folk workspace (id, name, email) — useful for resolving owner ids. Folk REST: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: folk_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List/filter people (contacts). Supports cursor pagination and structured filters. Folk REST: GET /v1/people.

tools.name: folk_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: Get a single person (contact) by id. Folk REST: GET /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: folk_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List/filter companies. Supports cursor pagination and structured filters. Folk REST: GET /v1/companies.

tools.name: folk_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get a single company by id. Folk REST: GET /v1/companies/{id}.

tools.name: folk_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List groups in the Folk workspace (ids needed to place people/companies). Folk REST: GET /v1/groups.

tools.name: folk_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally scoped to an entity or filtered by full text and creation date. Folk REST: GET /v1/notes.

tools.name: folk_get_note
tools.title: Get note
tools.description: Get a single note by id. Folk REST: GET /v1/notes/{id}.

tools.name: folk_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: Create a new person (contact). All fields are optional. Folk REST: POST /v1/people.

tools.name: folk_update_person
tools.title: Update person
tools.description: Update fields on an existing person. Only provided fields are changed; list-valued fields (emails, phones, groups, companies, etc.) REPLACE the existing values. Folk REST: PATCH /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: folk_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: Create a new company. `name` is required. Folk REST: POST /v1/companies.

tools.name: folk_update_company
tools.title: Update company
tools.description: Update fields on an existing company. Only provided fields are changed; list-valued fields REPLACE the existing values. Folk REST: PATCH /v1/companies/{id}.

tools.name: folk_create_note
tools.title: Create note
tools.description: Create a note attached to an entity (person/company). Folk REST: POST /v1/notes.

servers.name: Formbricks
servers.description: Read survey responses and manage contacts, webhooks, teams and organisation users.

tools.name: formbricks_health
tools.title: Check API health
tools.description: Check that the Formbricks API is reachable. Formbricks v2: GET /health.

tools.name: formbricks_whoami
tools.title: Identify the configured key
tools.description: Return the project and environment the configured x-api-key belongs to — the fastest way to find the workspace and environment ids the other tools need. Formbricks v2: GET /me.

tools.name: formbricks_list_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: List survey responses, optionally narrowed to one survey, one contact or a date window. This is the main read: the answers people gave. Formbricks v2: GET /management/responses.

tools.name: formbricks_get_response
tools.title: Get one response
tools.description: Fetch a single survey response with its answers, metadata and completion state. Formbricks v2: GET /management/responses/{id}.

tools.name: formbricks_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured to fire on survey events, optionally filtered to specific surveys. Formbricks v2: GET /management/webhooks.

tools.name: formbricks_get_webhook
tools.title: Get one webhook
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook with its URL, triggers and bound surveys. Formbricks v2: GET /management/webhooks/{id}.

tools.name: formbricks_list_contact_attribute_keys
tools.title: List contact attribute keys
tools.description: List the contact attribute keys defined in an environment — the schema of what you know about a contact. Formbricks v2: GET /management/contact-attribute-keys.

tools.name: formbricks_get_contact_attribute_key
tools.title: Get one contact attribute key
tools.description: Fetch a single contact attribute key. Formbricks v2: GET /management/contact-attribute-keys/{id}.

tools.name: formbricks_get_survey_contact_link
tools.title: Get a personal survey link for a contact
tools.description: Get the personalised survey URL for one contact — the link you send so their response is attributed to them. Formbricks v2: GET /management/surveys/{surveyId}/contact-links/contacts/{contactId}/.

tools.name: formbricks_get_survey_segment_links
tools.title: Get personal survey links for a segment
tools.description: Get personalised survey URLs for every contact in a segment — how you run a targeted send. Formbricks v2: GET /management/surveys/{surveyId}/contact-links/segments/{segmentId}.

tools.name: formbricks_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams in an organisation. Formbricks v2: GET /organizations/{organizationId}/teams.

tools.name: formbricks_list_organization_users
tools.title: List organisation users
tools.description: List the users in an organisation, optionally looked up by id or email. Formbricks v2: GET /organizations/{organizationId}/users.

tools.name: formbricks_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles that can be assigned to organisation users. Formbricks v2: GET /roles.

tools.name: formbricks_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a webhook
tools.description: Register a webhook that fires on survey events. Formbricks v2: POST /management/webhooks.

tools.name: formbricks_delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete a webhook
tools.description: Remove a webhook. Formbricks v2: DELETE /management/webhooks/{id}.

tools.name: formbricks_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact in a workspace from a set of attributes, e.g. email and userId. Formbricks v2: POST /management/contacts.

tools.name: formbricks_delete_response
tools.title: Delete a response
tools.description: Delete one survey response. Irreversible — use it to honour a data-deletion request. Formbricks v2: DELETE /management/responses/{id}.

servers.name: Foxy.io
servers.description: Read Foxy transactions, subscriptions, customers, carts and coupons; update customers and subs.

tools.name: foxy_get_api_home
tools.title: Get API home
tools.description: Get the Foxy hAPI home document — its _links / rels (including fx:store for the authenticated default store). Useful for HAL discovery. Foxy hAPI: GET /.

tools.name: foxy_get_default_store
tools.title: Get default store
tools.description: Resolve and return the authenticated user's default store (and its id) by fetching the API home and following the fx:store link. Use this to discover the store_id the list tools accept. Foxy hAPI: GET / then GET fx:store.

tools.name: foxy_get_store
tools.title: Get store
tools.description: Get a single store resource by id, including its settings and _links to sub-collections. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}.

tools.name: foxy_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List a store's transactions (orders), newest first. Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:transactions. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/transactions.

tools.name: foxy_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: Get a single transaction by id, optionally zooming related resources (items, customer, payments, applied_taxes…). Foxy hAPI: GET /transactions/{id}.

tools.name: foxy_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List a store's subscriptions (recurring orders). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:subscriptions. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/subscriptions.

tools.name: foxy_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Get a single subscription by id, optionally zooming related resources. Foxy hAPI: GET /subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: foxy_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List a store's customers. Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:customers. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/customers.

tools.name: foxy_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get a single customer by id, optionally zooming related resources (default_billing_address, subscriptions…). Foxy hAPI: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: foxy_list_carts
tools.title: List carts
tools.description: List a store's carts (in-progress / abandoned checkouts). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:carts. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/carts.

tools.name: foxy_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List a store's coupons (discount codes and their rules). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:coupons. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/coupons.

tools.name: foxy_list_items
tools.title: List transaction items
tools.description: List the line items of a transaction (the products purchased). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:items. Foxy hAPI: GET /transactions/{transaction_id}/items.

tools.name: foxy_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: UPDATES a customer's profile fields (first_name, last_name, email). This MODIFIES live store data. Foxy hAPI: PATCH /customers/{id}. Provide only the fields you want to change.

tools.name: foxy_update_subscription
tools.title: Update subscription
tools.description: UPDATES a subscription — reschedule its next run (next_transaction_date), change its frequency, or activate/pause it (is_active). This MODIFIES live store data and affects future billing. Foxy hAPI: PATCH /subscriptions/{id}. Provide only the fields you want to change.

tools.name: foxy_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: foxy_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Foxy.io tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Freshdesk
servers.description: Read tickets, contacts, companies, agents and groups; create, update and reply to tickets.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List/filter tickets (max page 300). Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: Get a single ticket by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_tickets
tools.title: Search tickets
tools.description: Search tickets with the Freshdesk query DSL. The query VALUE is wrapped in double quotes automatically. Examples: `status:2 AND priority:3`, `created_at:>'2026-01-01'`, `agent_id:123`, `group_id:45`, `tag:'urgent'`. Freshdesk REST: GET /search/tickets.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_ticket_conversations
tools.title: List ticket conversations
tools.description: List the conversations (replies and notes) on a ticket. Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/conversations.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List/filter contacts. Freshdesk REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts with the Freshdesk query DSL. The query VALUE is wrapped in double quotes automatically. Examples: `name:'ada'`, `email:'ada@example.com'`, `company_id:123`. Freshdesk REST: GET /search/contacts.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies. Freshdesk REST: GET /companies.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get a single company by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /companies/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List/filter agents. Freshdesk REST: GET /agents.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_agent
tools.title: Get agent
tools.description: Get a single agent by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /agents/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List groups (agent groups tickets are routed to). Freshdesk REST: GET /groups.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket. `subject` and `description` (HTML) are required, plus a requester — provide at least one of `email`, `requester_id`, or `phone`. status: 2=Open, 3=Pending, 4=Resolved, 5=Closed. priority: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Urgent. source: 1=Email, 2=Portal, 3=Phone, 7=Chat, 9=Feedbackwidget, 10=Outbound email. Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: Update fields on an existing ticket. Only provided fields are changed. status: 2=Open, 3=Pending, 4=Resolved, 5=Closed. priority: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Urgent. Freshdesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_reply_ticket
tools.title: Reply to ticket
tools.description: Add a public reply to a ticket (sent to the requester). Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/{id}/reply.

tools.name: freshdesk_add_note
tools.title: Add note to ticket
tools.description: Add a note to a ticket. Notes are internal (private) by default; set `private: false` for a public note. Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/{id}/notes.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create a contact. `name` is required. Freshdesk REST: POST /contacts.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact. Only provided fields are changed. Freshdesk REST: PUT /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: Create a company. `name` is required. Freshdesk REST: POST /companies.

tools.name: freshdesk_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: freshdesk_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Geoapify
servers.description: Geocode, reverse-geocode, autocomplete, route and search places.

tools.name: geoapify_geocode_search
tools.title: Forward geocoding
tools.description: Forward geocoding — turn a free-form address or place name into coordinates and structured address parts. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/geocode/search.

tools.name: geoapify_geocode_reverse
tools.title: Reverse geocoding
tools.description: Reverse geocoding — turn coordinates into the nearest address / place. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/geocode/reverse.

tools.name: geoapify_geocode_autocomplete
tools.title: Address autocomplete
tools.description: Address autocomplete — suggest completed addresses/places for a partial query, ideal for as-you-type inputs. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/geocode/autocomplete.

tools.name: geoapify_places
tools.title: Places search
tools.description: Search for places (POIs) by category within an area, optionally filtered by name/conditions. Returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Geoapify REST: GET /v2/places.

tools.name: geoapify_place_details
tools.title: Place details
tools.description: Get detailed information (and optionally geometry/features) for a place. Provide either `id` (the `place_id` returned by geoapify_places) OR both `lat` and `lon`. Geoapify REST: GET /v2/place-details.

tools.name: geoapify_routing
tools.title: Routing
tools.description: Compute a route between waypoints for a travel mode, returning distance, time and legs. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/routing.

tools.name: geoapify_isoline
tools.title: Reachability isoline
tools.description: Compute a reachability isoline (isochrone/isodistance) — the area reachable from a point within a time or distance budget. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/isoline.

tools.name: geoapify_ip_geolocation
tools.title: IP geolocation
tools.description: Look up the approximate location (country, city, coordinates) of an IP address. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/ipinfo.

servers.name: GetResponse
servers.description: Manage GetResponse contacts, campaigns, newsletters and autoresponders.

tools.name: getresponse_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the authenticated GetResponse account profile (id, email, name, company, plan, timezone, etc.). REST: GET /accounts.

tools.name: getresponse_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns (lists)
tools.description: List the account's campaigns — GetResponse's name for mailing lists a contact can subscribe to. Paginated. Optional name filter and sort. REST: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: getresponse_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign (list)
tools.description: Get a single campaign (mailing list) by id, including subscription confirmation settings. REST: GET /campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: getresponse_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List/search contacts across the account. Paginated, with optional email/name/campaign filters, sort, and a fields selector. REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: getresponse_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id, including campaign membership, tags, custom field values and engagement scoring. REST: GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: getresponse_list_newsletters
tools.title: List newsletters
tools.description: List newsletters (one-off email broadcasts). Paginated, with optional subject filter and sort. REST: GET /newsletters.

tools.name: getresponse_get_newsletter
tools.title: Get newsletter
tools.description: Get a single newsletter (email broadcast) by id, including its status and send settings. REST: GET /newsletters/{newsletterId}.

tools.name: getresponse_list_autoresponders
tools.title: List autoresponders
tools.description: List autoresponders (drip/cycle emails sent automatically on a schedule after subscription). Paginated. REST: GET /autoresponders.

tools.name: getresponse_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the account's tags (labels applied to contacts for segmentation). REST: GET /tags.

tools.name: getresponse_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the account's custom field definitions (custom contact attributes) — id, name, type and values. REST: GET /custom-fields.

tools.name: getresponse_list_from_fields
tools.title: List from-fields
tools.description: List the account's verified 'from' fields (sender name/email addresses usable when sending). REST: GET /from-fields.

tools.name: getresponse_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Add a contact to a campaign (mailing list). GetResponse processes this asynchronously and returns HTTP 202 (queued) with no body — the contact appears in the list within a few minutes. REST: POST /contacts.

tools.name: getresponse_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: Update an existing contact's mutable fields (name, tags, custom field values). Only the fields you supply are changed. REST: POST /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: getresponse_delete_contact
tools.title: Delete contact
tools.description: Delete (remove) a contact from the account. This unsubscribes them and deletes their data. REST: DELETE /contacts/{contactId}.

servers.name: GitBook
servers.description: Read spaces, collections, pages and content; search docs and manage GitBook organization spaces.

tools.name: gitbook_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Get the profile of the authenticated GitBook user. GitBook REST: GET /user.

tools.name: gitbook_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the authenticated user belongs to. GitBook REST: GET /orgs.

tools.name: gitbook_list_spaces
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description: List all spaces in an organization. GitBook REST: GET /orgs/{organizationId}/spaces.

tools.name: gitbook_get_space
tools.title: Get space
tools.description: Get full details of a space by its ID. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}.

tools.name: gitbook_list_pages
tools.title: List pages
tools.description: List all pages in a space with their hierarchy and metadata. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/content/pages.

tools.name: gitbook_get_page
tools.title: Get page
tools.description: Get a single page's content from a space by its page ID. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/content/page/{pageId}.

tools.name: gitbook_search_space
tools.title: Search space
tools.description: Full-text search across all pages in a space. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/search.

tools.name: gitbook_search_organization
tools.title: Search organization
tools.description: Search content across an entire organization. GitBook REST: GET /orgs/{organizationId}/search.

tools.name: gitbook_list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List all collections in an organization. GitBook REST: GET /orgs/{organizationId}/collections.

tools.name: gitbook_get_collection
tools.title: Get collection
tools.description: Get a collection by its ID. GitBook REST: GET /collections/{collectionId}.

tools.name: gitbook_list_change_requests
tools.title: List change requests
tools.description: List change requests for a space. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/change-requests.

tools.name: gitbook_list_comments
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: List top-level comments posted on a space. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/comments.

tools.name: gitbook_create_change_request
tools.title: Create change request
tools.description: Create a new draft change request (branch) in a space. Safe: creates a draft; publishes nothing. GitBook REST: POST /spaces/{spaceId}/change-requests.

tools.name: gitbook_update_change_request
tools.title: Update change request
tools.description: Update a change request's subject or status. Edits draft metadata only. GitBook REST: PATCH /spaces/{spaceId}/change-requests/{changeRequestId}.

tools.name: gitbook_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: gitbook_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Groove
servers.description: Read Groove shared-inbox conversations, contacts, agents and tags; close, assign, snooze and tag.

tools.name: groove_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List support conversations (tickets) in the shared inbox, with rich filters. Filter by state, channel_id, folder_id, tag_name, assigned, starred, or keywords; paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: conversations(filter: ConversationFilter).

tools.name: groove_get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: Get a single conversation by id — subject, state, assignment, contact, channel, counts, and tags. Groove GraphQL: conversation(id: ID!).

tools.name: groove_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List customer contacts (people who wrote in). Optional keyword search over name/email; paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: contacts(keywords: String).

tools.name: groove_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id — name, email, role, type, and conversation count. Groove GraphQL: contact(contactId: ID!).

tools.name: groove_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List agents (support staff / users) in the account, with role and state. Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: agents.

tools.name: groove_list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: List channels (mailboxes / inboxes — email, chat, etc.) configured in the account. Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: channels.

tools.name: groove_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List tags defined in the account (id, name, color) — use tag ids with the tag/untag write tools. Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: tags.

tools.name: groove_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List folders (saved views / smart folders that group conversations), with conversation counts. Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: folders.

tools.name: groove_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams (groups of agents that conversations can be assigned to). Paginate with first/after. Groove GraphQL: teams.

tools.name: groove_close_conversation
tools.title: Close conversation
tools.description: CLOSES a conversation (marks it resolved) in the shared inbox. Groove GraphQL: conversationClose.

tools.name: groove_open_conversation
tools.title: Open conversation
tools.description: RE-OPENS a closed/snoozed conversation in the shared inbox. Groove GraphQL: conversationOpen.

tools.name: groove_snooze_conversation
tools.title: Snooze conversation
tools.description: SNOOZES a conversation until the given time (ISO8601) — it drops out of the inbox until then. Groove GraphQL: conversationSnooze.

tools.name: groove_star_conversation
tools.title: Star conversation
tools.description: STARS a conversation (flags it for attention) in the shared inbox. Groove GraphQL: conversationStar.

tools.name: groove_assign_conversation
tools.title: Assign conversation
tools.description: ASSIGNS a conversation to an agent and/or team. Pass agent_id, team_id, or both (at least one is required). Groove GraphQL: conversationAssign.

tools.name: groove_tag_conversation
tools.title: Tag conversation
tools.description: ADDS tags (by tag id) to a conversation. Use groove_list_tags to find tag ids. Groove GraphQL: conversationTag.

tools.name: groove_untag_conversation
tools.title: Untag conversation
tools.description: REMOVES tags (by tag id) from a conversation. Use groove_list_tags to find tag ids. Groove GraphQL: conversationUntag.

tools.name: groove_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: groove_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Groove tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. servers.name: Gumroad
servers.description: Read products, sales, subscribers and offer codes; verify, enable and disable product licenses.

tools.name: gumroad_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get the authenticated user associated with the current Gumroad access token. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/user.

tools.name: gumroad_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List all of the authenticated user's products. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products.

tools.name: gumroad_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get a single product by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List/filter the authenticated user's successful sales, most recent first. Supports date, email, product/order filters and cursor pagination via page_key. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/sales.

tools.name: gumroad_get_sale
tools.title: Get sale
tools.description: Get a single sale by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/sales/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List a membership/subscription product's subscribers, optionally filtered by buyer email. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/subscribers.

tools.name: gumroad_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get subscriber
tools.description: Get a single subscriber by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/subscribers/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_offer_codes
tools.title: List offer codes
tools.description: List a product's offer codes (discount codes). Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/offer_codes.

tools.name: gumroad_get_offer_code
tools.title: Get offer code
tools.description: Get a single offer code on a product by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/offer_codes/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_variant_categories
tools.title: List variant categories
tools.description: List a product's variant categories (option groups). Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/variant_categories.

tools.name: gumroad_get_variant_category
tools.title: Get variant category
tools.description: Get a single variant category on a product by id. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/variant_categories/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List a product's custom fields (extra fields collected at checkout). Gumroad REST: GET /v2/products/{product_id}/custom_fields.

tools.name: gumroad_list_resource_subscriptions
tools.title: List resource subscriptions
tools.description: List the authenticated user's resource subscriptions (webhooks) for a given resource/event name. Gumroad REST: GET /v2/resource_subscriptions.

tools.name: gumroad_verify_license
tools.title: Verify license
tools.description: Verify a license key for a product (checks validity and returns purchase details). By default this does NOT increment the uses count (no side effect). Gumroad REST: POST /v2/licenses/verify.

tools.name: gumroad_enable_product
tools.title: Enable product
tools.description: Enable (publish) a product so it can be sold. Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/products/{id}/enable.

tools.name: gumroad_disable_product
tools.title: Disable product
tools.description: Disable (unpublish) a product so it can no longer be sold. Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/products/{id}/disable.

tools.name: gumroad_create_offer_code
tools.title: Create offer code
tools.description: Create a new offer code (discount code) on a product. Gumroad REST: POST /v2/products/{product_id}/offer_codes.

tools.name: gumroad_update_offer_code
tools.title: Update offer code
tools.description: Update an existing offer code on a product (its code text and/or its max purchase count). Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/products/{product_id}/offer_codes/{id}.

tools.name: gumroad_enable_license
tools.title: Enable license
tools.description: Enable a product's license key. Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/licenses/enable.

tools.name: gumroad_disable_license
tools.title: Disable license
tools.description: Disable a product's license key. Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/licenses/disable.

tools.name: gumroad_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: gumroad_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Harvest
servers.description: Read time entries, projects, clients, tasks and invoices; log and update tracked time.

tools.name: harvest_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List time entries, optionally filtered by user, project, client, task, date range, running/billed status, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /time_entries.

tools.name: harvest_get_time_entry
tools.title: Get time entry
tools.description: Retrieve a single time entry by id. Harvest REST: GET /time_entries/{id}.

tools.name: harvest_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally filtered by active status or client, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /projects.

tools.name: harvest_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Retrieve a single project by id. Harvest REST: GET /projects/{id}.

tools.name: harvest_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients, optionally filtered by active status or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /clients.

tools.name: harvest_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: Retrieve a single client by id. Harvest REST: GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: harvest_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (the billable/non-billable work categories that can be assigned to projects), optionally filtered by active status or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /tasks.

tools.name: harvest_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the account, optionally filtered by active status or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /users.

tools.name: harvest_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated user (whom the access token belongs to). Harvest REST: GET /users/me.

tools.name: harvest_list_project_assignments
tools.title: List my project assignments
tools.description: List the authenticated user's active project assignments — the projects and their assignable tasks the current user can log time against (use this to find the project_id + task_id for harvest_create_time_entry). Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /users/me/project_assignments.

tools.name: harvest_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by client, project, state, date range, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /invoices.

tools.name: harvest_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Retrieve a single invoice by id, including its line items. Harvest REST: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: harvest_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates, optionally filtered by client, state, date range, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /estimates.

tools.name: harvest_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expenses, optionally filtered by user, client, project, date range, billed status, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /expenses.

tools.name: harvest_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Retrieve the company/account settings for the authenticated account (name, currency, time/date formats, week start, feature flags). Harvest REST: GET /company.

tools.name: harvest_create_time_entry
tools.title: Create time entry
tools.description: Create a time entry. Requires project_id, task_id and spent_date. Provide `hours` to log a specific duration; OR provide `started_time` (+ optional `ended_time`) for a timestamped entry; OR omit both to start a running timer (on a timestamp-tracking account). Use harvest_list_project_assignments to find valid project_id + task_id. Harvest REST: POST /time_entries. WRITE — creates data.

tools.name: harvest_update_time_entry
tools.title: Update time entry
tools.description: Update an existing time entry's hours, notes, spent date, or project/task. Only the fields you provide are changed. Harvest REST: PATCH /time_entries/{id}. WRITE — modifies data.

tools.name: harvest_stop_time_entry
tools.title: Stop running time entry
tools.description: Stop a currently running time entry (no-op error if it is already stopped). Harvest REST: PATCH /time_entries/{id}/stop. WRITE — modifies data.

tools.name: harvest_restart_time_entry
tools.title: Restart stopped time entry
tools.description: Restart a previously stopped time entry, resuming its timer (error if it is already running). Harvest REST: PATCH /time_entries/{id}/restart. WRITE — modifies data.

tools.name: harvest_delete_time_entry
tools.title: Delete time entry
tools.description: Permanently delete a time entry by id. This cannot be undone. Harvest REST: DELETE /time_entries/{id}. WRITE — destroys data.

tools.name: harvest_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: harvest_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Health Gorilla
servers.description: Query Health Gorilla FHIR patients, conditions, medications and lab results.

tools.name: healthgorilla_find_patients
tools.title: Find patients
tools.description: Search for patients by demographics. FHIR: GET /Patient?given=&family=&birthdate=&identifier=. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle. Use the returned Patient id with the other tools.

tools.name: healthgorilla_get_patient
tools.title: Get patient
tools.description: Read a single patient by id. FHIR: GET /Patient/{id}. Returns a FHIR Patient resource.

tools.name: healthgorilla_get_patient_everything
tools.title: Get patient $everything
tools.description: Fetch the comprehensive record for a patient as a FHIR Bundle. FHIR: GET /Patient/{id}/$everything. Optionally scope by _since and page with _count.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_conditions
tools.title: List conditions
tools.description: List a patient's conditions/problems. FHIR: GET /Condition?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_medications
tools.title: List medications
tools.description: List a patient's medication requests/prescriptions. FHIR: GET /MedicationRequest?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_allergies
tools.title: List allergies
tools.description: List a patient's allergies/intolerances. FHIR: GET /AllergyIntolerance?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_immunizations
tools.title: List immunizations
tools.description: List a patient's immunizations. FHIR: GET /Immunization?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_observations
tools.title: List observations
tools.description: List a patient's observations (labs, vitals). FHIR: GET /Observation?patient={id}. Filter by category (e.g. laboratory, vital-signs), LOINC code, or date. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_diagnostic_reports
tools.title: List diagnostic reports
tools.description: List a patient's diagnostic reports (lab panels, imaging). FHIR: GET /DiagnosticReport?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List a patient's document references (C-CDA, notes, etc). FHIR: GET /DocumentReference?patient={id}. Each entry points at a Binary you can fetch with healthgorilla_get_binary.

tools.name: healthgorilla_get_coverage
tools.title: Get coverage
tools.description: List a patient's insurance coverage. FHIR: GET /Coverage?patient={id}. Returns a FHIR searchset Bundle.

tools.name: healthgorilla_get_binary
tools.title: Get binary (document content)
tools.description: Retrieve raw document content by Binary id. FHIR: GET /Binary/{id}. Content may be a FHIR Binary JSON resource, XML C-CDA, or base64 — returned as-is (raw text if not JSON).

tools.name: healthgorilla_poll_query_status
tools.title: Poll query status
tools.description: Poll a RequestResult URL returned by healthgorilla_start_patient360_query. HTTP 202 = still processing, 200 = done (returns retrieval metrics: organizationsTotal, documentsFound, documentsImported, documentsSkipped, documentsFailed). Returns { status, body }.

tools.name: healthgorilla_fhir_search
tools.title: Generic FHIR search
tools.description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary FHIR search. GET /{resource_type}?{query}. e.g. resource_type='Observation', query='patient=123&category=laboratory&_count=5'. Use when a dedicated tool does not cover your query.

tools.name: healthgorilla_create_patient
tools.title: Create patient
tools.description: Registers a NEW patient record in your Health Gorilla tenant. FHIR: POST /Patient with a minimal FHIR R4 Patient resource built from the given args. State-changing.

tools.name: healthgorilla_start_patient360_query
tools.title: Start Patient360 query
tools.description: Initiates an asynchronous national-network records retrieval (CommonWell / Carequality / QHINs) that imports external documents into your tenant. FHIR: GET /DocumentReference/$p360-retrieve?patient={id} with header 'Prefer: respond-async'. Returns the RequestResult poll URL (Location header); poll it with healthgorilla_poll_query_status. State-changing.

servers.name: Healthchecks.io
servers.description: Manage cron/heartbeat checks, read pings and flips, pause/resume/delete on Healthchecks.io.

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_checks
tools.title: List checks
tools.description: List all checks in the project, optionally filtered by slug and/or tags. Returns {checks:[...]} — each check's status, schedule, last ping, and ping URL. Healthchecks: GET /checks/.

tools.name: healthchecksio_get_check
tools.title: Get check
tools.description: Get a single check by its UUID (or its unique read-only key). Returns the check's full state — status, timeout/schedule, grace, tags, last ping. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}.

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_pings
tools.title: List pings
tools.description: List a check's logged pings (100 on the free plan, 1000 on paid), most recent first. Each ping: type, date, n, scheme, remote_addr, method, ua, rid, duration, body_url. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}/pings/.

tools.name: healthchecksio_get_ping_body
tools.title: Get ping body
tools.description: Get the logged request body of a single ping, returned as PLAIN TEXT (verbatim, not JSON). Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}/pings/{n}/body.

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_flips
tools.title: List flips
tools.description: List a check's status changes ("flips") over time — [{timestamp, up}]. Optionally scope by a lookback window or an explicit start/end range. Healthchecks: GET /checks/{uuid}/flips/.

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_integrations
tools.title: List integrations
tools.description: List the project's notification integrations ("channels") — {channels:[{id, name, kind}]}. The ids are what you assign to a check's `channels` field. Healthchecks: GET /channels/.

tools.name: healthchecksio_list_badges
tools.title: List badges
tools.description: List the project's status-badge URLs per tag (plus "*" for the overall status) — {badges:{...}}. Healthchecks: GET /badges/.

tools.name: healthchecksio_create_check
tools.title: Create check
tools.description: CREATES a new check — this MODIFIES live monitoring config. Provide a `timeout` (simple period-based check) OR a `schedule` + `tz` (cron-based check); the two are mutually exclusive. Use `unique` to avoid creating duplicates. Assign notifications via `channels`. Healthchecks: POST /checks/. Returns the created check (201) or the existing match (200).

tools.name: healthchecksio_update_check
tools.title: Update check
tools.description: UPDATES an existing check by UUID — this MODIFIES live monitoring config. Send only the fields you want to change (timeout and schedule remain mutually exclusive). Healthchecks: POST /checks/{uuid}. Returns the updated check.

tools.name: healthchecksio_pause_check
tools.title: Pause check
tools.description: PAUSES a check — disables monitoring without deleting it (it stops going down for missed pings until it next receives a ping or is resumed). This MODIFIES live monitoring config. Healthchecks: POST /checks/{uuid}/pause (empty body).

tools.name: healthchecksio_resume_check
tools.title: Resume check
tools.description: RESUMES a paused check — re-enables monitoring. This MODIFIES live monitoring config. Returns HTTP 409 (surfaced cleanly) if the check is not currently paused. Healthchecks: POST /checks/{uuid}/resume (empty body).

tools.name: healthchecksio_delete_check
tools.title: Delete check
tools.description: PERMANENTLY DELETES a check by UUID — this MODIFIES live monitoring config and cannot be undone. Healthchecks: DELETE /checks/{uuid}. Returns the deleted check's last known state.

tools.name: healthchecksio_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: healthchecksio_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Healthchecks.io tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: healthie_current_user

tools.name: healthie_get_organization

tools.name: healthie_list_patients
tools.title: List patients
tools.description: List patients and clients in the practice, optionally narrowed by a keyword search over name and email or by active/archived status, with pagination.

tools.name: healthie_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Fetch a single user — patient or provider — by id, returning their name, contact details, date of birth, timezone and account status.

tools.name: healthie_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments, optionally filtered by patient, provider, date range, a time filter (future, past, ended, didn't-occur) or appointment status.

tools.name: healthie_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: Fetch one appointment by id with its full detail — timing, location, contact type, provider, attendees and notes.

tools.name: healthie_list_appointment_types
tools.title: List appointment types
tools.description: List the practice's bookable appointment types (services), with length, group and waitlist flags and client-facing display names.

tools.name: healthie_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List custom module form templates such as charting notes and intake forms, optionally filtered by keyword or category.

tools.name: healthie_list_form_answer_groups
tools.title: List form answer groups
tools.description: List completed form submissions — filled charting notes and intake forms — optionally scoped to a specific patient or form template.

tools.name: healthie_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents, optionally scoped to a patient or searched by keyword, returning names, content types and expiring download URLs.

tools.name: healthie_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally scoped to a client or filtered by completion status, with due dates, priority and the client each task concerns.

tools.name: healthie_list_goals
tools.title: List goals
tools.description: List care goals, optionally scoped to a patient, including description, start and due dates, repeat cadence and completion state.

tools.name: healthie_list_metric_entries
tools.title: List metric entries
tools.description: List tracked metric entries such as weight or blood pressure, optionally scoped to a client or a metric category, with the recorded values.

tools.name: healthie_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List secure messaging conversations, optionally between the current user and a given user, with participants and the latest message preview.

tools.name: healthie_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a task in Healthie from its text, optionally attaching it to a client and setting a due date, priority and the creating user.

tools.name: healthie_create_note
tools.title: Create note
tools.description: Create a note or chat entry in Healthie from its text, optionally attaching it to a client or marking it as an organization chat.

tools.name: healthie_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: healthie_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Healthie tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: HelpCrunch
servers.description: Manage HelpCrunch chats, customers, agents and knowledge-base articles.

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List / search customers (people who chatted in). Optionally filter with a single field/operator/value clause (comparison AND), sort (e.g. customers.firstSeen, customers.lastSeen) with order, and paginate with limit/offset. HelpCrunch REST: POST /customers/search.

tools.name: helpcrunch_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get a single customer by id. HelpCrunch REST: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_chats
tools.title: List chats
tools.description: List / search chats (conversations). Optionally filter with a single field/operator/value clause (comparison AND), sort (e.g. chats.createdAt) with order, and paginate with limit/offset. HelpCrunch REST: POST /chats/search.

tools.name: helpcrunch_get_chat
tools.title: Get chat
tools.description: Get a single chat (conversation) by id. HelpCrunch REST: GET /chats/{id}.

tools.name: helpcrunch_get_chat_messages
tools.title: Get chat messages
tools.description: Get the messages of a chat (conversation), newest first (sorted by createdAt DESC). Paginate with limit (max 100) / offset. HelpCrunch REST: GET /chats/{id}/messages.

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List agents (support staff / operators) in the account, with role and email. Paginate with limit/offset. HelpCrunch REST: GET /agents.

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List departments (groups of agents that chats can be routed to), each with its agents. Paginate with limit/offset. HelpCrunch REST: GET /departments.

tools.name: helpcrunch_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List applications configured in the account — web chat widgets, iOS/Android apps, and social integrations (id, name, displayName, active, type). HelpCrunch REST: GET /applications.

tools.name: helpcrunch_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Get the organization's live-chat availability status — domain, whether the team is online (teamOnline), and whether chat is enabled (chatEnabled). HelpCrunch REST: GET /organization.

tools.name: helpcrunch_create_message
tools.title: Create message
tools.description: POSTS a message into a LIVE chat — a customer-visible reply (type "message") or an internal private note (type "private"). Set `agent` (agent id) for agent messages; omit it for customer messages. HelpCrunch REST: POST /messages.

tools.name: helpcrunch_update_chat_status
tools.title: Update chat status
tools.description: CHANGES the status of a LIVE chat (e.g. mark it opened, pending, on hold, or closed). HelpCrunch REST: PUT /chats/status.

tools.name: helpcrunch_assign_chat
tools.title: Assign chat
tools.description: ASSIGNS (or unassigns) a LIVE chat to an agent. Pass `assignee` (agent id) to assign; omit it (or pass null) to unassign. HelpCrunch REST: PUT /chats/assignee.

servers.name: Hetzner Cloud
servers.description: Servers, volumes, networks, firewalls, load balancers, pricing and safe power operations.

tools.name: hetzner_list_servers
tools.title: List servers
tools.description: List the servers in the token's project, optionally filtered by name, status or a label selector. Hetzner Cloud: GET /servers.

tools.name: hetzner_get_server
tools.title: Get one server
tools.description: Fetch a single server with its type, image, IPs, volumes, networks and protection flags. Hetzner Cloud: GET /servers/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_get_server_metrics
tools.title: Get server metrics
tools.description: Fetch CPU, disk or network time series for one server over a window. Hetzner Cloud: GET /servers/{id}/metrics.

tools.name: hetzner_list_server_types
tools.title: List server types
tools.description: List the available server types with their cores, memory, disk and hourly and monthly prices — read this before creating a server. Hetzner Cloud: GET /server_types.

tools.name: hetzner_list_images
tools.title: List images
tools.description: List OS images, snapshots and backups you can boot or restore from. Hetzner Cloud: GET /images.

tools.name: hetzner_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the datacentre locations (city, country, network zone) servers can run in. Hetzner Cloud: GET /locations.

tools.name: hetzner_get_pricing
tools.title: Get pricing
tools.description: Fetch the full price list for the project's currency — server types, volumes, traffic, floating IPs, load balancers and backups. Hetzner Cloud: GET /pricing.

tools.name: hetzner_get_action
tools.title: Get one action
tools.description: Fetch the status of one asynchronous action. Every write tool here returns an action id — poll it with this to see whether the operation finished. Hetzner Cloud: GET /actions/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_volumes
tools.title: List volumes
tools.description: List block-storage volumes, their size and which server they are attached to. Hetzner Cloud: GET /volumes.

tools.name: hetzner_get_volumes
tools.title: Get one volume
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /volumes/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_networks
tools.title: List networks
tools.description: List private networks, their IP ranges, subnets and routes. Hetzner Cloud: GET /networks.

tools.name: hetzner_get_networks
tools.title: Get one network
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /networks/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_firewalls
tools.title: List firewalls
tools.description: List firewalls, their rules and which resources they are applied to. Hetzner Cloud: GET /firewalls.

tools.name: hetzner_get_firewalls
tools.title: Get one firewall
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /firewalls/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_load_balancers
tools.title: List load balancers
tools.description: List load balancers, their services, targets and health status. Hetzner Cloud: GET /load_balancers.

tools.name: hetzner_get_load_balancers
tools.title: Get one load balancer
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /load_balancers/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_ssh_keys
tools.title: List SSH keys
tools.description: List the SSH public keys available to inject when creating a server. Hetzner Cloud: GET /ssh_keys.

tools.name: hetzner_get_ssh_keys
tools.title: Get one SSH key
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /ssh_keys/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_floating_ips
tools.title: List floating IPs
tools.description: List floating IPs and which server each is assigned to. Hetzner Cloud: GET /floating_ips.

tools.name: hetzner_get_floating_ips
tools.title: Get one floating IP
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /floating_ips/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_primary_ips
tools.title: List primary IPs
tools.description: List primary IPs and their assignments. Hetzner Cloud: GET /primary_ips.

tools.name: hetzner_get_primary_ips
tools.title: Get one primary IP
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /primary_ips/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_list_certificates
tools.title: List certificates
tools.description: List TLS certificates, managed or uploaded, and their expiry. Hetzner Cloud: GET /certificates.

tools.name: hetzner_get_certificates
tools.title: Get one certificate
tools.description: Fetch a single resource by id. Hetzner Cloud: GET /certificates/{id}.

tools.name: hetzner_create_server
tools.title: Create a server
tools.description: Provision a new server. THIS STARTS BILLING: the chosen server type is charged by the hour from the moment it boots. Call hetzner_list_server_types first to see prices, and hetzner_list_images for a bootable image. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers.

tools.name: hetzner_poweron_server
tools.title: Power on a server
tools.description: Power on a stopped server. Returns an action id — poll it with hetzner_get_action. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/poweron.

tools.name: hetzner_shutdown_server
tools.title: Shut down a server
tools.description: Ask the guest OS to shut down gracefully via ACPI. Prefer this over a hard power-off. Note that a stopped server still costs money — only deleting it stops the bill. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/shutdown.

tools.name: hetzner_reboot_server
tools.title: Reboot a server
tools.description: Reboot a server gracefully via ACPI. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/reboot.

tools.name: hetzner_create_image_from_server
tools.title: Snapshot a server to an image
tools.description: Create a snapshot image from a server's disk — the safe thing to do BEFORE a risky change. Snapshots are billed for the space they use. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/create_image.

tools.name: hetzner_enable_server_backup
tools.title: Enable server backups
tools.description: Turn on automatic backups for a server. This adds roughly 20% to the server's price. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/enable_backup.

tools.name: hetzner_disable_server_backup
tools.title: Disable server backups
tools.description: Turn off automatic backups for a server. Existing backups are DELETED. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/disable_backup.

tools.name: hetzner_change_server_protection
tools.title: Change a server's protection
tools.description: Turn deletion and rebuild protection on or off for a server. Turning protection ON is the safest write in this server. Hetzner Cloud: POST /servers/{id}/actions/change_protection.

servers.name: Hypertune
servers.description: Evaluate and inspect your Hypertune feature flags from your AI assistant.

tools.name: hypertune_evaluate
tools.title: Evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate one or more feature flags for a given context — environment plus user and request attributes — and get their fully resolved JSON values back.

tools.name: hypertune_get_logic
tools.title: Get logic
tools.description: Fetch the underlying conditional expression and targeting rules of flags without reducing them, so you can inspect exactly how a flag is configured.

tools.name: hypertune_list_flags
tools.title: List flags
tools.description: List the project's top-level feature flags with their return types and descriptions — a convenient first call to discover what flags exist before evaluating.

tools.name: hypertune_introspect
tools.title: Introspect
tools.description: Run a GraphQL introspection query to discover the project's full schema, including every available flag and the exact shape of the evaluation context.

tools.name: hypertune_query
tools.title: Query
tools.description: Run an arbitrary GraphQL query with optional variables against the Hypertune edge endpoint — a power-user escape hatch for any flag shape or nested selection.

tools.name: hypertune_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hypertune_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Hypertune tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: increase_list_account_numbers

tools.name: increase_list_transactions

tools.name: increase_list_pending_transactions

tools.name: increase_list_declined_transactions

tools.name: increase_list_ach_transfers

tools.name: increase_get_ach_transfer

tools.name: increase_list_wire_transfers

tools.name: increase_list_check_transfers

tools.name: increase_list_real_time_payments_transfers
tools.title: List Real-Time Payments transfers
tools.description: List Real-Time Payments (RTP) transfers (read-only observability; this server does NOT create transfers). Increase API: GET /real_time_payments_transfers. Filter by account.

tools.name: increase_list_cards
tools.title: List cards
tools.description: List cards. Increase API: GET /cards. Filter by account and status (sent as status.in). Read-only; no card actions are exposed.

tools.name: increase_list_entities
tools.title: List entities
tools.description: List entities (the people/businesses — KYC records — that own accounts). Increase API: GET /entities. Filter by status (sent as status.in).

tools.name: increase_list_external_accounts
tools.title: List external accounts
tools.description: List external (counterparty) bank accounts registered in Increase. Increase API: GET /external_accounts. Filter by status (sent as status.in).

tools.name: increase_lookup_routing_number

tools.name: increase_create_external_account

servers.name: Infermedica
servers.description: Run Infermedica symptom checks, diagnosis, triage and condition lookups.

tools.name: infermedica_list_symptoms
tools.title: List symptoms
tools.description: List all symptoms in the Infermedica medical model (optionally age-filtered). Engine API: GET /symptoms.

tools.name: infermedica_get_symptom
tools.title: Get symptom
tools.description: Get a single symptom by its id. Engine API: GET /symptoms/{id}.

tools.name: infermedica_list_conditions
tools.title: List conditions
tools.description: List all conditions (diseases) in the Infermedica medical model. Engine API: GET /conditions.

tools.name: infermedica_get_condition
tools.title: Get condition
tools.description: Get a single condition by its id. Engine API: GET /conditions/{id}.

tools.name: infermedica_list_risk_factors
tools.title: List risk factors
tools.description: List all risk factors in the Infermedica medical model. Engine API: GET /risk_factors.

tools.name: infermedica_get_risk_factor
tools.title: Get risk factor
tools.description: Get a single risk factor by its id. Engine API: GET /risk_factors/{id}.

tools.name: infermedica_list_lab_tests
tools.title: List lab tests
tools.description: List all lab tests (and their results) in the Infermedica medical model. Engine API: GET /lab_tests.

tools.name: infermedica_get_lab_test
tools.title: Get lab test
tools.description: Get a single lab test by its id. Engine API: GET /lab_tests/{id}.

tools.name: infermedica_search_concepts
tools.title: Search concepts
tools.description: Search the medical concept database for observations matching a phrase (autocomplete). Engine API: GET /search.

tools.name: infermedica_get_info
tools.title: Get model info
tools.description: Get metadata about the current Infermedica medical model (version, last update, concept counts). Engine API: GET /info.

tools.name: infermedica_diagnosis
tools.title: Compute diagnosis
tools.description: Run the diagnostic engine over the collected evidence — returns the next question to ask, ranked candidate conditions with probabilities, and a should_stop flag. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /diagnosis.

tools.name: infermedica_triage
tools.title: Compute triage
tools.description: Recommend a triage level (emergency_ambulance | emergency | consultation_24 | consultation | self_care) plus any serious/emergency observations, given the evidence. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /triage.

tools.name: infermedica_explain
tools.title: Explain condition
tools.description: Explain which evidence supports or conflicts with a given target condition, for the collected evidence. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /explain.

tools.name: infermedica_suggest
tools.title: Suggest observations
tools.description: Suggest additional symptoms/observations the patient is likely to have, to speed up the interview. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /suggest.

tools.name: infermedica_rationale
tools.title: Get question rationale
tools.description: Explain WHY the diagnostic engine wants to ask its next question, given the evidence. Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /rationale.

tools.name: infermedica_parse
tools.title: Parse clinical text
tools.description: Extract clinical mentions (symptoms / risk factors) and their states from free-text describing complaints, mapping them to Infermedica evidence ids (NLP). Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /parse.

tools.name: infermedica_recommend_specialist
tools.title: Recommend specialist
tools.description: Recommend the most appropriate medical specialist and consultation channel for the collected evidence (accepts the same body as diagnosis/triage). Non-mutating computation. Engine API: POST /recommend_specialist.

servers.name: Inngest
servers.description: Trace events to function runs to the failing step, and bulk-cancel runs.

tools.name: inngest_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events received in the key's environment, newest first. Events are what start functions, so this is where an investigation begins. Inngest: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: inngest_get_event
tools.title: Get one event
tools.description: Fetch a single event with its name, payload and timestamp. Inngest: GET /v1/events/{eventId}.

tools.name: inngest_list_event_runs
tools.title: List the runs an event started
tools.description: List every function run one event triggered, with each run's status. This is the hop from 'this event arrived' to 'and here is what it did'. Inngest: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/runs.

tools.name: inngest_get_run
tools.title: Get one function run
tools.description: Fetch a single function run — its status, output and error. Inngest: GET /v1/runs/{runId}.

tools.name: inngest_list_run_jobs
tools.title: List a run's steps
tools.description: List the individual steps (jobs) of one run, with their status and timing — how you find which step of a durable function failed. Inngest: GET /v1/runs/{runId}/jobs.

tools.name: inngest_list_cancellations
tools.title: List bulk cancellations
tools.description: List bulk-cancellation jobs and their progress. Inngest: GET /v1/cancellations.

tools.name: inngest_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook ingresses configured for the environment — the external sources that turn into events. Inngest: GET /v1/webhooks.

tools.name: inngest_get_webhook
tools.title: Get one webhook
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook ingress with its URL and transform. Inngest: GET /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}.

tools.name: inngest_create_cancellation
tools.title: Bulk cancel function runs
tools.description: Cancel every run of one function that started within a time window, optionally narrowed by an event expression. This STOPS IN-FLIGHT WORK across your production functions — scope the window tightly. Runs already finished are unaffected. Inngest: POST /v1/cancellations.

tools.name: inngest_delete_cancellation
tools.title: Stop a bulk cancellation
tools.description: Delete a bulk-cancellation job so it stops cancelling further runs. Runs it already cancelled stay cancelled. Inngest: DELETE /v1/cancellations/{cancellationId}.

tools.name: inngest_delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete a webhook
tools.description: Remove a webhook ingress. The external source stops producing events immediately. Inngest: DELETE /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}.

servers.name: Instatus
servers.description: Manage status pages: components, incidents and maintenances; set live component status.

tools.name: instatus_list_pages
tools.title: List pages
tools.description: List all status pages on the account — each page's id, subdomain, name, status, url, custom domain, and timestamps. The page id is what every other tool takes as `page_id`. Instatus: GET /v2/pages.

tools.name: instatus_list_components
tools.title: List components
tools.description: List a status page's components — id, name, description, status, order, showUptime, grouped, archived. The component ids are what you set impact on. Instatus: GET /v2/{page_id}/components.

tools.name: instatus_get_component
tools.title: Get component
tools.description: Get a single component by id — its full state (name, description, status, order, showUptime, grouped, archived). Instatus: GET /v2/{page_id}/components/{component_id}.

tools.name: instatus_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List a status page's incidents, most recent first — optionally filtered by status. Each incident: id, name, status, impact, affected components, updates, timestamps. Instatus: GET /v1/{page_id}/incidents.

tools.name: instatus_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by id — its full state including its update timeline and affected components. Instatus: GET /v1/{page_id}/incidents/{incident_id}.

tools.name: instatus_list_maintenances
tools.title: List maintenances
tools.description: List a status page's scheduled maintenances, most recent first — id, name, status, affected components, start/end, updates. Instatus: GET /v2/{page_id}/maintenances.

tools.name: instatus_get_maintenance
tools.title: Get maintenance
tools.description: Get a single scheduled maintenance by id — its full state including its update timeline and affected components. Instatus: GET /v1/{page_id}/maintenances/{maintenance_id}.

tools.name: instatus_update_component
tools.title: Update component
tools.description: UPDATES a component by id — this MODIFIES live status-page data. The key way to set a component's operational status (OPERATIONAL, UNDERMAINTENANCE, DEGRADEDPERFORMANCE, PARTIALOUTAGE, MAJOROUTAGE). Send only the fields you want to change. Instatus: PUT /v2/{page_id}/components/{component_id}. Returns the updated component.

tools.name: instatus_create_incident
tools.title: Create incident
tools.description: CREATES a new incident — this MODIFIES live status-page data and can notify subscribers. Provide `name` (required); optionally set the initial `message`, affected `components`, per-component impact via `statuses`, `status`, `started`, `notify`, and `shouldPublish`. Instatus: POST /v1/{page_id}/incidents. Returns the created incident.

tools.name: instatus_update_incident
tools.title: Update incident
tools.description: UPDATES an existing incident by id — this MODIFIES live status-page data and can notify subscribers (e.g. move it to MONITORING or RESOLVED). Send only the fields you want to change. Instatus: PUT /v1/{page_id}/incidents/{incident_id}. Returns the updated incident.

tools.name: instatus_delete_incident
tools.title: Delete incident
tools.description: PERMANENTLY DELETES an incident by id — this MODIFIES live status-page data and cannot be undone. Instatus: DELETE /v1/{page_id}/incidents/{incident_id}.

tools.name: instatus_create_maintenance
tools.title: Create maintenance
tools.description: CREATES a new scheduled maintenance — this MODIFIES live status-page data and can notify subscribers. Provide `name` (required); optionally set `message`, affected `components`, per-component impact via `statuses`, `status`, `start`/`end`, `duration`, and `notify`. Instatus: POST /v1/{page_id}/maintenances. Returns the created maintenance.

tools.name: instatus_update_maintenance
tools.title: Update maintenance
tools.description: UPDATES an existing scheduled maintenance by id — this MODIFIES live status-page data and can notify subscribers. Send only the fields you want to change. Instatus: PUT /v1/{page_id}/maintenances/{maintenance_id}. Returns the updated maintenance.

tools.name: instatus_delete_maintenance
tools.title: Delete maintenance
tools.description: PERMANENTLY DELETES a scheduled maintenance by id — this MODIFIES live status-page data and cannot be undone. Instatus: DELETE /v1/{page_id}/maintenances/{maintenance_id}.

tools.name: kinde_get_user_permissions_in_organization
tools.title: Get a user's permissions in an organization

tools.name: northflank_get_addon

tools.name: northflank_list_service_builds

tools.name: northflank_get_service_metrics

tools.name: northflank_list_secret_groups

tools.name: northflank_list_domains

tools.name: northflank_trigger_service_build

tools.name: northflank_restart_service

tools.name: northflank_scale_service

tools.name: northflank_pause_service

tools.name: northflank_resume_service

tools.name: northflank_usage_status
