servers.name: NPPES NPI Registry
servers.description: Look up US healthcare providers and organisations by NPI.

tools.name: nppes_lookup_npi
tools.title: Look up a provider by NPI number
tools.description: Look up a single healthcare provider by their exact 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI). Returns the full registry record: basic info, addresses, taxonomies/specialties, identifiers and other names. NPPES Read API v2.1.

tools.name: nppes_search_individuals
tools.title: Search individual providers
tools.description: Search for INDIVIDUAL healthcare providers (NPI-1: doctors, nurses, therapists, etc.) by name, specialty (taxonomy) and/or location. Provide at least one meaningful criterion beyond a location. Name fields support a trailing '*' wildcard (min 2 chars before it). NPPES Read API v2.1.

tools.name: nppes_search_organizations
tools.title: Search organization providers
tools.description: Search for ORGANIZATION healthcare providers (NPI-2: hospitals, clinics, group practices, pharmacies, labs, etc.) by organization name, specialty (taxonomy) and/or location. The organization_name field supports a trailing '*' wildcard (min 2 chars before it). NPPES Read API v2.1.

tools.name: nppes_search
tools.title: Search the NPI registry (all criteria)
tools.description: Full-power search of the NPPES NPI Registry across ANY combination of criteria — individual name, organization name, NPI number, taxonomy/specialty, and location. Use nppes_search_individuals / nppes_search_organizations for the common cases; use this when you need mixed or advanced criteria. The API requires at least one meaningful search parameter. NPPES Read API v2.1.

servers.name: Numeral
servers.description: Calculate sales tax & VAT, record transactions and refunds, manage products and customers.

tools.name: numeral_ping
tools.title: Ping (health check)
tools.description: Health check — verifies the API key works and reports the environment (test/prod), api_version, and server timestamp. Numeral: GET /tax/ping.

tools.name: numeral_calculate_tax
tools.title: Calculate tax
tools.description: Calculate sales tax / VAT for an order — a STATELESS quote that persists nothing (record it later with numeral_create_transaction using the returned calculation id). Returns per-jurisdiction rates, total_tax_amount, and totals. Provide a customer address and one or more line items (each needs reference_product_id OR product_category). Amounts are in the currency's smallest unit (cents). Numeral: POST /tax/calculations.

tools.name: numeral_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: Get a recorded transaction by its Numeral id (tr_...). Returns the transaction with its line items, currencies, and metadata. Numeral: GET /tax/transactions/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: numeral_list_transaction_refunds
tools.title: List transaction refunds
tools.description: List all refunds recorded against a transaction. Returns {refunds:[...]}. Numeral: GET /tax/transactions/{transaction_id}/refunds.

tools.name: numeral_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List your Numeral products (up to 50 per page), each with its reference id, name, and product_category. Use `cursor` (the last_product_id from a previous page) to paginate; has_more indicates more pages. Numeral: GET /tax/products.

tools.name: numeral_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get a single product by its reference_product_id (your id). Returns the product's name, product_category, and timestamps. Numeral: GET /tax/products/{reference_product_id}.

tools.name: numeral_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get a customer by id. By default `customer_id` is the Numeral id (cus_...); set id_type to "reference" to look up by your own reference_customer_id. Returns name, email, and tax-exempt status. Numeral: GET /tax/customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: numeral_create_transaction
tools.title: Create transaction
tools.description: RECORDS a completed sale as a transaction — this WRITES a live tax/compliance record used for filings. Supply the `calculation_id` returned by numeral_calculate_tax and your `reference_order_id`. Numeral: POST /tax/transactions.

tools.name: numeral_create_refund
tools.title: Create refund
tools.description: RECORDS a refund against a transaction — this WRITES a live tax/compliance record (adjusts tax owed). Use type="full" to refund the whole transaction, or type="partial" with line_items (each keyed by reference_product_id) for a partial refund. Numeral: POST /tax/refunds.

tools.name: numeral_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: CREATES (or upserts) a product with its tax category — this WRITES to your Numeral product catalog, which drives future tax calculations. Numeral: POST /tax/products.

tools.name: numeral_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: CREATES a customer record — this WRITES to your Numeral customer list (used for order tracking and tax exemptions). Numeral: POST /tax/customers.

tools.name: numeral_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: numeral_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Numeral tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Nylas
servers.description: MCP server for Nylas — read email, calendars, events and contacts, and send email or create events.

tools.name: nylas_list_grants
tools.title: List grants
tools.description: List the connected accounts (grants) on your Nylas application, each with the grant_id used to scope every other email, calendar, and contacts tool.

tools.name: nylas_get_grant
tools.title: Get grant
tools.description: Get the details of a single connected account (grant) by id, including its provider and connection state.

tools.name: nylas_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List email messages for a connected account, filterable by subject, sender, recipient, folder, and unread or starred status.

tools.name: nylas_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: Get a single email message by id, including its headers, body, and metadata.

tools.name: nylas_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List the mail folders and labels for a connected account.

tools.name: nylas_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List the calendars on a connected account, each with the calendar_id used by the events tools.

tools.name: nylas_get_calendar
tools.title: Get calendar
tools.description: Get a single calendar by id, including its name, timezone, and metadata.

tools.name: nylas_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List events on a given calendar over an optional start/end time window, optionally including cancelled events.

tools.name: nylas_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: Get a single calendar event by id from a given calendar, including its time, participants, and location.

tools.name: nylas_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts for a connected account, filterable by email address or phone number.

tools.name: nylas_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id, including names, email addresses, phone numbers, and other details.

tools.name: nylas_list_drafts
tools.title: List drafts
tools.description: List the saved draft emails on a connected account.

tools.name: nylas_send_message
tools.title: Send message
tools.description: Send a real email from a connected account to the given recipients, with optional cc, bcc, and reply-to-message threading — destructive.

tools.name: nylas_create_event
tools.title: Create event
tools.description: Create a calendar event on a given calendar with a title, start/end time, description, and location, optionally inviting participants.

tools.name: nylas_create_draft
tools.title: Create draft
tools.description: Create (but do not send) a draft email on a connected account — safe and additive.

tools.name: nylas_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: nylas_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Nylas tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Olark
servers.description: Manage Olark live-chat operators and groups (teams): list, create, update, and assign to teams.

tools.name: list_operators
tools.title: List operators
tools.description: List all operators (chat agents) on the Olark account. Olark API: GET /operators. Returns operators (each with id, email, nickname, available). Only operators under the authenticated account are returned (sub-accounts are not).

tools.name: get_operator
tools.title: Get an operator
tools.description: Fetch a single operator (chat agent) by id. Olark API: GET /operators/{id}. Returns id, email, nickname, available.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List all groups (teams) on the Olark account. Olark API: GET /groups. Returns groups (each with id, name, and operator_ids — the members).

tools.name: olark_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Olark API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the base, starting with a slash, including any query string, e.g. /operators?page=2 or /groups. Returns the parsed JSON.

tools.name: create_operator
tools.title: Create an operator
tools.description: MUTATES Olark data: creates a new operator (chat agent). Olark API: POST /operators (JSON). Required: email and password; nickname (display name) optional. NOTE: creating an operator CONSUMES A PAID SEAT (billing side effect). Returns the created operator.

tools.name: update_operator
tools.title: Update an operator
tools.description: MUTATES Olark data: updates an existing operator. Olark API: PUT /operators/{id} (JSON). Set nickname (display name) and/or available (online/offline status); use the fields passthrough for any other documented field. NOTE: Olark uses full PUT semantics — omitting a field may reset it to its default.

tools.name: add_operator_to_group
tools.title: Add operator to group
tools.description: MUTATES Olark data: adds an operator to a group (team). Olark API: POST /groups/{group_id}/operators (JSON body { operator_id }). Reversible via remove_operator_from_group. Adding to a nonexistent group returns 404.

tools.name: remove_operator_from_group
tools.title: Remove operator from group
tools.description: MUTATES Olark data: removes an operator from a group (team). Olark API: DELETE /groups/{group_id}/operators/{operator_id}. Reversible via add_operator_to_group. Does NOT delete the operator, only their group membership.

tools.name: olark_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: olark_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Olark tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Onfido
servers.description: Create and read Onfido applicants, documents, checks and reports.

tools.name: onfido_list_applicants
tools.title: List applicants
tools.description: List applicant (person) records in the Onfido account, paginated. Onfido API: GET /applicants.

tools.name: onfido_get_applicant
tools.title: Get applicant
tools.description: Retrieve a single applicant record by id. Onfido API: GET /applicants/{applicant_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List the identity documents uploaded for an applicant (metadata only). Onfido API: GET /documents?applicant_id=….

tools.name: onfido_get_document
tools.title: Get document
tools.description: Retrieve a single document's metadata by id. Onfido API: GET /documents/{document_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_checks
tools.title: List checks
tools.description: List the verification checks run for an applicant (results/status, read-only). Onfido API: GET /checks?applicant_id=….

tools.name: onfido_get_check
tools.title: Get check
tools.description: Retrieve a single check (status + report ids + result) by id. Onfido API: GET /checks/{check_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the individual reports that make up a check (document, facial similarity, watchlist, …). Onfido API: GET /reports?check_id=….

tools.name: onfido_get_report
tools.title: Get report
tools.description: Retrieve a single report (detailed breakdown + result) by id. Onfido API: GET /reports/{report_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_workflow_runs
tools.title: List workflow runs
tools.description: List Onfido Studio workflow runs (status/output, read-only — does NOT start a run). Onfido API: GET /workflow_runs.

tools.name: onfido_get_workflow_run
tools.title: Get workflow run
tools.description: Retrieve a single Studio workflow run (status, output, task history) by id. Onfido API: GET /workflow_runs/{workflow_run_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_live_photos
tools.title: List live photos
tools.description: List the live photos captured for an applicant (metadata only). Onfido API: GET /live_photos?applicant_id=….

tools.name: onfido_list_live_videos
tools.title: List live videos
tools.description: List the live videos captured for an applicant (metadata only). Onfido API: GET /live_videos?applicant_id=….

tools.name: onfido_create_applicant
tools.title: Create applicant
tools.description: Creates an applicant (person) record in Onfido. Onfido API: POST /applicants. Creates a PII record only — runs NO verification check and costs nothing.

tools.name: onfido_update_applicant
tools.title: Update applicant
tools.description: Updates an applicant's details (reversible; runs no verification). Onfido API: PUT /applicants/{applicant_id}.

servers.name: openFDA
servers.description: Search openFDA drug, device, food and adverse-event datasets.

tools.name: search_drug_events
tools.title: Search drug adverse-event reports (FAERS)
tools.description: Search the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS): reports of drug side effects, adverse reactions and medication errors submitted to the FDA. Returns individual case reports. openFDA drug/event endpoint.

tools.name: search_drug_labels
tools.title: Search drug product labels (SPL)
tools.description: Search Structured Product Labeling (SPL): the official prescribing information for drugs — indications, warnings, dosage, adverse reactions, drug interactions and more. openFDA drug/label endpoint.

tools.name: search_drug_ndc
tools.title: Search the National Drug Code directory
tools.description: Search the National Drug Code (NDC) directory: every drug product's code, name, dosage form, route, active ingredients, marketing status and labeler. openFDA drug/ndc endpoint.

tools.name: search_drug_recalls
tools.title: Search drug recall enforcement reports
tools.description: Search drug recall enforcement reports: recalled drug products with the reason, classification (Class I/II/III), recalling firm, distribution and status. openFDA drug/enforcement endpoint.

tools.name: search_drugsfda
tools.title: Search Drugs@FDA approved products
tools.description: Search Drugs@FDA: FDA-approved drug products and their applications (NDA/ANDA/BLA), sponsors, approval dates, products and submissions. openFDA drug/drugsfda endpoint.

tools.name: search_drug_shortages
tools.title: Search drug shortages
tools.description: Search current and resolved drug shortages: the affected product, status, reason, availability and related dates. openFDA drug/shortages endpoint.

tools.name: search_device_events
tools.title: Search device adverse-event reports (MAUDE)
tools.description: Search the MAUDE database: medical device adverse events — reported injuries, deaths and malfunctions involving medical devices. openFDA device/event endpoint.

tools.name: search_device_510k
tools.title: Search 510(k) premarket clearances
tools.description: Search 510(k) premarket notification clearances: devices cleared for market as substantially equivalent to a predicate, with applicant, decision, product code and dates. openFDA device/510k endpoint.

tools.name: search_device_recalls
tools.title: Search device recalls
tools.description: Search medical device recalls: recalled devices with the reason, recalling firm, classification, product code and status. openFDA device/recall endpoint.

tools.name: search_device_classification
tools.title: Search device classification
tools.description: Search the FDA device classification database: a device type's product code, device class (I/II/III), regulation number, medical specialty and submission requirements. openFDA device/classification endpoint.

tools.name: search_food_events
tools.title: Search food/supplement/cosmetic adverse events (CAERS)
tools.description: Search the CFSAN Adverse Event Reporting System (CAERS): adverse events and product complaints for foods, dietary supplements and cosmetics. openFDA food/event endpoint.

tools.name: search_food_recalls
tools.title: Search food recall enforcement reports
tools.description: Search food recall enforcement reports: recalled food products with the reason, classification (Class I/II/III), recalling firm, distribution state and status. openFDA food/enforcement endpoint.

tools.name: count
tools.title: Count/aggregate over an openFDA dataset
tools.description: openFDA's most valuable feature: aggregate over any dataset by a field to get a top-terms histogram (returns `results: [{term, count}]` instead of records). Use the '.exact' field suffix to count whole phrases. Example: endpoint 'drug/event', field 'patient.reaction.reactionmeddrapt.exact', search 'patient.drug.medicinalproduct:"aspirin"' → the most common reactions reported for aspirin.

tools.name: openfda_query
tools.title: Query any openFDA endpoint (generic)
tools.description: Generic escape hatch to query ANY supported openFDA endpoint with the full parameter set — covers the less-common datasets (device/pma, device/registrationlisting, device/udi, device/covid19serology, drug/orangebook, other/nsde, other/substance, tobacco/problem, etc.). Use the named search tools for the common datasets; use this for everything else or for advanced queries. openFDA REST API.

servers.name: OpenPhone
servers.description: Send and read OpenPhone messages, calls, contacts and phone numbers.

tools.name: openphone_list_phone_numbers
tools.title: List phone numbers
tools.description: List the OpenPhone numbers in the workspace (id, number, name, formatted number, assigned users, restrictions). Usually the first call — most other tools need a phoneNumberId. OpenPhone REST: GET /phone-numbers.

tools.name: openphone_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List workspace users (id, email, name, role). Use to find a userId for scoping other calls. OpenPhone REST: GET /users.

tools.name: openphone_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the workspace, optionally filtered by external ids or sources. Returns each contact's default fields (name, company, emails, phone numbers) and custom fields. OpenPhone REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: openphone_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by its id, including default fields (name, company, role, emails, phone numbers) and custom fields. OpenPhone REST: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: openphone_get_contact_custom_fields
tools.title: Get contact custom fields
tools.description: List the workspace's contact custom-field definitions (name, key, type). Use the returned keys when creating contacts with custom fields. OpenPhone REST: GET /contact-custom-fields.

tools.name: openphone_list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List conversations (threads), most-recent activity first, optionally filtered by phone number(s), user, and created/updated date ranges. Each conversation has participants, assignee, and last-activity metadata. OpenPhone REST: GET /conversations.

tools.name: openphone_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List messages in a conversation between one of your OpenPhone numbers and one or more participants. Returns text, direction, status and timestamps. OpenPhone REST: GET /messages.

tools.name: openphone_get_message
tools.title: Get a message
tools.description: Get a single message by its id (starts with 'AC'). OpenPhone REST: GET /messages/{id}.

tools.name: openphone_send_message
tools.title: Send a text message
tools.description: Send an SMS/text message from one of your OpenPhone numbers to up to 10 recipients. WRITE ACTION — this actually sends a real text message (which may incur carrier cost and requires approved A2P 10DLC registration). OpenPhone REST: POST /messages.

tools.name: openphone_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: List calls between one of your OpenPhone numbers and a participant, newest first, optionally filtered by user and created date range. Returns direction, status, duration and timestamps. OpenPhone REST: GET /calls.

tools.name: openphone_get_call
tools.title: Get a call
tools.description: Get a single call by its id (starts with 'AC') — direction, status, duration, participants and timestamps. OpenPhone REST: GET /calls/{id}.

tools.name: openphone_get_call_summary
tools.title: Get a call summary
tools.description: Get the AI-generated summary and next steps for a call by its id. Availability depends on your plan and whether the call was summarized. OpenPhone REST: GET /call-summaries/{callId}.

tools.name: openphone_get_call_transcript
tools.title: Get a call transcript
tools.description: Get the transcription for a call by its id — dialogue segments with speaker, text and timestamps, plus overall status and duration. OpenPhone REST: GET /call-transcripts/{id}.

tools.name: openphone_get_call_recordings
tools.title: Get call recordings
tools.description: Get the recordings for a call by its id — each with a URL, duration, start time and status. OpenPhone REST: GET /call-recordings/{callId}.

tools.name: openphone_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List all webhooks configured in the workspace (id, url, events, status). Read-only inventory — this tool does not create or delete webhooks. OpenPhone REST: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: openphone_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in the workspace. WRITE ACTION — this adds a persistent contact record. Emails and phoneNumbers are passed as simple string arrays and stored under default field labels. OpenPhone REST: POST /contacts.

tools.name: orb_get_customer_costs

tools.name: orb_get_customer_credits

tools.name: orb_get_customer_credits_ledger
tools.title: Get customer credit ledger
tools.description: Get the append-only credit ledger for a customer. Orb API: GET /customers/{customer_id}/credits/ledger.

tools.name: orb_list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List plans configured in the Orb account. Orb API: GET /plans.

tools.name: orb_get_plan
tools.title: Get plan
tools.description: Fetch a single plan by id. Orb API: GET /plans/{plan_id}.

tools.name: orb_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
