tools.name: orb_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Fetch a single subscription by id. Orb API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}.

tools.name: orb_get_subscription_costs
tools.title: Get subscription costs
tools.description: Get costs for a subscription over a timeframe. Orb API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/costs.

tools.name: orb_get_subscription_usage
tools.title: Get subscription usage
tools.description: Get metered usage for a subscription over a timeframe. Orb API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/usage.

tools.name: orb_get_subscription_schedule
tools.title: Get subscription schedule
tools.description: Get the plan-change schedule for a subscription. Orb API: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/schedule.

tools.name: orb_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by customer, subscription, or status. Orb API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: orb_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Fetch a single invoice by id. Orb API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: orb_get_upcoming_invoice
tools.title: Get upcoming invoice
tools.description: Preview the upcoming (draft) invoice for a subscription. Orb API: GET /invoices/upcoming.

tools.name: orb_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List items (the things you bill for). Orb API: GET /items.

tools.name: orb_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: Fetch a single item by id. Orb API: GET /items/{item_id}.

tools.name: orb_list_prices
tools.title: List prices
tools.description: List prices configured in the Orb account. Orb API: GET /prices.

tools.name: orb_get_price
tools.title: Get price
tools.description: Fetch a single price by id. Orb API: GET /prices/{price_id}.

tools.name: orb_list_metrics
tools.title: List billable metrics
tools.description: List billable metrics configured in the Orb account. Orb API: GET /metrics.

tools.name: orb_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List coupons in the Orb account. Orb API: GET /coupons.

tools.name: orb_list_alerts
tools.title: List alerts
tools.description: List usage/spend alerts, optionally filtered by customer or subscription. Orb API: GET /alerts.

tools.name: orb_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Creates a new customer in Orb (additive). Requires name and a valid email. Orb API: POST /customers.

tools.name: orb_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: Updates an existing customer's details (reversible). Only provided fields are changed. Orb API: PUT /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: orb_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: orb_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Orb tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Oura
servers.description: Read sleep, readiness, activity, stress, heart rate and workouts from the Oura Ring.

tools.name: oura_get_personal_info
tools.title: Get personal info
tools.description: Fetch the wearer's profile — age, weight, height, biological sex and email. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/personal_info.

tools.name: oura_list_documents
tools.title: List documents from a collection
tools.description: List documents from one Oura collection over a date range. This is the main read: pick `collection` for what you want — daily_sleep and sleep for sleep, daily_readiness for recovery, daily_activity for movement, daily_stress and daily_resilience for load, workout and session for exercise, daily_spo2, daily_cardiovascular_age and vO2_max for cardiovascular measures, tag and enhanced_tag for the wearer's own annotations, rest_mode_period and ring_configuration for device state. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/{collection}.

tools.name: oura_get_document
tools.title: Get one document
tools.description: Fetch a single document by id from one collection. Ids come from oura_list_documents. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/{collection}/{document_id}.

tools.name: oura_get_heartrate
tools.title: Get heart-rate samples
tools.description: Fetch individual heart-rate samples over a DATETIME range. This collection is sampled continuously, so it uses start_datetime/end_datetime rather than dates, and can return a great many points — narrow the window or pass latest. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/heartrate.

tools.name: oura_get_ring_battery_level
tools.title: Get ring battery level
tools.description: Fetch ring battery readings over a DATETIME range, or just the latest. Oura: GET /v2/usercollection/ring_battery_level.

tools.name: oura_list_webhook_subscriptions
tools.title: List webhook subscriptions
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions registered for the application. Oura: GET /v2/webhook/subscription.

tools.name: oura_get_webhook_subscription
tools.title: Get one webhook subscription
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook subscription with its callback URL, event type and expiry. Oura: GET /v2/webhook/subscription/{id}.

tools.name: oura_create_webhook_subscription
tools.title: Create a webhook subscription
tools.description: Register a webhook so Oura notifies your callback URL when data changes. Oura verifies the URL before activating it, and the subscription EXPIRES — renew it with oura_renew_webhook_subscription. Oura: POST /v2/webhook/subscription.

tools.name: oura_renew_webhook_subscription
tools.title: Renew a webhook subscription
tools.description: Extend a webhook subscription's expiry. Oura subscriptions lapse if not renewed, so this is the tool that keeps a live integration alive. Oura: PUT /v2/webhook/subscription/renew/{id}.

tools.name: oura_delete_webhook_subscription
tools.title: Delete a webhook subscription
tools.description: Remove a webhook subscription. Notifications stop immediately. Oura: DELETE /v2/webhook/subscription/{id}.

servers.name: OwnerRez
servers.description: Manage OwnerRez properties, bookings, guests, quotes and inquiries.

tools.name: get_me
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Return the authenticated OwnerRez user (verifies your credentials). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/users/me.

tools.name: list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List rental properties. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/properties. Returns the pageable envelope { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: get_property
tools.title: Get a property
tools.description: Fetch a single property by id (includes time_zone). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/properties/{id}.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings (reservations). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/bookings. Filter by property, date range, changed-since, and status; opt into embedded charges/guest/tags. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Fetch a single booking by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/bookings/{id}. Opt into embedded charges/guest/tags.

tools.name: list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List guests (contacts). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/guests. NOTE: OwnerRez REQUIRES either `q` (search) or `created_since_utc` on this endpoint. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: get_guest
tools.title: Get a guest
tools.description: Fetch a single guest (contact) by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/guests/{id}.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: List quotes. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/quotes. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }. Use the `params` passthrough for documented filters (e.g. property_id, guest_id).

tools.name: get_quote
tools.title: Get a quote
tools.description: Fetch a single quote by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/quotes/{id}.

tools.name: list_listings
tools.title: List listings
tools.description: List channel listings (a property's presence on a listing site such as Airbnb/Vrbo). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/listings. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.title: Get a listing
tools.description: Fetch a single channel listing by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/listings/{id}.

tools.name: list_listing_sites
tools.title: List listing sites
tools.description: List the listing sites (channels, e.g. Airbnb, Vrbo) known to OwnerRez. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/listingsites.

tools.name: list_owners
tools.title: List owners
tools.description: List property owners. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/owners. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: list_inquiries
tools.title: List inquiries
tools.description: List guest inquiries (pre-booking leads). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/inquiries. Use `params` for documented filters.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List messages from guest-communication threads. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/messages. Use `params` for documented filters (e.g. booking_id).

tools.name: list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/payments. Use `params` for documented filters (e.g. booking_id, since_utc).

tools.name: get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Fetch a single payment by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/payments/{id}.

tools.name: list_field_definitions
tools.title: List custom-field definitions
tools.description: List custom-field definitions available in the account (the schema for custom fields on properties/bookings/guests). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/fielddefinitions.

tools.name: ownerrez_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any OwnerRez API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the host, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/v2/propertysearch?query=beach" or "/v2/bookings/123". Returns the parsed JSON.

tools.name: create_guest
tools.title: Create a guest
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a new guest (contact). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/guests (JSON). Emails/phones/addresses are arrays of objects — pass them via the `fields` passthrough (e.g. email_addresses:[{address:"a@b.com"}]). Returns the created guest.

tools.name: update_guest
tools.title: Update a guest
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: updates an existing guest. OwnerRez API: PATCH /v2/guests/{id} (JSON — only included fields change). Use the `fields` passthrough for arrays (email_addresses/phones/addresses) and any other documented field.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a new booking (reservation). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/bookings (JSON). A booking ties a guest to a property for a date range; the exact charge/quote shape is account-specific, so pass extra documented fields via `fields`. Returns the created booking.

tools.name: update_booking
tools.title: Update a booking
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: updates an existing booking. OwnerRez API: PATCH /v2/bookings/{id} (JSON — only included fields change). Use the `fields` passthrough for any documented field (dates, guest counts, notes, status).

tools.name: create_quote
tools.title: Create a quote
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a quote for a property + date range (the pre-booking pricing document). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/quotes (JSON). The full quote/charge shape is account-specific — pass extra documented fields via `fields`. Returns the created quote.

tools.name: create_message
tools.title: Create a message
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: posts a message into a guest-communication thread. OwnerRez API: POST /v2/messages (JSON). The exact thread/booking linkage is account-specific — pass extra documented fields (e.g. thread_id, booking_id) via `fields`. Returns the created message.

servers.name: Parabol
servers.description: Start Parabol retrospectives, standups and sprint poker; read teams/meetings/tasks; create tasks.

tools.name: get_viewer
tools.title: Get current user (viewer)
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated Parabol user (the token owner): id, preferredName, email, tier, and the team ids they belong to. Start here to discover your identity and team ids. GraphQL: viewer. Requires USERS_READ.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams the viewer belongs to, each with id, name, orgId, tier, and team lead. GraphQL: viewer.teams. Requires TEAMS_READ.

tools.name: get_team
tools.title: Get a team
tools.description: Fetch one team by id: metadata, its team members (with users), active meetings, and organization. GraphQL: viewer.team(teamId). Requires TEAMS_READ.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the members of a team, each with role flags (isLead, isOrgAdmin) and the underlying user. GraphQL: viewer.team.teamMembers. Requires TEAMS_READ.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the viewer belongs to: id, name, tier, billingTier. GraphQL: viewer.organizations. Requires ORGS_READ.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.title: Get an organization
tools.description: Fetch one organization by id, including its teams. GraphQL: viewer.organization(orgId). Requires ORGS_READ.

tools.name: list_organization_users
tools.title: List organization users
tools.description: List the users in an organization (paginated): each org-user's role, joinedAt, tier, and underlying user. GraphQL: viewer.organization.organizationUsers. Requires ORGS_READ + USERS_READ.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.title: List meetings (history)
tools.description: List past/ongoing meetings for one or more teams, newest first, across the retrospective, action, poker and teamPrompt types. GraphQL: viewer.meetings. Requires MEETINGS_READ.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.title: Get a meeting
tools.description: Fetch one meeting by id with its phases and stages; for a retrospective it also returns reflection groups/reflections and vote/topic/task/comment counts. GraphQL: viewer.meeting. Requires MEETINGS_READ.

tools.name: list_active_meetings
tools.title: List active meetings
tools.description: List a team's currently-active (in-progress) meetings. GraphQL: viewer.team.activeMeetings. Requires TEAMS_READ + MEETINGS_READ.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List the viewer's tasks (paginated), optionally filtered by team, user, status, archived state, or a text query. GraphQL: viewer.tasks. Requires TASKS_READ.

tools.name: parabol_query
tools.title: Run a GraphQL query (read-only)
tools.description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary read-only Parabol GraphQL query with optional variables. Mutations are rejected — use the dedicated write tools instead. Requires the matching read scope(s).

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task on a team (required: teamId, status). Provide plaintextContent and/or rich content; optionally assign a userId or link a meeting. GraphQL: createTask. Requires TASKS_WRITE.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Update an existing task (required: id); change content, status, assignee, or sortOrder. Only included fields change. GraphQL: updateTask. Requires TASKS_WRITE.

tools.name: create_reflection
tools.title: Create a reflection
tools.description: Add a reflection card to a running retrospective's reflect phase (required: meetingId, promptId, sortOrder). GraphQL: createReflection. Requires MEETINGS_WRITE.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.title: Add a comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a meeting discussion thread (required: content, discussionId). Optionally anonymous or a threaded reply. GraphQL: addComment. Requires COMMENTS_WRITE.

tools.name: start_retrospective
tools.title: Start a retrospective
tools.description: Start a new retrospective meeting for a team and return the new meetingId (required: teamId; optional name). GraphQL: startRetrospective. Requires MEETINGS_WRITE.

tools.name: start_checkin
tools.title: Start a check-in meeting
tools.description: Start a new Check-in (Action) meeting for a team and return the new meetingId (required: teamId; optional name). GraphQL: startCheckIn. Requires MEETINGS_WRITE.

tools.name: start_team_prompt
tools.title: Start a standup (team prompt)
tools.description: Start a new async Standup (Team Prompt) meeting for a team (required: teamId; optional name). GraphQL: startTeamPrompt. Requires MEETINGS_WRITE.

tools.name: invite_to_team
tools.title: Invite users to a team
tools.description: Send team invitations by email (required: teamId and an array of invitee emails). Optionally scope to a meeting. GraphQL: inviteToTeam. Requires TEAMS_WRITE.

tools.name: parabol_graphql
tools.title: Run a GraphQL operation (query or mutation)
tools.description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary Parabol GraphQL operation — including any mutation — with optional variables. Your token must carry the scope the operation requires. Prefer parabol_query for read-only calls.

tools.name: parabol_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: parabol_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Parabol tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Particle Health
servers.description: Query Particle Health patient records across connected clinical networks.

tools.name: particle_get_patient
tools.title: Get patient record
tools.description: Fetch a single patient record by its Particle patient id. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}.

tools.name: particle_search_patient
tools.title: Search for a patient
tools.description: Search for an existing patient by demographics (non-mutating). Returns an array of matching patient objects (or a 204 message when none match). Endpoint: POST /api/v2/patients/search.

tools.name: particle_get_query_status
tools.title: Get query status
tools.description: Get the status of a clinical-record retrieval query (state, timing, demographics, files). Omit query_id to get the latest COMPLETE query. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/query.

tools.name: particle_get_fhir
tools.title: Get FHIR bundle
tools.description: Retrieve the patient's complete clinical record as a FHIR searchset Bundle. Supports incremental sync and pagination. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/fhir.

tools.name: particle_get_fhir_by_type
tools.title: Get FHIR resources by type
tools.description: Retrieve only one FHIR resource type for a patient (e.g. Condition, MedicationRequest, Observation) as a Bundle. Supports the same pagination as particle_get_fhir. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/fhir/{type}.

tools.name: particle_get_flat
tools.title: Get flattened clinical data
tools.description: Retrieve the patient's clinical data in Particle's flattened (de-nested) format, easier to read than raw FHIR. Optionally filter to one domain. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/flat.

tools.name: particle_get_ccda
tools.title: Get C-CDA document(s)
tools.description: Retrieve the patient's C-CDA clinical document(s). May be large and returned as XML/text — parsed if JSON, otherwise passed through as-is. Endpoint: GET /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/ccda.

tools.name: particle_search_network_participants
tools.title: Search network participants
tools.description: List the health-data network participants (organizations Particle can query). Optionally filter by state or zipcode, and page with continuation_token. Endpoint: GET /api/v1/networkparticipants (with /state/{state} and /zipcode/{zip} variants).

tools.name: particle_get_patient_documents
tools.title: List patient documents
tools.description: List the documents uploaded / available for a patient. Endpoint: GET /api/v1/documents/{patient_id}.

tools.name: particle_submit_patient
tools.title: Submit (register) patient (WRITE)
tools.description: ⚠️ WRITE: register a new patient with Particle Health. Returns the patient with a system-generated particle_patient_id (use it for subsequent queries). Endpoint: POST /api/v2/patients.

tools.name: particle_create_query
tools.title: Create clinical-record query (WRITE)
tools.description: ⚠️ WRITE: initiate a nationwide clinical-record retrieval for a patient. Returns a query_id — poll particle_get_query_status for progress. Endpoint: POST /api/v2/patients/{particle_patient_id}/query.

servers.name: People Data Labs
servers.description: Enrich and search people and companies, resolve identities, and enrich IP addresses.

tools.name: pdl_person_enrich
tools.title: Pdl person enrich
tools.description: Resolve a set of identifying attributes (name, email, phone, profile URL, company, and more) to the single best-matching person profile, returned with a 1-10 likelihood score or a clean 'no match' outcome.

tools.name: pdl_person_identify
tools.title: Pdl person identify
tools.description: Given broad or ambiguous attributes about a person, return up to 20 strongly-related candidate profiles ranked by match score — the middle ground between exact 1:1 enrichment and open-ended search.

tools.name: pdl_person_search
tools.title: Pdl person search
tools.description: Query the full People Data Labs person dataset with an Elasticsearch query object or a SQL string over the Person Schema, returning matching profiles sorted by completeness with scroll-token pagination.

tools.name: pdl_company_enrich
tools.title: Pdl company enrich
tools.description: Resolve a company by name, website, ticker, or profile URL to a single best-matching record complete with firmographics such as industry, employee count, and headquarters location.

tools.name: pdl_company_search
tools.title: Pdl company search
tools.description: Query the full People Data Labs company dataset with an Elasticsearch query object or a SQL string over the Company Schema — for example every US SaaS company with 50-200 employees — with scroll-token pagination.

tools.name: pdl_ip_enrich
tools.title: Pdl ip enrich
tools.description: Enrich an IP address with its geographic location, associated company, and optionally linked person data via a 1:1 match against the People Data Labs IP dataset.

tools.name: pdl_autocomplete
tools.title: Pdl autocomplete
tools.description: Suggest valid values for a search field (company, school, location, industry, title, role, skill, and more) along with the record count for each, to help build well-formed person and company search queries.

tools.name: pdl_job_posting_search
tools.title: Pdl job posting search
tools.description: Search People Data Labs' job-posting dataset of millions of active and historical postings sourced from company career pages using an Elasticsearch query object or a SQL string.

tools.name: peopledatalabs_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: peopledatalabs_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED People Data Labs tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Persona
servers.description: Read Persona inquiries, accounts, verifications and reports.

tools.name: persona_list_inquiries
tools.title: List inquiries
tools.description: List identity-verification inquiries (an end-user's KYC verification session). Optionally filter by status, account_id, reference_id, inquiry_template_id, and a created-at date range, and paginate via the JSON:API links.next cursor (page_after) / links.prev (page_before). Returns JSON:API { data:[...], links } — objects contain PII. Persona REST: GET /inquiries.

tools.name: persona_get_inquiry
tools.title: Get inquiry
tools.description: Get a single identity-verification inquiry by id, including its status, template, and relationships (verifications, account). Returns JSON:API { data } containing PII. Persona REST: GET /inquiries/{inquiry_id}.

tools.name: persona_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List accounts (a persistent identity record for an end user, linking their inquiries/verifications over time). Optionally filter by reference_id and paginate via the JSON:API links.next cursor (page_after) / links.prev (page_before). Returns JSON:API { data:[...], links } — objects contain PII. Persona REST: GET /accounts.

tools.name: persona_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get a single account by id — the persistent identity record for an end user. Returns JSON:API { data } containing PII. Persona REST: GET /accounts/{account_id}.

tools.name: persona_get_verification
tools.title: Get verification
tools.description: Get a single verification by id — one identity check within an inquiry (e.g. government-id, selfie, database, document). Returns JSON:API { data } with check results and PII. Persona REST: GET /verifications/{verification_id}.

tools.name: persona_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List reports (screening/monitoring results such as watchlist, adverse-media, or business lookups). Paginate via the JSON:API links.next cursor (page_after) / links.prev (page_before). Returns JSON:API { data:[...], links } — objects may contain PII. Persona REST: GET /reports.

tools.name: persona_get_report
tools.title: Get report
tools.description: Get a single report by id — a screening/monitoring result (e.g. watchlist, adverse-media, business lookup). Returns JSON:API { data } containing PII. Persona REST: GET /reports/{report_id}.

tools.name: persona_list_cases
tools.title: List cases
tools.description: List cases (manual-review workflow items grouping inquiries/reports for an analyst to adjudicate). Optionally filter by status, case_template_id, account_id, reference_id, inquiry_id, report_id, and paginate via the JSON:API links.next cursor (page_after) / links.prev (page_before). Returns JSON:API { data:[...], links } — objects contain PII. Persona REST: GET /cases.

tools.name: persona_get_case
tools.title: Get case
tools.description: Get a single case by id — a manual-review workflow item. Returns JSON:API { data } containing PII. Persona REST: GET /cases/{case_id}.

tools.name: persona_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List transactions (records submitted for transaction fraud/monitoring analysis). Optionally filter by reference_id and transaction_type_id, and paginate via the JSON:API links.next cursor (page_after) / links.prev (page_before). Returns JSON:API { data:[...], links } — objects may contain PII. Persona REST: GET /transactions.

tools.name: persona_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: Get a single transaction by id — a record submitted for transaction fraud/monitoring analysis. Returns JSON:API { data } containing PII. Persona REST: GET /transactions/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: persona_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List audit-trail events (an immutable log of actions across your Persona account — inquiry/account/case state changes, etc.). Paginate via the JSON:API links.next cursor (page_after) / links.prev (page_before). Returns JSON:API { data:[...], links } — payloads may reference PII. Persona REST: GET /events.

tools.name: persona_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: Get a single audit-trail event by id, including its name and payload. Returns JSON:API { data } — payloads may reference PII. Persona REST: GET /events/{event_id}.

tools.name: persona_add_account_tag
tools.title: Add account tag
tools.description: WRITE: adds a tag to an account (mutates state). Tags label/segment accounts for review and automation. Sends JSON body { meta: { "tag-name": <tag_name> } }. Persona REST: POST /accounts/{account_id}/add-tag.

servers.name: Pipedrive
servers.description: Read deals, persons, organizations, activities and pipelines; create and update CRM records.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List deals, optionally filtered by filter/owner/person/org/pipeline/stage/status and sorted. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_deal
tools.title: Get deal
tools.description: Get a single deal by its id. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals/{id}.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_deals
tools.title: Search deals
tools.description: Search deals by term across selected fields. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/deals/search.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_persons
tools.title: List persons
tools.description: List persons (contacts), optionally filtered by filter/owner/org and sorted. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/persons.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: Get a single person (contact) by its id. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/persons/{id}.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_persons
tools.title: Search persons
tools.description: Search persons (contacts) by term across selected fields. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/persons/search.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List organizations, optionally filtered by filter/owner and sorted. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/organizations.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Get a single organization by its id. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/organizations/{id}.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_organizations
tools.title: Search organizations
tools.description: Search organizations by term across selected fields. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/organizations/search.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List activities (tasks/events), optionally filtered by filter/owner/deal/person/org/done/updated_since. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/activities.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List all pipelines. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/pipelines.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_stages
tools.title: List stages
tools.description: List stages, optionally restricted to a single pipeline. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/stages.

tools.name: pipedrive_search_items
tools.title: Search items
tools.description: Global search across multiple item types (deals, persons, organizations, products, leads, files, etc.). Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/itemSearch.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile (name, email, company, locale, timezone). Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally filtered by user/deal/person/org/lead. Uses v1 (v2 has no notes endpoint) with start+limit pagination. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v1/notes.

tools.name: pipedrive_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: Create a new deal. `title` is required; link it to a person/org/pipeline/stage/owner as needed. Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v2/deals.

tools.name: pipedrive_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: Create a new person (contact). `name` is required; `email`/`phone` are convenience strings mapped to Pipedrive's structured emails/phones arrays. Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v2/persons.

tools.name: pipedrive_create_activity
tools.title: Create activity
tools.description: Create a new activity (task/event). `subject` is required; link it to a deal/person/org and set type/date/time as needed. Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v2/activities.

tools.name: pipedrive_add_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: Add a note, linked to at least one of a deal/person/organization/lead. `content` is required (HTML or plain text). Uses v1 (v2 has no notes endpoint). Pipedrive REST: POST /api/v1/notes.

tools.name: pipedrive_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: pipedrive_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Plausible
servers.description: Query site stats, realtime visitors, breakdowns and goals from Plausible Analytics.

tools.name: plausible_query_stats
tools.title: Query stats
tools.description: The full-power Stats API query. Compute metrics over a date range, optionally grouped by dimensions and narrowed by filters, with ordering, includes, and pagination. Plausible: POST /api/v2/query.

tools.name: plausible_aggregate
tools.title: Aggregate totals
tools.description: Convenience: aggregate totals for the given metrics over a date range (no group-by). Plausible: POST /api/v2/query with no dimensions.

tools.name: plausible_timeseries
tools.title: Timeseries
tools.description: Convenience: metrics over time, grouped by a time interval. Plausible: POST /api/v2/query with dimensions=[interval].

tools.name: plausible_breakdown
tools.title: Breakdown by property
tools.description: Convenience: break metrics down by a single property (dimension), e.g. visit:source or event:page. Plausible: POST /api/v2/query with dimensions=[property].

tools.name: plausible_realtime_visitors
tools.title: Realtime visitors
tools.description: Get the number of current visitors on a site (active in the last 5 minutes). Returns a single integer. Plausible: GET /api/v1/stats/realtime/visitors.

tools.name: plausible_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List the sites the API key can access (domain + timezone), with cursor pagination. Requires an enterprise plan. Plausible: GET /api/v1/sites.

tools.name: plausible_get_site
tools.title: Get site
tools.description: Get a single site by its domain (timezone, etc.). Requires an enterprise plan. Plausible: GET /api/v1/sites/{site_id}.

tools.name: plausible_list_goals
tools.title: List goals
tools.description: List the goals (conversions) configured for a site. Requires an enterprise plan. Plausible: GET /api/v1/sites/goals.

tools.name: plausible_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: plausible_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Polar
servers.description: Products, customers, orders, subscriptions, benefits, revenue metrics and refunds.

tools.name: polar_list_organizations
tools.title: List organisations
tools.description: List the organisations the token can act for. Start here — most other tools take an organization_id. Polar: GET /v1/organizations/.

tools.name: polar_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products, optionally filtered by archived state, recurrence or a text query. Polar: GET /v1/products/.

tools.name: polar_get_product
tools.title: Get one product
tools.description: Fetch a single product with its prices and attached benefits. Polar: GET /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: polar_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally by email or a text query. Polar: GET /v1/customers/.

tools.name: polar_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by Polar id. Polar: GET /v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: polar_get_customer_state
tools.title: Get a customer's full state
tools.description: Fetch everything about one customer in a single call — active subscriptions, granted benefits and entitlements. The best answer to 'what does this customer currently have?'. Polar: GET /v1/customers/{id}/state.

tools.name: polar_get_customer_state_by_external_id
tools.title: Get a customer's state by your own id
tools.description: Same as polar_get_customer_state, but looked up by YOUR external id rather than Polar's — the usual path when you hold your own user id. Polar: GET /v1/customers/external/{external_id}/state.

tools.name: polar_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders, filtered by customer, product, subscription, status or a date window. Polar: GET /v1/orders/.

tools.name: polar_get_order
tools.title: Get one order
tools.description: Fetch a single order with its line items, discount and tax. Polar: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

tools.name: polar_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions, filtered by customer, product, status, active state or cancellation window. Polar: GET /v1/subscriptions/.

tools.name: polar_get_subscription
tools.title: Get one subscription
tools.description: Fetch a single subscription with its product, price and period. Polar: GET /v1/subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: polar_get_metrics
tools.title: Get revenue metrics
tools.description: Fetch revenue and subscription metrics over a date range, bucketed by interval — orders, revenue, MRR, active subscriptions. Polar: GET /v1/metrics/.

tools.name: polar_list_benefits
tools.title: List benefits
tools.description: List benefits — the things a product grants, such as licence keys, file downloads or Discord roles. Polar: GET /v1/benefits/.

tools.name: polar_list_benefit_grants
tools.title: List grants of a benefit
tools.description: List who has been granted one benefit, and whether the grant is still active. Polar: GET /v1/benefits/{id}/grants.

tools.name: polar_list_discounts
tools.title: List discounts
tools.description: List discount codes and their redemption limits. Polar: GET /v1/discounts/.

tools.name: polar_list_refunds
tools.title: List refunds
tools.description: List refunds, filtered by order, subscription, customer or success. Polar: GET /v1/refunds/.

tools.name: polar_list_license_keys
tools.title: List licence keys
tools.description: List issued licence keys and their status. Polar: GET /v1/license-keys/.

tools.name: polar_list_meters
tools.title: List usage meters
tools.description: List the usage meters that aggregate events into billable quantities. Polar: GET /v1/meters/.

tools.name: polar_get_meter_quantities
tools.title: Get a meter's quantities
tools.description: Fetch the aggregated quantities a meter has recorded over a window — what usage-based billing will charge for. Polar: GET /v1/meters/{id}/quantities.

tools.name: polar_list_events
tools.title: List usage events
tools.description: List the raw usage events ingested for metering, filtered by customer, meter, name or time. Polar: GET /v1/events/.

tools.name: polar_list_webhook_deliveries
tools.title: List webhook deliveries
tools.description: List webhook delivery attempts with their HTTP results — the tool for 'why did my webhook not arrive?'. Polar: GET /v1/webhooks/deliveries.

tools.name: polar_list_webhook_endpoints
tools.title: List webhook endpoints
tools.description: List the configured webhook endpoints and their subscribed events. Polar: GET /v1/webhooks/endpoints.

tools.name: polar_redeliver_webhook_event
tools.title: Redeliver a webhook event
tools.description: Queue one webhook event for redelivery after your endpoint recovered. Polar: POST /v1/webhooks/events/{id}/redeliver.

tools.name: polar_create_refund
tools.title: Refund an order
tools.description: Refund an order, in full or in part. This moves real money back to the customer. Polar: POST /v1/refunds/.

tools.name: polar_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel a subscription
tools.description: Cancel a subscription at the end of its current period. The customer keeps access until then. Polar: PATCH /v1/subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: polar_create_checkout_link
tools.title: Create a checkout link
tools.description: Create a reusable checkout URL for one or more products — the link you put in a page or an email. Polar: POST /v1/checkout-links/.

servers.name: Portkey
servers.description: Read AI-gateway analytics, configs, virtual keys, workspaces and users; log request feedback.

tools.name: portkey_get_analytics_graph
tools.title: Get analytics graph
tools.description: Get a time-series analytics graph for a single metric (cost, requests, tokens, latency, error-rate, cache-hit-rate, …) over a time window. Optionally scope by virtual keys, configs, or metadata. Portkey: GET /analytics/graphs/{metric}.

tools.name: portkey_get_analytics_group
tools.title: Get analytics group
tools.description: Get grouped analytics (aggregated by models, users, or metadata) over a time window. Portkey: GET /analytics/groups/{group}.

tools.name: portkey_list_configs
tools.title: List configs
tools.description: List gateway configs (routing/fallback/retry/cache rulesets applied to requests). Portkey: GET /configs.

tools.name: portkey_get_config
tools.title: Get config
tools.description: Get a single gateway config by slug (or id), including its routing rules. Portkey: GET /configs/{slug}.

tools.name: portkey_list_api_keys
tools.title: List API keys
tools.description: List API keys in the organization/workspace (metadata only — secrets are never returned). Portkey: GET /api-keys.

tools.name: portkey_get_api_key
tools.title: Get API key
tools.description: Get a single API key's metadata by id (the secret is never returned). Portkey: GET /api-keys/{id}.

tools.name: portkey_list_virtual_keys
tools.title: List virtual keys
tools.description: List virtual keys (the aliases that map to provider credentials + budget/rate limits used in requests). Portkey: GET /virtual-keys.

tools.name: portkey_get_virtual_key
tools.title: Get virtual key
tools.description: Get a single virtual key by slug, including its provider + limits. Portkey: GET /virtual-keys/{slug}.

tools.name: portkey_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces in the organization. Portkey: GET /workspaces.

tools.name: portkey_get_workspace
tools.title: Get workspace
tools.description: Get a single workspace by slug/id. Portkey: GET /workspaces/{id}.

tools.name: portkey_list_workspace_members
tools.title: List workspace members
tools.description: List members of a workspace (users + their roles). Portkey: GET /workspaces/{id}/members.

tools.name: portkey_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the organization. Filter by role or email. Portkey: GET /users.

tools.name: portkey_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get a single user by id. Portkey: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: portkey_list_user_invites
tools.title: List user invites
tools.description: List pending user invitations to the organization. Portkey: GET /user-invites.

tools.name: portkey_list_audit_logs
tools.title: List audit logs
tools.description: List audit log entries (admin actions across the organization). Portkey: GET /audit-logs.

tools.name: portkey_create_feedback
tools.title: Create feedback
tools.description: WRITES a feedback record into the Portkey account, attached to a request/trace by trace_id. Use for logging a quality score (typically -10..10) with an optional weight (0..1) and metadata. Portkey: POST /feedback.

tools.name: portkey_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: portkey_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Portkey tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Printify
servers.description: Read shops, catalog blueprints, print providers, products and orders; create and publish products.

tools.name: printify_list_shops
tools.title: List shops
tools.description: List all shops connected to the Printify account. This is the entry point — each shop's `id` is required by the product, order and webhook tools. Printify REST: GET /v1/shops.json.

tools.name: printify_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products in a shop (paginated). Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/products.json.

tools.name: printify_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get a single product's full details (variants, images, print areas, publish status). Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/products/{product_id}.json.

tools.name: printify_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders in a shop (paginated), optionally filtered by status or SKU. Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders.json.

tools.name: printify_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get a single order's full details, including `shipments` (carrier + tracking numbers). Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders/{order_id}.json.

tools.name: printify_calculate_shipping
tools.title: Calculate shipping
tools.description: Get a shipping price quote for a set of line items to a destination address. Non-destructive — it only prices, it does NOT place an order. `line_items` is an array where each item is one of {product_id, variant_id, quantity}, {print_provider_id, blueprint_id, variant_id, quantity}, or {sku, quantity}. `address_to` is the destination (first_name, last_name, email, phone, country, region, address1, address2, city, zip, company). Printify REST: POST /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders/shipping.json.

tools.name: printify_list_catalog_blueprints
tools.title: List catalog blueprints
tools.description: List all blueprints (product types, e.g. 'Unisex T-Shirt') available in the Printify catalog. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/blueprints.json.

tools.name: printify_get_blueprint
tools.title: Get blueprint
tools.description: Get a single catalog blueprint's details. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/blueprints/{blueprint_id}.json.

tools.name: printify_get_print_providers
tools.title: Get blueprint print providers
tools.description: List the print providers that can produce a given blueprint. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/blueprints/{blueprint_id}/print_providers.json.

tools.name: printify_get_variants
tools.title: Get variants
tools.description: List the variants (sizes, colors) a print provider offers for a blueprint. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/blueprints/{blueprint_id}/print_providers/{print_provider_id}/variants.json.

tools.name: printify_list_print_providers
tools.title: List print providers
tools.description: List all print providers in the Printify catalog. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/print_providers.json.

tools.name: printify_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured for a shop. Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/webhooks.json.

tools.name: printify_list_uploads
tools.title: List uploads
tools.description: List images uploaded to the account's media library (paginated). Printify REST: GET /v1/uploads.json.

tools.name: printify_publish_product
tools.title: Publish product
tools.description: Publish a product to the shop's connected sales channel (e.g. Shopify, Etsy). STATE-CHANGING: this locks the product and pushes the selected fields to the external store. The body is an object of booleans controlling which fields are published; all default to true. Printify REST: POST /v1/shops/{shop_id}/products/{product_id}/publish.json.

tools.name: printify_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: printify_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Quaderno
servers.description: MCP server for Quaderno — tax-rate calculation, invoices, contacts, products, receipts & expenses.

tools.name: ping
tools.title: Ping
tools.description: Ping Quaderno to verify the API key and account subdomain resolve and authenticate — a quick way to confirm the connection works before doing real work.

tools.name: calculate_tax
tools.title: Calculate tax
tools.description: Calculate the correct tax rate and amount for a sale from the customer's location and product, applying Quaderno's per-jurisdiction VAT / GST / US sales-tax rules; read-only and creates no record.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices newest-first with filters for search text, date range, state (outstanding/late/uncollectible/paid) and contact, cursor-paginated for large accounts.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Fetch a single invoice by id in full detail, including line items, taxes, payments, permalink and PDF link.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers and vendors) newest-first, searchable by name, email or tax ID, with cursor pagination.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Fetch a single contact by id, including its kind, names, email, country, tax ID and tax status.

tools.name: list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List products/items in the catalog newest-first, each with code, name, kind, unit cost, tax class, currency and stock, cursor-paginated.

tools.name: get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: Fetch a single product/item by id with its full pricing and tax configuration.

tools.name: list_credit_notes
tools.title: List credit notes
tools.description: List credit notes (refund documents) newest-first, filterable by search text, date range and contact, with cursor pagination.

tools.name: get_credit_note
tools.title: Get credit note
tools.description: Fetch a single credit note by id in full detail.

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.title: List receipts
tools.description: List receipts newest-first, filterable by search text, date range and contact, with cursor pagination.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.title: Get receipt
tools.description: Fetch a single receipt by id in full detail.

tools.name: list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expenses (bills you received) newest-first, filterable by search text, date range and vendor, with cursor pagination.

tools.name: get_expense
tools.title: Get expense
tools.description: Fetch a single expense by id in full detail.

tools.name: list_tax_codes
tools.title: List tax codes
tools.description: List the product tax codes Quaderno supports (id, name, description), used as the tax_code on products and tax calculations.

tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.title: List jurisdictions
tools.description: List the tax jurisdictions where the account is registered to collect tax, each with its name, country and region.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the account's configured webhooks with their id, target URL and subscribed events.

tools.name: quaderno_request
tools.title: Request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch to GET any read-only Quaderno API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool, for endpoints like tax IDs or evidence.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create a contact (customer or vendor) with a kind and name, plus any other Quaderno contact attribute via a free-form fields passthrough.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: Update an existing contact by id, changing only the fields you pass (name, email, country, tax ID, or any raw field).

tools.name: create_item
tools.title: Create item
tools.description: Create a product/item in the catalog with a name and unit cost, plus optional code, kind, product type, currency and any raw field.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.title: Create invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice for a contact with line items, currency, issue/due dates and notes, returning the created invoice with its permalink and PDF.

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.title: Create transaction
tools.description: Record a sale or refund transaction for which Quaderno computes the tax and produces the compliant invoice or credit-note document.

tools.name: quaderno_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: quaderno_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Quaderno tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Raisely
servers.description: Read campaigns, donations, profiles and supporters; record offline donations and upsert users.

tools.name: get_authenticated_user
tools.title: Get authenticated user
tools.description: Verify credentials and show the currently authenticated user plus their privileges; use first to confirm the API key works. Raisely API: GET /authenticate.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List fundraising campaigns. Raisely API: GET /campaigns. Returns the list envelope { data:[...], pagination }.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Fetch a single campaign by id or path/slug. Raisely API: GET /campaigns/{campaign}.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.title: List fundraising profiles
tools.description: List fundraising profiles (individual/team fundraising pages), filterable via params (campaign, type, sort, order). Raisely API: GET /profiles.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get a fundraising profile
tools.description: Fetch a single fundraising profile by path (URL slug) or uuid. Raisely API: GET /profiles/{path}.

tools.name: list_donations
tools.title: List donations
tools.description: List donations, filterable via params (campaign, status, sort, order). Raisely API: GET /donations.

tools.name: get_donation
tools.title: Get a donation
tools.description: Fetch a single donation by uuid. Raisely API: GET /donations/{uuid}.

tools.name: list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (donors/supporters/fundraisers), filterable via params. Raisely API: GET /users.

tools.name: get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Fetch a single user (donor/supporter) by uuid. Raisely API: GET /users/{uuid}.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions (recurring donations), filterable via params. Raisely API: GET /subscriptions.

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.title: Get a subscription
tools.description: Fetch a single subscription (recurring donation) by uuid. Raisely API: GET /subscriptions/{uuid}.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List posts (campaign/profile updates), filterable via params. Raisely API: GET /posts.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders (ticket/product purchases), filterable via params. Raisely API: GET /orders.

tools.name: list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List saved audience segments. Raisely API: GET /segments.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List tags used to label records. Raisely API: GET /tags.

tools.name: list_campaign_donations
tools.title: List a campaign's donations
tools.description: Convenience: list donations for a specific campaign. Raisely API: GET /campaigns/{campaign}/donations.

tools.name: list_campaign_profiles
tools.title: List a campaign's profiles
tools.description: Convenience: list fundraising profiles for a specific campaign. Raisely API: GET /campaigns/{campaign}/profiles.

tools.name: list_user_donations
tools.title: List a user's donations
tools.description: Convenience: a donor's giving history. Raisely API: GET /users/{uuid}/donations.

tools.name: raisely_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user read-only escape hatch: GET any Raisely API path (including query string) not wrapped by a dedicated tool; only GET is allowed.

tools.name: create_donation
tools.title: Record a donation
tools.description: Records a donation (for offline/manual donations such as cash or cheque); requires amount, currency, email, type and method. Raisely API: POST /donations.

tools.name: upsert_user
tools.title: Upsert a user
tools.description: Create or update a supporter/donor, matched by email so no duplicates are created. Raisely API: POST /users/upsert.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.title: Update a fundraising profile
tools.description: Update a fundraising profile's goal, name or story; only included fields change, with optional custom-field overwrite. Raisely API: PATCH /profiles/{path}.

tools.name: create_post
tools.title: Create a post
tools.description: Publish a post (a campaign/profile update); requires path, body and photoUrl. Raisely API: POST /posts.

tools.name: raisely_usage_status

servers.name: Release Radar
servers.description: Correlate GitHub releases with Sentry issues and PagerDuty incidents.

tools.name: whats_broken_since_last_deploy
tools.title: What's broken since the last deploy?
tools.description: COMPOSITE. Finds the latest GitHub deployment/release for a repo, then queries Sentry for unresolved issues SINCE that deploy's timestamp (the deploy time drives the Sentry window), then looks up who's currently on-call in PagerDuty — and synthesizes one situational-awareness object. Degrades gracefully: if Sentry or PagerDuty creds are absent it returns what it can plus a note. GitHub is required (it's the anchor).

tools.name: incident_snapshot
tools.title: Current incident snapshot
tools.description: COMPOSITE. A right-now on-call picture: top unresolved Sentry issues + active (triggered/acknowledged) PagerDuty incidents + who's currently on-call, fused into one snapshot with a human summary. Each service degrades independently if its creds are missing.

tools.name: oncall_handoff
tools.title: On-call handoff briefing
tools.description: COMPOSITE. A start-of-shift briefing for whoever is currently on call, fusing all three services: (a) PagerDuty current on-call + any active (triggered/acknowledged) incidents they're inheriting, (b) the GitHub deployment/release that most recently shipped (what's live), and (c) Sentry's top unresolved errors. Correlates them into one object — including a heads-up when a fresh deploy coincides with active incidents (a likely culprit). Degrades gracefully: every service is optional; whatever's unconfigured or failing is named in `notes` and the briefing still returns. Never crashes.

tools.name: github_latest_deploy
tools.title: Latest GitHub deploy/release
tools.description: Low-level building block: the latest GitHub deployment for a repo (falls back to the latest release), returning sha + timestamp. Used internally by whats_broken_since_last_deploy. GitHub: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/deployments.

tools.name: sentry_recent_issues
tools.title: Recent unresolved Sentry issues
tools.description: Low-level building block: unresolved Sentry issues over a relative window. Sentry: GET /api/0/projects/{org}/{project}/issues/?query=is:unresolved.
