tools.description: Health check — verifies the API key works and returns the scopes (permissions) granted to it. SendGrid: GET /v3/scopes.

tools.name: sendgrid_list_templates
tools.title: List email templates
tools.description: List your transactional email templates (Dynamic and/or Legacy). Returns { result, _metadata } — use _metadata.next / page_token to paginate. SendGrid: GET /v3/templates.

tools.name: sendgrid_get_template
tools.title: Get email template
tools.description: Get a single transactional email template by id, including its versions (subject + content). SendGrid: GET /v3/templates/{template_id}.

tools.name: sendgrid_list_marketing_lists
tools.title: List marketing lists
tools.description: List your Marketing Campaigns contact lists, each with its id, name, and contact_count. Returns { result, _metadata }. SendGrid: GET /v3/marketing/lists.

tools.name: sendgrid_get_contact_count
tools.title: Get contact count
tools.description: Get the total number of Marketing Campaigns contacts on your account. Returns { contact_count, billable_count }. SendGrid: GET /v3/marketing/contacts/count.

tools.name: sendgrid_search_contacts_by_email
tools.title: Search contacts by email
tools.description: Look up marketing contacts by exact email address (a read-only lookup — mutates nothing). Returns the matching contacts keyed by email. SendGrid: POST /v3/marketing/contacts/search/emails.

tools.name: sendgrid_get_stats
tools.title: Get email stats
tools.description: Get global email statistics over a date range (delivered, opens, clicks, bounces, spam reports, etc.), optionally grouped by day/week/month. SendGrid: GET /v3/stats.

tools.name: sendgrid_list_bounces
tools.title: List bounces
tools.description: List bounced email addresses (the bounce suppression list). Returns an array of { created, email, reason, status }. SendGrid: GET /v3/suppression/bounces.

tools.name: sendgrid_list_global_unsubscribes
tools.title: List global unsubscribes
tools.description: List globally-unsubscribed email addresses (the global suppression list). Returns an array of { created, email }. SendGrid: GET /v3/suppression/unsubscribes.

tools.name: sendgrid_send_mail
tools.title: Send email
tools.description: Sends a real email immediately via SendGrid. Provide from_email and one or more to recipients, plus either a subject + content or a template_id (values via dynamic_template_data). Returns { status, message_id }. SendGrid: POST /v3/mail/send.

tools.name: sendgrid_add_or_update_contacts
tools.title: Add or update marketing contacts
tools.description: Upserts marketing contacts (creates new ones, updates existing ones by email) and optionally adds them to lists. This is an async job — returns { job_id } you can poll. SendGrid: PUT /v3/marketing/contacts.

tools.name: sendgrid_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: sendgrid_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED SendGrid tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: SimpleTexting
servers.description: Send SMS/MMS, manage contacts, and read campaigns, messages and media on SimpleTexting.

tools.name: simpletexting_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the account's contacts as a paged collection, optionally filtered by a `since` cursor and sort `direction`. SimpleTexting REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: simpletexting_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by its id or phone number, including profile fields, list memberships, and custom fields. SimpleTexting REST: GET /contacts/{contactIdOrNumber}.

tools.name: simpletexting_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the account's campaigns as a paged collection, optionally filtered by sending number, state, list, and start-date range. Note: only immediate campaigns are returned — scheduled/recurring campaigns are NOT included. SimpleTexting REST: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: simpletexting_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: Get a single campaign by its id, including its message, recipients, and status. SimpleTexting REST: GET /campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: simpletexting_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List the account's messages as a paged collection (inbound + outbound message history). SimpleTexting REST: GET /messages.

tools.name: simpletexting_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: Get a single message by its id, including its text, direction, status, and timestamps. SimpleTexting REST: GET /messages/{id}.

tools.name: simpletexting_list_media
tools.title: List media
tools.description: List the account's media items (MMS assets) as a paged collection. SimpleTexting REST: GET /media.

tools.name: simpletexting_get_media
tools.title: Get media
tools.description: Get a single media item (MMS asset) by its id, including its URL and metadata. SimpleTexting REST: GET /media/{id}.

tools.name: simpletexting_evaluate_message
tools.title: Evaluate message
tools.description: DRY-RUN a message body to compute its segment count, whether it sends as SMS or MMS, and its estimated cost — WITHOUT sending anything. Safe and read-only. SimpleTexting REST: POST /messages/evaluate with JSON body {text, mode?}.

tools.name: simpletexting_send_message
tools.title: Send message
tools.description: SENDS A REAL SMS or MMS to a recipient — this MODIFIES live data and consumes message credits. Provide only the optional fields you need. SimpleTexting REST: POST /messages with JSON body {contactPhone, text, accountPhone?, mode?, subject?, fallbackText?, mediaItems?}.

tools.name: simpletexting_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: UPDATES a live contact — its profile fields, list memberships, and custom fields. This MODIFIES live data. Provide only the fields you want to change. SimpleTexting REST: PUT /contacts/{contactIdOrNumber}.

tools.name: simpletexting_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: simpletexting_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED SimpleTexting tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Speechmatics
servers.description: Transcribe audio and video with Speechmatics speech-to-text from Claude and any MCP client.

tools.name: speechmatics_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List your transcription jobs most-recent-first, each with its status, source data name, and audio duration, with optional pagination and deleted-job filters.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: Fetch a single job's full details and current status (running, done, rejected, deleted, or expired) so you can poll until the transcript is ready.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript
tools.description: Retrieve a completed job's transcript as plain text, SRT subtitles, or structured json-v2 with word timings, speaker labels, translations, and summaries.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_job_log
tools.title: Get job log
tools.description: Get a job's plain-text processing log, which is the quickest way to diagnose why a job was rejected or produced unexpected output.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_usage
tools.title: Get usage
tools.description: Report account usage statistics such as transcription minutes consumed over a chosen date range for cost tracking and reporting.

tools.name: speechmatics_transcribe_url
tools.title: Transcribe url
tools.description: Submit a publicly reachable audio or video URL for asynchronous speech-to-text transcription with optional diarization, custom vocabulary, translation, and summarization, returning a job id to poll.

tools.name: speechmatics_delete_job
tools.title: Delete job
tools.description: Permanently delete a job and its transcript, optionally forcing deletion while the job is still running.

tools.name: speechmatics_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: speechmatics_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Speechmatics tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Spike.sh
servers.description: Read Spike.sh incidents, on-call, escalations and services; acknowledge, resolve, set priority.

tools.name: spike_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List all teams in the Spike.sh organization — {teams:[{_id, name, uid, private, org}]}. NOT team-scoped (no x-team-id needed). The `_id` values here are what you pass as `teamId` (x-team-id) to every other tool. Spike: GET /teams/get-all-teams.

tools.name: spike_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List incidents for a team — {incidents:[...], totalIncidents, totalOpenIncidents, pagination}. Each incident carries title, status, priority, severity, and timing. Spike: GET /incidents (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_list_triggered_incidents
tools.title: List triggered incidents
tools.description: List currently TRIGGERED (open, unacknowledged) incidents for a team — the active fire-fighting queue. Spike: GET /incidents/triggered (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_list_acknowledged_incidents
tools.title: List acknowledged incidents
tools.description: List currently ACKNOWLEDGED (being worked on, not yet resolved) incidents for a team. Spike: GET /incidents/acknowledged (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get a single incident's full detail by its counterId — {incident, duration, metadata, comments, repeatedIncidents}. Spike: GET /incidents/{counterId} (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_get_incident_activity_log
tools.title: Get incident activity log
tools.description: Get the chronological activity log for an incident — {incident, activities:[...]} (who acknowledged/resolved/commented and when). Spike: GET /incidents/{counterId}/activity-log (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_list_on_calls
tools.title: List on-call schedules
tools.description: List a team's on-call schedules — {oncalls:[...]}. Each on-call has an id, name, timezone, and layers. Use the id with spike_get_on_call / spike_who_is_on_call_next. Spike: GET /on-calls (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_get_on_call
tools.title: Get on-call schedule
tools.description: Get one on-call schedule by id — {oncall:{_id, name, timezone, teams, users, activeShift, renderedShifts}}. `from` optionally sets the window start for rendered shifts. Spike: GET /on-calls/{oncallId} (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_who_is_on_call_next
tools.title: Who is on call next
tools.description: Get the NEXT scheduled shift for an on-call schedule — {nextShift:{userId, startTimeInUTC, endTimeInUTC}} (or {} if none). Spike: GET /on-calls/{oncallId}/who-is-on-call-next (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_list_escalations
tools.title: List escalation policies
tools.description: List a team's escalation policies — {totalEscalations, escalations:[{_id, name, teams, org}], pagination}. Spike: GET /escalations (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_get_escalation
tools.title: Get escalation policy
tools.description: Get one escalation policy by id — {escalation, integrations:[...], isPinned, alertRules}. Spike: GET /escalations/{escalationId} (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List a team's services — {totalServices, services:[{_id, counterId, name, desc, teams, org}], pagination}. Spike: GET /services (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_get_service
tools.title: Get service
tools.description: Get one service by its counterId — {service, org, openIncidentsCountForService, incidents, badgeURL}. Spike: GET /services/{counterId} (team-scoped).

tools.name: spike_acknowledge_incidents
tools.title: Acknowledge incidents
tools.description: ACKNOWLEDGES one or more incidents — this CHANGES live incident state (stops escalation and marks them as being worked on). Spike: POST /incidents/acknowledge with {ids:[...]}.

tools.name: spike_resolve_incidents
tools.title: Resolve incidents
tools.description: RESOLVES (closes) one or more incidents — this CHANGES live incident state and marks them done. Spike: POST /incidents/resolve with {ids:[...]}.

tools.name: spike_set_incident_priority
tools.title: Set incident priority
tools.description: Sets the PRIORITY (p1..p5) on one or more incidents — this CHANGES live incident state. Spike: POST /incidents/priority with {ids:[...], priority}.

tools.name: spike_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: spike_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Spike.sh tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Squadcast
servers.description: Read incidents, services, teams, on-call schedules; acknowledge, resolve and note incidents.

tools.name: squadcast_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: Search/list incidents over a time window with filters (status, service, priority, assignee, tags, sources, starred, SLO-affecting) and sorting. `start_time`, `end_time` (both ISO8601) and `owner_id` (a TEAM id — use squadcast_list_teams to find it) are REQUIRED. Squadcast: GET /v3/incidents/export.

tools.name: squadcast_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by its id. Squadcast: GET /v3/incidents/{incidentID}.

tools.name: squadcast_get_incident_events
tools.title: Get incident events
tools.description: Get the timeline of events for a single incident (state changes, notifications, actions). Squadcast: GET /v3/incidents/{incidentID}/events.

tools.name: squadcast_list_incident_notes
tools.title: List incident notes
tools.description: List the war-room notes on a single incident. Squadcast: GET /v3/incidents/{IncidentId}/warroom.

tools.name: squadcast_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List services for a team. `owner_id` (a TEAM id — use squadcast_list_teams to find it) is REQUIRED. Squadcast: GET /v3/services.

tools.name: squadcast_get_service
tools.title: Get service
tools.description: Get a single service by its id. Squadcast: GET /v3/services/{serviceID}.

tools.name: squadcast_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List all users in the organization. Squadcast: GET /v3/users.

tools.name: squadcast_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get a single user by their id. Squadcast: GET /v3/users/{userID}.

tools.name: squadcast_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List all teams in the organization. A team id is the `owner_id`/`teamID` several other tools require. Squadcast: GET /v3/teams.

tools.name: squadcast_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Get a single team by its id. Squadcast: GET /v3/teams/{teamId}.

tools.name: squadcast_list_squads
tools.title: List squads
tools.description: List squads for a team. `owner_id` (a TEAM id — use squadcast_list_teams to find it) is REQUIRED. Squadcast: GET /v4/squads.

tools.name: squadcast_list_schedules
tools.title: List schedules (on-call)
tools.description: List on-call schedules for a team. `teamID` is REQUIRED (use squadcast_list_teams to find it). Set `myOnCall` to filter to schedules where the token's own user is currently on call — the 'who's on call' lens. Squadcast: GET /v4/schedules.

tools.name: squadcast_list_escalation_policies
tools.title: List escalation policies
tools.description: List escalation policies for a team. `owner_id` (a TEAM id — use squadcast_list_teams to find it) is REQUIRED. Squadcast: GET /v3/escalation-policies.

tools.name: squadcast_acknowledge_incident
tools.title: Acknowledge incident
tools.description: Acknowledge a triggered incident on the LIVE account (stops escalation/paging for it). Squadcast: POST /v3/incidents/{incidentID}/acknowledge.

tools.name: squadcast_resolve_incident
tools.title: Resolve incident
tools.description: Resolve an incident on the LIVE account, recording a resolution message. Squadcast: POST /v3/incidents/{incidentID}/resolve.

tools.name: squadcast_add_incident_note
tools.title: Add incident note
tools.description: Add a war-room note to a LIVE incident (optionally with attachment URLs). Squadcast: POST /v3/incidents/{IncidentId}/warroom.

tools.name: squadcast_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: squadcast_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Squadcast tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: StatusPal
servers.description: Read status-page status, services, incidents and metrics; create, update and publish incidents.

tools.name: statuspal_get_summary
tools.title: Get status page summary
tools.description: Get the FULL status-page summary — status_page, services[], incidents[], maintenances[], upcoming_maintenances[], info_notices[], and current_status_type. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/summary.

tools.name: statuspal_get_status
tools.title: Get overall status
tools.description: Get the current overall status of the status page (the aggregate status type). StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/status.

tools.name: statuspal_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services on a status page — each with {id, name, current_incident_type, children[]}. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/services.

tools.name: statuspal_get_service_status
tools.title: Get service status
tools.description: Get the current status of a single service by its id. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/services/{service_id}/status.

tools.name: statuspal_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List incidents for a status page. Returns {incidents[], links:{next,prev}, meta:{total_count}}. Use `before`/`after` cursors to paginate and `type` to filter. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents.

tools.name: statuspal_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by its id. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}.

tools.name: statuspal_list_metrics
tools.title: List metrics
tools.description: List the metrics configured on a status page. Use `before`/`after` cursors to paginate. StatusPal: GET /status_pages/{subdomain}/metrics.

tools.name: statuspal_create_incident
tools.title: Create incident
tools.description: PUBLISHES a new incident to the LIVE public status page (and, with notify=true, emails/notifies subscribers). type="major" or "minor" is an outage incident; type="scheduled" creates a scheduled maintenance window. StatusPal: POST /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents.

tools.name: statuspal_update_incident
tools.title: Update incident
tools.description: UPDATES an existing incident on the LIVE public status page (title/type/services/timing). StatusPal: PUT /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}.

tools.name: statuspal_create_incident_update
tools.title: Post incident update
tools.description: POSTS an update (e.g. investigating → identified → monitoring → resolved) to an existing incident on the LIVE public status page (and, with notify=true, notifies subscribers). StatusPal: POST /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}/updates.

tools.name: statuspal_delete_incident
tools.title: Delete incident
tools.description: DELETES an incident from the LIVE public status page — this permanently removes it. StatusPal: DELETE /status_pages/{subdomain}/incidents/{incident_id}.

tools.name: statuspal_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED StatusPal tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: stream_get_app

tools.name: stream_query_channels
tools.title: Query channels
tools.description: List and filter channels across the app by a Stream filter (e.g. by type or member), returning each channel's recent state and messages.

tools.name: stream_get_channel

tools.name: stream_search_messages
tools.title: Search messages

tools.name: stream_get_message
tools.title: Get message

tools.name: stream_get_replies
tools.title: Get replies

tools.name: stream_get_reactions

tools.name: stream_query_members
tools.title: Query members

tools.name: stream_query_users
tools.title: Query users
tools.description: List and filter users across the app by attributes such as role or id, with sorting and pagination.

tools.name: stream_query_threads
tools.title: Query threads
tools.description: List threads (messages that have replies), optionally scoped to a user's participation and read-state, with a preview of recent replies.

tools.name: stream_get_unread_counts

tools.name: stream_send_message

tools.name: stream_send_reaction

tools.name: stream_usage_status

servers.name: Svix
servers.description: Send and debug webhooks — applications, endpoints, messages, delivery attempts and replays.

tools.name: svix_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List the applications (your tenants/customers) in the Svix environment. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app.

tools.name: svix_get_application
tools.title: Get one application
tools.description: Fetch a single application by its Svix id or your own uid. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}.

tools.name: svix_list_endpoints
tools.title: List endpoints
tools.description: List the webhook endpoints registered for one application. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint.

tools.name: svix_get_endpoint
tools.title: Get one endpoint
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook endpoint, including its URL, subscribed event types and channels. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}.

tools.name: svix_get_endpoint_stats
tools.title: Get endpoint delivery stats
tools.description: Read delivery statistics for one endpoint — counts of success, pending, sending and fail. The fastest way to see whether an endpoint is healthy. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/stats.

tools.name: svix_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List the webhook messages sent for one application, newest first. Filter by event type, channel, tag or time window. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/msg.

tools.name: svix_get_message
tools.title: Get one message
tools.description: Fetch a single message, including its event type and payload. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/msg/{msg_id}.

tools.name: svix_list_attempts_by_message
tools.title: List delivery attempts for a message
tools.description: List every delivery attempt Svix made for one message, across endpoints — status, response code and body. This is the tool for answering 'why did this webhook not arrive?'. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/attempt/msg/{msg_id}.

tools.name: svix_list_attempts_by_endpoint
tools.title: List delivery attempts for an endpoint
tools.description: List delivery attempts against one endpoint, newest first. Filter by status to find the failures. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/attempt/endpoint/{endpoint_id}.

tools.name: svix_list_endpoint_messages
tools.title: List messages for an endpoint
tools.description: List the messages destined for one endpoint, with each message's delivery status. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/msg.

tools.name: svix_list_event_types
tools.title: List event types
tools.description: List the event types defined in the environment — the catalogue endpoints can subscribe to. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/event-type.

tools.name: svix_get_event_type
tools.title: Get one event type
tools.description: Fetch a single event type by name, including its description and JSON schema. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/event-type/{event_type_name}.

tools.name: svix_list_background_tasks
tools.title: List background tasks
tools.description: List Svix background tasks (bulk replays, expunges, imports) with their status. Use it to follow up a recover or replay. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/background-task.

tools.name: svix_health
tools.title: Check API health
tools.description: Check that the Svix API is reachable and the API key works. Returns 200 with an empty body when healthy. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/health.

tools.name: svix_create_application
tools.title: Create an application
tools.description: Create a new application (one tenant/customer of yours) in the Svix environment. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app.

tools.name: svix_create_endpoint
tools.title: Create an endpoint
tools.description: Register a webhook endpoint URL for one application, optionally scoped to specific event types and channels. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint.

tools.name: svix_send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description: Send a webhook message to every endpoint of an application subscribed to the event type. This delivers real traffic to your customers' URLs. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/msg.

tools.name: svix_resend_message
tools.title: Resend a message to one endpoint
tools.description: Queue one message for redelivery to one endpoint. The usual fix after a customer's endpoint was down. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/msg/{msg_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/resend.

tools.name: svix_recover_endpoint
tools.title: Recover an endpoint's failed messages
tools.description: Replay every failed message for one endpoint since a timestamp. Runs as a background task — follow it with svix_list_background_tasks. Svix REST: POST /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/recover.

servers.name: Swell
servers.description: Manage your Swell headless-commerce store — products, orders, customers, and subscriptions.

tools.name: swell_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products in your store with MongoDB-style filtering, sorting, full-text search, field selection, and related-record expansion.

tools.name: swell_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Fetch a single product by its record id or slug, optionally expanding related records such as variants and categories.

tools.name: swell_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List product categories with filtering, sorting, search, and expansion to browse and understand your catalog structure.

tools.name: swell_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with MongoDB-style filtering, sorting, search, and expansion to review sales, fulfillment status, and revenue.

tools.name: swell_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Fetch a single order by its record id or order number, expanding line items and the customer account as needed.

tools.name: swell_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (Swell's accounts model) with filtering, sorting, search, and expansion to analyze your buyer base.

tools.name: swell_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer account by id, expanding related records such as their orders and subscriptions.

tools.name: swell_list_carts
tools.title: List carts
tools.description: List shopping carts including abandoned ones, with filtering, sorting, and expansion to surface recovery and conversion opportunities.

tools.name: swell_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring subscriptions with filtering, sorting, and expansion to track active plans, renewals, and churn.

tools.name: swell_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Fetch a single subscription by id, expanding the linked account and product for full recurring-billing detail.

tools.name: swell_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices (typically subscription invoices) with filtering, sorting, and expansion to reconcile billing and payments.

tools.name: swell_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons with filtering and sorting to audit active promotions and their redemption rules.

tools.name: swell_query
tools.title: Query
tools.description: Power tool for read-only access to any Swell collection not covered by a dedicated tool, such as stock, promotions, giftcards, payments, or settings.

tools.name: swell_create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: Create a new product in your store, setting name, price, SKU, stock, type, description, and any additional fields (mutates live store data).

tools.name: swell_update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: Partially update an existing product by id, changing fields such as price, stock level, or active status (mutates live store data).

tools.name: swell_update_order
tools.title: Update order
tools.description: Partially update an existing order by id — change status, fulfillment, or notes (mutates a live order).

tools.name: swell_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: swell_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Swell tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Tailscale
servers.description: Read devices, users, keys, ACLs and DNS for a tailnet; manage devices, routes and auth keys.

tools.name: tailscale_list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: List all devices in the tailnet (name, addresses, OS, last seen, tags, etc.). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/devices.

tools.name: tailscale_get_device
tools.title: Get device
tools.description: Get a single device by id. Tailscale REST: GET /device/{deviceId}.

tools.name: tailscale_list_device_routes
tools.title: List device routes
tools.description: List the subnet routes a device advertises and which are enabled. Tailscale REST: GET /device/{deviceId}/routes.

tools.name: tailscale_list_keys
tools.title: List keys
tools.description: List auth keys and API access tokens for the tailnet. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/keys.

tools.name: tailscale_get_key
tools.title: Get key
tools.description: Get details of a single auth key / API access token by id (capabilities, expiry, usage). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/keys/{keyId}.

tools.name: tailscale_get_policy_file
tools.title: Get policy file
tools.description: Get the tailnet's ACL / policy file (returned as JSON via the Accept header, not HuJSON). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/acl.

tools.name: tailscale_list_dns_nameservers
tools.title: List DNS nameservers
tools.description: List the global DNS nameservers configured for the tailnet. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/dns/nameservers.

tools.name: tailscale_get_dns_preferences
tools.title: Get DNS preferences
tools.description: Get the tailnet's DNS preferences (e.g. whether MagicDNS is enabled). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/dns/preferences.

tools.name: tailscale_list_dns_searchpaths
tools.title: List DNS search paths
tools.description: List the DNS search paths (search domains) configured for the tailnet. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/dns/searchpaths.

tools.name: tailscale_get_split_dns
tools.title: Get split DNS
tools.description: Get the tailnet's split-DNS configuration — a map of domain → nameservers. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/dns/split-dns.

tools.name: tailscale_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users of the tailnet, optionally filtered by type, role or status. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/users.

tools.name: tailscale_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get a single user by id. Tailscale REST: GET /users/{userId}.

tools.name: tailscale_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook endpoints configured for the tailnet. Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/webhooks.

tools.name: tailscale_get_tailnet_settings
tools.title: Get tailnet settings
tools.description: Get the tailnet's settings (device approval, key expiry, posture, etc.). Tailscale REST: GET /tailnet/{tailnet}/settings.

tools.name: tailscale_authorize_device
tools.title: Authorize device
tools.description: Authorize or de-authorize a device (only relevant when device approval is enabled for the tailnet). Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/authorized.

tools.name: tailscale_set_device_name
tools.title: Set device name
tools.description: Set (rename) a device's name. Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/name.

tools.name: tailscale_set_device_tags
tools.title: Set device tags
tools.description: Set a device's ACL tags. REPLACES the device's existing tags. Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/tags.

tools.name: tailscale_expire_device_key
tools.title: Expire device key
tools.description: Expire a device's node key, forcing it to re-authenticate — a security response to a compromised or lost device. Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/expire.

tools.name: tailscale_set_device_routes
tools.title: Set device routes
tools.description: Set the subnet routes ENABLED for a device (from the routes it advertises). REPLACES the enabled set. Tailscale REST: POST /device/{deviceId}/routes.

tools.name: tailscale_create_auth_key
tools.title: Create auth key
tools.description: Create a new auth key for the tailnet (used to register new devices). Tailscale REST: POST /tailnet/{tailnet}/keys.

tools.name: tailscale_delete_key
tools.title: Delete key
tools.description: Delete (revoke) an auth key or API access token by id — a security response. Tailscale REST: DELETE /tailnet/{tailnet}/keys/{keyId}.

tools.name: tailscale_delete_device
tools.title: Delete device
tools.description: Delete a device, removing it from the tailnet. Tailscale REST: DELETE /device/{deviceId}.

tools.name: tailscale_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: tailscale_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Text-Em-All
servers.description: Send and track Text-Em-All broadcasts, texts and contact lists.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Fetch your Text-Em-All account settings — company/billing info plus credit balances (AvailableCallUnits, CallBalance) used for sending. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/account. Use this first to confirm your credentials work.

tools.name: list_broadcasts
tools.title: List broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcasts (text + voice campaigns) as a paged Feed { Size, Items:[...], Previous, Next }. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/broadcasts. Filter with equals-style `params` (e.g. BroadcastStatus=Complete) and order with `sortby`. For date-range operators (StartDate~gte~2024-01-01) use the textemall_request escape hatch.

tools.name: get_broadcast
tools.title: Get a broadcast
tools.description: Fetch a single broadcast by id, including its status and summary. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/broadcasts/{id}.

tools.name: get_broadcast_details
tools.title: Get broadcast delivery details
tools.description: Fetch per-contact delivery details/results for a broadcast (who was reached, delivery status). Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/broadcasts/{id}/details.

tools.name: list_text_numbers
tools.title: List text numbers
tools.description: List the toll-free text (SMS) numbers on your account as a Feed. Each TextNumber has a TextNumberID you need to send a 1:1 conversation text (see send_text_message). Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/textnumbers.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List saved contact lists (groups you can broadcast to) as a Feed; each List has a ListID/ListName. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/lists. NOTE: inferred from the API's List model — if your account/endpoint differs, use the textemall_request escape hatch.

tools.name: get_authorization_token
tools.title: Get a user authorization token
tools.description: Exchange a Text-Em-All account username + PIN/password for that user's authorization token (the value you set as TEXTEMALL_AUTH_TOKEN). Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/user/login. Signed with your App/Secret key only (no user token yet). Returns { AuthToken }. Use this once to bootstrap; store the token in config thereafter.

tools.name: get_conversations_sso_url
tools.title: Get a single-sign-on conversations URL
tools.description: Generate a single-sign-on URL to the Text-Em-All conversations UI (open in a browser/iframe). Optionally scope it to one conversation thread by passing a toll-free textNumber + the other phoneNumber. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/singlesignon/conversations. Returns { Url }. No account data is changed.

tools.name: textemall_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Text-Em-All API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the origin, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/v1/broadcasts?StartDate~gte~2024-01-01&sortby=-StartDate" or "/v1/textnumbers". Returns the parsed JSON.

tools.name: create_broadcast
tools.title: Send a broadcast
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data AND SENDS MESSAGES (spends account credits): creates + sends a broadcast to the given contacts. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/broadcasts. Set broadcastType to 'SMS' (a text broadcast — provide textMessage) or 'Announcement' (a voice broadcast — provide voiceText for text-to-speech, or a pre-recorded AudioID via `fields.Audio`). Contacts is a list of { primaryPhone, firstName?, lastName?, notes? }. Extra documented fields (CallerID, TextNumberID, Lists, RetryTimes, CallThrottle, MaxMessageLength, StartDate, CheckCallingWindow) go through `fields` (PascalCase). Returns the created broadcast.

tools.name: send_text_message
tools.title: Send a conversation text
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data AND SENDS A TEXT (spends credits): sends a 1:1 conversation text message immediately from one of your toll-free text numbers to a single contact. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/conversations. You need a textNumberId (from list_text_numbers). Returns the conversation.

tools.name: create_draft_broadcast
tools.title: Create a draft broadcast
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data (creates a DRAFT — does NOT send anything): stages a broadcast with the given contacts and returns a single-sign-on URL to finish + send it in the Text-Em-All UI. Safer than create_broadcast when a human should review before sending. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/draftbroadcasts. Returns { SingleSignOnUrl, ... }.

tools.name: add_account_user
tools.title: Add an account user
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data: adds a new user to your account (a master user can do this). Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/account/users. Provide the user's fields via `fields` using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. UserName, FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, Permissions). Returns the created user.

tools.name: update_account_user
tools.title: Update an account user
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data: updates an existing account user. Text-Em-All API: PUT /v1/account/users/{user_id}. Provide the fields to change via `fields` (PascalCase, e.g. FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, Permissions). The user_id is never sent in the body. Returns the updated user.

servers.name: Trigger.dev
servers.description: Debug background jobs — runs, traces, spans, schedules, queues and deployments.

tools.name: trigger_list_runs
tools.title: List runs
tools.description: List task runs, filtered by status, task, tag, queue, schedule or a time window. This is the main read for 'what ran, and what failed?'. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs.

tools.name: trigger_get_run
tools.title: Get one run
tools.description: Fetch a single run's outcome — its status, output, error and attempts. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/result.

tools.name: trigger_get_run_trace
tools.title: Get a run's trace
tools.description: Fetch the full execution trace of a run — every span, with timings and nesting. The tool for 'where did this run spend its time, and where did it break?'. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/trace.

tools.name: trigger_get_run_span
tools.title: Get one span of a run
tools.description: Fetch a single span from a run's trace, with its own logs and attributes. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/spans/{spanId}.

tools.name: trigger_list_run_events
tools.title: List a run's events
tools.description: List the lifecycle events of one run — queued, dequeued, started, retried, completed. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/events.

tools.name: trigger_get_run_metadata
tools.title: Get a run's metadata
tools.description: Fetch the mutable metadata a run has written about itself — progress, checkpoints and custom state. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/metadata.

tools.name: trigger_get_batch_results
tools.title: Get a batch's results
tools.description: Fetch the outcome of every run in a batch. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/batches/{batchId}/results.

tools.name: trigger_list_schedules
tools.title: List schedules
tools.description: List the cron schedules configured for tasks, with their next run times. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/schedules.

tools.name: trigger_get_schedule
tools.title: Get one schedule
tools.description: Fetch a single schedule with its cron expression, timezone and active state. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId}.

tools.name: trigger_list_queues
tools.title: List queues
tools.description: List task queues with their concurrency limits and current depth — where you look when work is backing up. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/queues.

tools.name: trigger_get_queue
tools.title: Get one queue
tools.description: Fetch a single queue's concurrency limit, running count and queued count. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/queues/{queue}.

tools.name: trigger_get_current_deployment
tools.title: Get the current deployment
tools.description: Fetch the deployment currently serving the key's environment — its version, git ref and status. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/deployments/current.

tools.name: trigger_list_env_vars
tools.title: List environment variables
tools.description: List the environment variables configured for a project environment. Values may be redacted depending on the key's permissions. READ ONLY — this server exposes no env-var writes. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectRef}/envvars/{env}.

tools.name: trigger_list_waitpoint_tokens
tools.title: List waitpoint tokens
tools.description: List outstanding waitpoint tokens — runs paused waiting for an external signal. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/waitpoints/tokens.

tools.name: trigger_list_bulk_actions
tools.title: List bulk actions
tools.description: List bulk replay and cancel operations and their progress. Trigger.dev: GET /api/v1/bulk-actions.

tools.name: trigger_cancel_run
tools.title: Cancel a run
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight run. Note this is the one endpoint on API v2, not v1. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v2/runs/{runId}/cancel.

tools.name: trigger_replay_run
tools.title: Replay a run
tools.description: Re-run one specific past run with the same payload. This EXECUTES your production task again — the same side effects it had the first time. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/replay.

tools.name: trigger_reschedule_run
tools.title: Reschedule a delayed run
tools.description: Change when a delayed run will execute. Only applies to runs that have not started. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/reschedule.

tools.name: trigger_add_run_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a run
tools.description: Attach tags to a run so you can filter for it later. Additive and safe. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/tags.

tools.name: trigger_activate_schedule
tools.title: Activate a schedule
tools.description: Resume a paused schedule so it fires again. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId}/activate.

tools.name: trigger_deactivate_schedule
tools.title: Deactivate a schedule
tools.description: Pause a schedule so it stops firing. The usual first move when a scheduled task is misbehaving. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId}/deactivate.

tools.name: trigger_pause_queue
tools.title: Pause or resume a queue
tools.description: Pause a queue so its runs stop being dequeued, or resume it. The containment move when a task is failing in a loop. Trigger.dev: POST /api/v1/queues/{queue}/pause.

servers.name: Twenty
servers.description: Read people, companies, opportunities, notes and tasks; create and update records in Twenty CRM.

tools.name: twenty_list_metadata_objects
tools.title: List metadata objects
tools.description: List all objects (standard + custom) and their fields from the Twenty schema — use this to discover custom objects/fields and valid field names. Twenty REST: GET /rest/metadata/objects.

tools.name: twenty_list_people
tools.title: List people

tools.name: twenty_get_person
tools.title: Get person

tools.name: twenty_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List/filter companies. Supports cursor pagination, raw filter/order_by, and relation depth. Twenty REST: GET /rest/companies.

tools.name: twenty_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get a single company by id. Twenty REST: GET /rest/companies/{id}.

tools.name: twenty_list_opportunities
tools.title: List opportunities
tools.description: List/filter opportunities (deals). Supports cursor pagination, raw filter/order_by, and relation depth. Twenty REST: GET /rest/opportunities.

tools.name: twenty_get_opportunity
tools.title: Get opportunity
tools.description: Get a single opportunity by id. Twenty REST: GET /rest/opportunities/{id}.

tools.name: twenty_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List/filter notes. Supports cursor pagination, raw filter/order_by, and relation depth. Twenty REST: GET /rest/notes.

tools.name: twenty_get_note
tools.title: Get note
tools.description: Get a single note by id. Twenty REST: GET /rest/notes/{id}.

tools.name: twenty_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List/filter tasks. Supports cursor pagination, raw filter/order_by, and relation depth. Twenty REST: GET /rest/tasks.

tools.name: twenty_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: Get a single task by id. Twenty REST: GET /rest/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: twenty_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: Create a new person (contact). All fields optional; firstName/lastName combine into name:{firstName,lastName}. Twenty REST: POST /rest/people.

tools.name: twenty_update_person
tools.title: Update person
tools.description: Update fields on an existing person. Only provided fields change. Twenty REST: PATCH /rest/people/{id}.

tools.name: twenty_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: Create a new company. `name` is required. Twenty REST: POST /rest/companies.

tools.name: twenty_update_company
tools.title: Update company
tools.description: Update fields on an existing company. Only provided fields change. Twenty REST: PATCH /rest/companies/{id}.

tools.name: twenty_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create opportunity
tools.description: Create a new opportunity (deal). `name` is required; amountMicros combines with currencyCode into amount:{amountMicros,currencyCode}. Twenty REST: POST /rest/opportunities.

tools.name: twenty_update_opportunity
tools.title: Update opportunity
tools.description: Update fields on an existing opportunity. Only provided fields change. Twenty REST: PATCH /rest/opportunities/{id}.

tools.name: twenty_create_note
tools.title: Create note
tools.description: Create a note. `title` is required; `body` holds the note content. (Attaching to records via noteTargets is out of scope.) Twenty REST: POST /rest/notes.

tools.name: twenty_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a task. `title` is required. Twenty REST: POST /rest/tasks.

tools.name: twenty_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: Update fields on an existing task. Only provided fields change. Twenty REST: PATCH /rest/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: twenty_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: twenty_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Unkey
servers.description: Manage API keys, identities, permissions, rate-limit overrides and verification analytics.

tools.name: unkey_liveness
tools.title: Check API health
tools.description: Check that the Unkey API is reachable and the root key works. The only GET in the v2 surface. Unkey: GET /v2/liveness.

tools.name: unkey_get_key
tools.title: Get one key by id
tools.description: Fetch a key's metadata by its key id — name, owner, permissions, credits, rate limits and whether it is enabled. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.getKey.

tools.name: unkey_whoami_key
tools.title: Look up a key by its secret
tools.description: Given a plaintext API key, return which key it is and its metadata — without spending credits or recording a verification. This is the safe way to identify a key a customer sent you. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.whoami.

tools.name: unkey_get_api
tools.title: Get one API
tools.description: Fetch an API namespace by id. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/apis.getApi.

tools.name: unkey_list_api_keys
tools.title: List the keys of an API
tools.description: List every key issued under one API, optionally narrowed to a single customer by externalId. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/apis.listKeys.

tools.name: unkey_list_identities
tools.title: List identities
tools.description: List identities — the end users or organisations your keys belong to. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/identities.listIdentities.

tools.name: unkey_get_identity
tools.title: Get one identity
tools.description: Fetch a single identity with its metadata and shared rate limits. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/identities.getIdentity.

tools.name: unkey_list_permissions
tools.title: List permissions
tools.description: List the permissions defined in the workspace. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/permissions.listPermissions.

tools.name: unkey_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles defined in the workspace. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/permissions.listRoles.

tools.name: unkey_list_ratelimit_overrides
tools.title: List rate-limit overrides
tools.description: List the per-identifier overrides in one rate-limit namespace. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/ratelimit.listOverrides.

tools.name: unkey_get_ratelimit_override
tools.title: Get one rate-limit override
tools.description: Fetch the override for one identifier in a namespace. Read-only despite being a POST. Unkey: POST /v2/ratelimit.getOverride.

tools.name: unkey_query_verification_analytics
tools.title: Query key-verification analytics
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query over key-verification analytics. The query must use one of the public aliases: key_verifications_v1, key_verifications_per_minute_v1, key_verifications_per_hour_v1, key_verifications_per_day_v1 or key_verifications_per_month_v1. Physical default.* table names are rejected, and results are scoped to your workspace. Unkey: POST /v2/analytics.getVerifications.

tools.name: unkey_create_api
tools.title: Create an API
tools.description: Create a new API namespace to issue keys under. Unkey: POST /v2/apis.createApi.

tools.name: unkey_create_key
tools.title: Create an API key
tools.description: Issue a new API key under an API. The plaintext key is returned ONCE in the response and cannot be retrieved later unless recoverable is set. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.createKey.

tools.name: unkey_update_key
tools.title: Update a key
tools.description: Change a key's name, owner, metadata, expiry, roles, permissions or enabled state. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.updateKey.

tools.name: unkey_update_key_credits
tools.title: Update a key's credits
tools.description: Set, increment or decrement a key's remaining credits. Use set with no value for unlimited. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.updateCredits.

tools.name: unkey_delete_key
tools.title: Delete a key
tools.description: Revoke a key. By default this is a soft delete the key stops working but stays queryable; pass permanent to erase it. Unkey: POST /v2/keys.deleteKey.

tools.name: unkey_create_identity
tools.title: Create an identity
tools.description: Create an identity — an end user or organisation that keys and shared rate limits attach to. Unkey: POST /v2/identities.createIdentity.

tools.name: unkey_set_ratelimit_override
tools.title: Set a rate-limit override
tools.description: Set a custom rate limit for one identifier in a namespace — how you raise or lower a single customer's limit. Unkey: POST /v2/ratelimit.setOverride.

servers.name: Uploadcare
servers.description: Manage Uploadcare files, groups and webhooks; upload and store files.

tools.name: uploadcare_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Get project details: name, public key, collaborators, and whether autostore is enabled. REST API: GET /project/.

tools.name: uploadcare_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List files in the project (paginated envelope: next, previous, total, per_page, results). REST API: GET /files/.

tools.name: uploadcare_get_file
tools.title: Get file
tools.description: Get full info for a single file: uuid, url, original_filename, size, mime_type, is_image, is_ready, timestamps, variations, content_info, metadata, tags. REST API: GET /files/{uuid}/.

tools.name: uploadcare_get_file_metadata
tools.title: Get file metadata
tools.description: Get all custom metadata key/value pairs for a file. REST API: GET /files/{uuid}/metadata/.

tools.name: uploadcare_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List file groups in the project (paginated envelope: next, previous, total, per_page, results). REST API: GET /groups/.

tools.name: uploadcare_get_group
tools.title: Get group
tools.description: Get info for a single file group by its id. REST API: GET /groups/{uuid}/.

tools.name: uploadcare_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List all webhook subscriptions configured for the project. REST API: GET /webhooks/.

tools.name: uploadcare_upload_from_url
tools.title: Upload file from URL
tools.description: Uploads a file into the project from a public URL (additive). Uses the Upload API host with the public key. Returns { type: \

tools.name: uploadcare_store_file
tools.title: Store file
tools.description: Marks a file as permanently stored (otherwise unstored files are deleted after 24h). Additive. REST API: PUT /files/{uuid}/storage/.

tools.name: uploadcare_delete_file
tools.title: Delete file
tools.description: Permanently deletes a file from the project. Destructive. REST API: DELETE /files/{uuid}/.

tools.name: uploadcare_create_webhook
tools.title: Create webhook
tools.description: Creates a webhook subscription (additive). The project will POST to target_url when the chosen event fires. REST API: POST /webhooks/.

tools.name: uploadcare_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: uploadcare_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Uploadcare tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Vital
servers.description: Read wearables and lab health data — sleep, activity, workouts, timeseries, lab tests and orders.

tools.name: vital_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List every Vital user in your team with pagination, so you can browse or reconcile the people whose wearable and lab data you manage.

tools.name: vital_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Fetch a single Vital user by their Vital user_id, returning that user's profile and connection metadata.

tools.name: vital_resolve_user
tools.title: Resolve user
tools.description: Look up a Vital user by the stable client_user_id you assigned, mapping your own identifier back to Vital's user_id.

tools.name: vital_get_user_connected_providers
tools.title: Get user connected providers
tools.description: List the wearables and data sources a user has connected (Oura, Fitbit, Apple Health and more), so you know which data streams are available.

tools.name: vital_get_user_latest_info
tools.title: Get user latest info
tools.description: Get the most recent device and app info reported for a user, useful for confirming a connection is live and actively syncing.

tools.name: vital_list_providers
tools.title: List providers
tools.description: List every provider (wearable or data source) Vital supports, to see the full set a user could connect.

tools.name: vital_get_sleep
tools.title: Get sleep
tools.description: Retrieve sleep summaries for a user over a date range, including stages, duration and efficiency across their connected providers.

tools.name: vital_get_activity
tools.title: Get activity
tools.description: Retrieve daily activity summaries for a user over a date range, covering steps, active and basal calories, and overall movement.

tools.name: vital_get_workouts
tools.title: Get workouts
tools.description: Retrieve workout summaries for a user over a date range, with per-session sport, duration, distance and intensity.

tools.name: vital_get_body
tools.title: Get body
tools.description: Retrieve body summaries for a user over a date range, such as body weight and body-fat percentage measurements.

tools.name: vital_get_meal
tools.title: Get meal
tools.description: Retrieve logged meal summaries for a user over a date range, including nutrition and macronutrient breakdowns.

tools.name: vital_get_menstrual_cycle
tools.title: Get menstrual cycle
tools.description: Retrieve menstrual-cycle summaries for a user over a date range, including cycle phases and related metrics.

tools.name: vital_get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: Get a user's profile summary of static attributes such as height, optionally filtered to a single provider.

tools.name: vital_get_timeseries
tools.title: Get timeseries
tools.description: Fetch fine-grained timeseries data points for a user and resource — heart rate, HRV, glucose, blood pressure, steps and 15+ more — over a date range.

tools.name: vital_list_lab_tests
tools.title: List lab tests
tools.description: List the lab tests configured for your team, filtering by name, status or lab and sorting by price or date.

tools.name: vital_get_lab_test
tools.title: Get lab test
tools.description: Get the full definition of a single lab test by its id, including its markers and metadata.

tools.name: vital_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List lab-test orders with filters for user, status, date range and free-text search, returned paginated.

tools.name: vital_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get a single lab-test order by its id, including its current status and fulfillment details.

tools.name: vital_get_order_results
tools.title: Get order results
tools.description: Get the finalized lab-test results for an order, including biomarker values and their reference ranges.

tools.name: vital_create_user
tools.title: Create user
tools.description: Create a new Vital user record from your own client_user_id (additive), returning the Vital user_id to key future data against.

tools.name: vital_create_link_token
tools.title: Create link token
tools.description: Create a short-lived Link token so a user can connect a wearable or provider, optionally pre-selecting or restricting which providers appear.

tools.name: vital_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: vital_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Vital tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: WHOOP
servers.description: Read WHOOP recovery, sleep, cycles, workouts and body measurements.

tools.name: whoop_get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: The current user's basic WHOOP profile (user id, email, first name, last name). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/user/profile/basic. Scope: read:profile.

tools.name: whoop_body_measurement
tools.title: Get body measurement
tools.description: The user's body measurements (height in meters, weight in kilograms, max heart rate). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/user/measurement/body. Scope: read:body_measurement.

tools.name: whoop_list_cycles
tools.title: List cycles
tools.description: List the user's physiological cycles (a WHOOP 'day', ~24h anchored to sleep), most recent first. Each cycle carries a score with day strain, kilojoules burned, and average/max heart rate. Paginated (limit/nextToken) and filterable by created-time window (start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/cycle. Scope: read:cycles.

tools.name: whoop_get_cycle
tools.title: Get cycle
tools.description: Get a single physiological cycle by its id (strain, kilojoules, average/max heart rate, start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/cycle/{cycleId}. Scope: read:cycles.

tools.name: whoop_get_cycle_recovery
tools.title: Get cycle recovery
tools.description: Get the recovery scored for a specific cycle (recovery %, resting heart rate, HRV RMSSD, SpO2 %, skin temperature). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/cycle/{cycleId}/recovery. Scope: read:recovery.

tools.name: whoop_list_recoveries
tools.title: List recoveries
tools.description: List the user's recoveries, most recent first. Each recovery scores how ready the body is (recovery %, resting heart rate, HRV RMSSD, SpO2 %, skin temperature) and links to its cycle and sleep. Paginated (limit/nextToken) and filterable by created-time window (start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/recovery. Scope: read:recovery.

tools.name: whoop_list_sleep
tools.title: List sleep
tools.description: List the user's sleep activities, most recent first. Each carries a score with sleep-stage summary, sleep needed, respiratory rate, and sleep performance %. Paginated (limit/nextToken) and filterable by created-time window (start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/activity/sleep. Scope: read:sleep.

tools.name: whoop_get_sleep
tools.title: Get sleep
tools.description: Get a single sleep activity by its id (stage summary, sleep needed, respiratory rate, sleep performance %, start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/activity/sleep/{sleepId}. Scope: read:sleep.

tools.name: whoop_list_workouts
tools.title: List workouts
tools.description: List the user's workouts, most recent first. Each carries a score with strain, average/max heart rate, distance (meters), and per-heart-rate-zone durations. Paginated (limit/nextToken) and filterable by created-time window (start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/activity/workout. Scope: read:workout.

tools.name: whoop_get_workout
tools.title: Get workout
tools.description: Get a single workout by its id (sport, strain, average/max heart rate, distance, zone durations, start/end). WHOOP REST: GET /v2/activity/workout/{workoutId}. Scope: read:workout.

servers.name: YouCanBook.me
servers.description: Manage YouCanBook.me bookings, booking pages, appointment types, team members and locations.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings (appointments), filterable by profile, an after/before time window, cancelled status, and free-text search. YCBM API: GET /v1/bookings.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Fetch a single booking (appointment) by id, with optional field selection. YCBM API: GET /v1/bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.title: List profiles (booking pages)
tools.description: List all profiles (booking pages) on the account, each a bookable page with its own subdomain, appointment types, team members, and locations. YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get a profile (booking page)
tools.description: Fetch a single profile (booking page) by id, including nested sub-resources (appointment types, team members, locations). YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles/{profileId}.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.title: List a profile's team members
tools.description: List the team members configured on a profile (id, name, email, description, pic, calendarId). YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles/{profileId} with a teamMembers field selection.

tools.name: list_appointment_types
tools.title: List a profile's appointment types
tools.description: List the appointment types configured on a profile (id, name, description, slotLength, price). YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles/{profileId} with an appointmentTypes field selection.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.title: List a profile's locations
tools.description: List the locations configured on a profile (id, kind, value, notes, strategy). YCBM API: GET /v1/profiles/{profileId} with a locations field selection.

tools.name: list_available_accounts
tools.title: List available accounts (calendars)
tools.description: List the accounts/calendars available to your account, used to find the calendarId for a team member. YCBM API: GET /v1/{accountId}/availableAccounts.

tools.name: youcanbookme_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch to GET any YCBM API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool (read-only; only GET is allowed). Returns the parsed JSON.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Create a booking (appointment) on a profile from profileId, startsAt, and endsAt, with optional title, timeZone, locale, and units. YCBM API: POST /v1/bookings.

tools.name: update_booking
tools.title: Update a booking
tools.description: Update an existing booking to reschedule, rename, or mark cancelled/no-show via a partial update. YCBM API: PATCH /v1/bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking (a reversible wrapper that sets cancelled=true, safer than deleting). YCBM API: PATCH /v1/bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.title: Update a profile (booking page)
tools.description: Update a profile's (booking page) configuration via a partial update of documented profile fields. YCBM API: PATCH /v1/profiles/{profileId}.

tools.name: create_appointment_type
tools.title: Create an appointment type
tools.description: Add an appointment type (name plus optional description, slotLength, price) to a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/appointmenttypes/items.

tools.name: update_appointment_type
tools.title: Update an appointment type
tools.description: Update an appointment type on a profile via a partial update of its fields. YCBM API: PATCH /v1/profiles/{profileId}/appointmenttypes/items/{appointmentTypeId}.

tools.name: create_team_member
tools.title: Add a team member
tools.description: Add a team member (name, optional calendarId and other fields) to a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/teammembers/items.

tools.name: update_team_member
tools.title: Update a team member
tools.description: Update a team member on a profile via a partial update of its fields. YCBM API: PATCH /v1/profiles/{profileId}/teammembers/items/{teamMemberId}.

tools.name: create_location
tools.title: Add a location
tools.description: Add a location (kind and strategy plus optional value and notes) to a profile. YCBM API: POST /v1/profiles/{profileId}/locations.

tools.name: youcanbookme_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: youcanbookme_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED YouCanBook.me tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Zendesk
servers.description: Read tickets, users, orgs, macros and satisfaction ratings; create, update and comment on tickets.

tools.name: zendesk_search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Unified search across tickets, users, organizations and groups using Zendesk search syntax. Examples: `type:ticket status:open`, `type:user email:jane@acme.com`, `type:organization name:acme`. Zendesk REST: GET /search.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List recent tickets (offset pagination). Zendesk REST: GET /tickets.json.

tools.name: zendesk_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: Fetch a single ticket by id. Zendesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_ticket_comments
tools.title: List ticket comments
tools.description: List the comments (public replies and internal notes) on a ticket, oldest first. Zendesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/comments.json.

tools.name: zendesk_current_user
tools.title: Current user (whoami)
tools.description: Return the currently authenticated user — a quick way to verify credentials and subdomain. Zendesk REST: GET /users/me.json.

tools.name: zendesk_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Fetch a single user by id. Zendesk REST: GET /users/{id}.json.

tools.name: zendesk_search_users
tools.title: Search users
tools.description: Find users by name, email, phone, or other attributes. Zendesk REST: GET /users/search.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List organizations (offset pagination). Zendesk REST: GET /organizations.json.

tools.name: zendesk_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Fetch a single organization by id. Zendesk REST: GET /organizations/{id}.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List agent groups. Zendesk REST: GET /groups.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_views
tools.title: List views
tools.description: List saved ticket views (curated ticket lists). Use zendesk_execute_view to run one. Zendesk REST: GET /views.json.

tools.name: zendesk_execute_view
tools.title: Execute view
tools.description: Run a saved view by id and return the matching tickets. Zendesk REST: GET /views/{id}/execute.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_macros
tools.title: List macros
tools.description: List macros (reusable sets of ticket actions/replies agents apply). Zendesk REST: GET /macros.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_ticket_fields
tools.title: List ticket fields
tools.description: List all standard and custom ticket fields — useful for discovering field ids/values before creating or updating tickets. Zendesk REST: GET /ticket_fields.json.

tools.name: zendesk_get_ticket_metrics
tools.title: Get ticket metrics
tools.description: Fetch SLA / response / resolution time metrics for a ticket. Zendesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/metrics.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_satisfaction_ratings
tools.title: List satisfaction ratings
tools.description: List customer satisfaction (CSAT) ratings, optionally filtered by score. Zendesk REST: GET /satisfaction_ratings.json.

tools.name: zendesk_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: MUTATING: create a new support ticket. `subject` and `comment_body` are required; the comment becomes the ticket's first message. Zendesk REST: POST /tickets.json.

tools.name: zendesk_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: MUTATING: update an existing ticket. Provide the ticket `id` plus at least one field to change (status, priority, assignee_id, group_id, type, tags, or a comment). Zendesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}.json.

tools.name: zendesk_add_ticket_comment
tools.title: Add ticket comment
tools.description: MUTATING: add a comment to a ticket. `public` defaults to true (a reply visible to the requester); set it false for an internal agent note. Convenience over PUT /tickets/{id}.json.

tools.name: zendesk_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached.

tools.name: zendesk_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to Pro for unlimited tool calls, monthly ($9) or yearly ($90). Returns a Stripe Checkout link.

servers.name: Fillout
servers.description: Read Fillout forms and submissions, export responses, and create submissions and webhooks.

tools.name: fillout_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List every form in the Fillout account — each form's name and formId. Start here to find the formId the other tools need. Fillout: GET /forms.

tools.name: fillout_get_form
tools.title: Get form questions and metadata
tools.description: Fetch one form's metadata: every question (id, name, type), calculations, URL parameters, scheduling and payment fields, and quiz settings. Use the question ids to read answers or to create submissions. Fillout: GET /forms/{formId}.

tools.name: fillout_list_submissions
tools.title: List submissions
tools.description: List one page of a form's submissions (answers to every question, calculations, URL parameters, scheduling, payments, quiz score, login email), filtered by date range, status or free-text search. Offset pagination: the response carries totalResponses and pageCount. Fillout: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions.

tools.name: fillout_get_submission
tools.title: Get one submission
tools.description: Fetch a single submission by id, with every answer. Fillout: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions/{submissionId}.

tools.name: fillout_count_submissions
tools.title: Count submissions
tools.description: Count a form's submissions matching the same filters as fillout_list_submissions (date range, status, search) without pulling the answers — e.g. 'how many responses this week?' or 'how many partial submissions?'. Reads totalResponses from GET /forms/{formId}/submissions with limit=1.

tools.name: fillout_export_submissions
tools.title: Export submissions
tools.description: Fetch many submissions in one call by walking the offset pagination (150 per page, paced under Fillout's 5 requests/second limit), up to max_submissions. Same filters as fillout_list_submissions. Use this for analysis across a whole response set; the result says whether it was truncated. Fillout: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions (repeated).

tools.name: fillout_create_submissions
tools.title: Create submissions
tools.description: Create up to 10 new submissions on a form, as if respondents had filled it in — e.g. to import responses collected elsewhere. Each submission needs its question answers (question ids from fillout_get_form); URL parameters, scheduling, payments, login email and timestamps are optional. Creates real records that trigger the form's integrations. Fillout: POST /forms/{formId}/submissions.

tools.name: fillout_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a submission webhook
tools.description: Subscribe a URL to a form's new submissions: Fillout will POST each submission (same shape as a fillout_list_submissions entry) to it. Returns the webhook id — keep it, it is the only handle for removing the webhook later. Fillout: POST /webhook/create.

tools.name: fillout_remove_webhook
tools.title: Remove a submission webhook
tools.description: Stop a webhook from receiving submissions. Recoverable: create it again with fillout_create_webhook (it gets a new id). Fillout: POST /webhook/delete.

tools.name: fillout_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
