tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: fillout_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Fillout tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Checkfront
servers.description: Check Checkfront availability and rates, and manage booking sessions, bookings, customers and notes.

tools.name: checkfront_get_company
tools.title: Get company settings
tools.description: Fetch the connected Checkfront account's company configuration — name, URL, plan, currency, timezone, locale and date/time formats. A cheap way to confirm the host and credentials work. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/company.

tools.name: checkfront_list_categories
tools.title: List item categories
tools.description: List the inventory categories (e.g. Tours, Rentals, Accommodations) with their ids, names, display order and item counts. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/category.

tools.name: checkfront_list_items
tools.title: List inventory items
tools.description: List the enabled inventory items (tours, activities, rentals, rooms). With NO dates this is the plain catalogue. Pass start_date (and end_date / param quantities) to get a RATED response: per-item availability, pricing and a SLIP token — the SLIP is what checkfront_add_to_booking_session needs to book the item. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/item.

tools.name: checkfront_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Fetch one inventory item's details. Pass start_date / end_date and param quantities (e.g. {"adults": 2}) for a RATED response with availability (rate.status, rate.available), the price breakdown and the SLIP used to book it. For parent/child grouped items, rate the CHILD item. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/item/{item_id}.

tools.name: checkfront_get_availability_calendar
tools.title: Get an availability calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day available inventory over a date range — for one item (item_ids with a single id), several items, or a whole category. Use it to answer 'which days next month still have space?'. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/item/{item_id}/cal or GET /api/3.0/item/cal.

tools.name: checkfront_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings, newest filters first — by status, customer, dates, item or partner. Each row has the booking code, status, totals (total, tax_total, paid_total), customer name/email, summary and date_desc. Paged (default 100/page); the response's request.pages tells you how many pages exist. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/index.

tools.name: checkfront_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Fetch extended information on one booking — status, dates, customer, form fields, line items and totals. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}.

tools.name: checkfront_list_booking_notes
tools.title: List booking notes
tools.description: List the notes left on bookings across the account (default: the past 30 days), each with its booking code, author account id (0 = customer), date, body and whether it is private. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/notes.

tools.name: checkfront_get_booking_form
tools.title: Get the booking form fields
tools.description: Fetch the customer-details form for a booking (booking_form_ui): every field id (customer_name, customer_email, …), its label, type and whether it is required. Call this before checkfront_create_booking to know which `form` fields to send. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/form.

tools.name: checkfront_get_booking_session
tools.title: Get a booking session
tools.description: Read a booking session — the in-progress 'cart' — with its line items (keyed by line_id), dates, sub_total, tax, total and amount due. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/session.

tools.name: checkfront_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Look up customers by exact email, full name or phone number (exact matches; non-unique fields such as name can return several). Results are in the `customers` object. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/customer.

tools.name: checkfront_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer's contact details and their bookings (codes with created dates). Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/customer/{customer_id}.

tools.name: checkfront_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the date-based events that change price or availability — seasonal rates (SE), specials (SP), discounts (DC), closures (status U) — with their dates, recurrence, pricing rule and the items/categories they apply to. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/event.

tools.name: checkfront_list_staff_accounts
tools.title: List staff accounts
tools.description: List the staff (and partner) accounts on the Checkfront account — ids, names, emails, login ids and whether enabled. The account_id is what CHECKFRONT_ON_BEHALF takes. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/account.

tools.name: checkfront_add_to_booking_session
tools.title: Add items to a booking session
tools.description: Start or modify a booking session: add one or more SLIPs (from a rated checkfront_get_item / checkfront_list_items call), replace a line with a new SLIP (line_id + slip), or alter lines (quantity, 'remove', 'optin'/'optout' for package add-ons). Holds the inventory while the session is open; NOTHING is booked until checkfront_create_booking. Returns the session_id to reuse. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/session.

tools.name: checkfront_end_booking_session
tools.title: End or clear a booking session
tools.description: Abandon a booking session: 'clear' empties its items, 'end' closes it. Releases the inventory it was holding; no booking is affected. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/session/clear or /booking/session/end.

tools.name: checkfront_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Commit a booking: from a session_id (built with checkfront_add_to_booking_session) or directly from SLIPs, plus the customer form fields (see checkfront_get_booking_form for which are required — typically customer_name and customer_email). Creates a real reservation that consumes inventory and may notify the customer; change it later with checkfront_update_booking_status. Returns the new booking's ids and any invoice/payment URL. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/create.

tools.name: checkfront_update_booking_status
tools.title: Change a booking's status
tools.description: Set a booking's status — e.g. confirm a pending booking (PAID/PART), put it on HOLD or WAIT(list), or cancel it (VOID/STOP). Reversible: set it back to the previous status the same way. Does NOT record a payment. Optionally triggers the account's customer notifications. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/update.

tools.name: checkfront_add_booking_note
tools.title: Add a note to a booking
tools.description: Add a note to a booking, logged under the staff account the API acts on behalf of. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/note.

tools.name: checkfront_check_in_booking
tools.title: Check a booking in or out
tools.description: Mark a guest as arrived (check in) or departed (check out). Checkfront adds a note under the acting account. VOID and cancelled bookings cannot be checked in or out. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/checkin or /checkout.

tools.name: checkfront_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: checkfront_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Checkfront tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Breeze ChMS
servers.description: Manage Breeze ChMS people, tags, events, check-ins, volunteers and contributions.

tools.name: breeze_get_account_summary
tools.title: Get the account summary
tools.description: The church account this key belongs to: name, subdomain, status, timezone and country/currency. A cheap way to confirm BREEZE_SUBDOMAIN and BREEZE_API_KEY are right. Breeze: GET /api/account/summary.

tools.name: breeze_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people in the church database, optionally filtered (by tag, status, gender, etc.) and paginated with limit/offset. Without details you get id, first_name, last_name and photo path; with details=true every profile field is returned keyed by field_id (slower). Filter keys are profile field_ids (see breeze_list_profile_fields) or special keys, e.g. {"tag_contains":"y_16681"} for people in a tag, or {"2000138015":"226-227"} for a Status field matching options 226 or 227. Breeze: GET /api/people.

tools.name: breeze_get_person
tools.title: Get a person
tools.description: Fetch one person's profile by id, including address and — by default — every profile field keyed by field_id, plus family members. Pair with breeze_list_profile_fields to label the field ids. Breeze: GET /api/people/{person_id}.

tools.name: breeze_list_profile_fields
tools.title: List profile fields
tools.description: The church's profile layout: sections, each with its fields (field_id, field_type, name) and, for multiple-choice fields, their options (option_id, name). Needed to read person details, to build list_people filters, and to write fields with breeze_add_person / breeze_update_person. Breeze: GET /api/profile.

tools.name: breeze_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List tags (Breeze's groups/lists) with id, name, created_on and folder_id, optionally only those in one folder. To list the people in a tag, call breeze_list_people with filter {"tag_contains":"y_<tag_id>"}. Breeze: GET /api/tags/list_tags.

tools.name: breeze_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List event instances in a date range (default: the current month), optionally on one calendar. Each row's `id` is the INSTANCE id used by attendance, volunteer and get_event tools; `event_id` is the series. Responses are cached by Breeze and may lag up to 15 minutes. Breeze: GET /api/events.

tools.name: breeze_get_event
tools.title: Get an event instance
tools.description: Fetch one event instance, optionally with the other instances in its series (then the response is an array of {id, start} only). Cached by Breeze, may lag up to 15 minutes. Breeze: GET /api/events/list_event.

tools.name: breeze_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List the church's event calendars (id, name, color and iCal feed address). The id is the category_id for breeze_list_events and breeze_add_event. Breeze: GET /api/events/calendars/list.

tools.name: breeze_list_attendance
tools.title: List attendance
tools.description: Who checked in to one event instance (person_id, check-in time created_on, check_out), optionally with each person's details, or the anonymous head count instead. Breeze: GET /api/events/attendance/list.

tools.name: breeze_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the church's online forms (id, name, url_slug, is_archived) — active ones by default, or archived ones. Breeze: GET /api/forms/list_forms.

tools.name: breeze_list_form_fields
tools.title: List form fields
tools.description: The fields of one form (field_id, field_type, name, options). Form entry responses are keyed by these field_ids. Breeze: GET /api/forms/list_form_fields.

tools.name: breeze_list_form_entries
tools.title: List form entries
tools.description: Submissions to one form (id, created_on, person_id), and with details=true each entry's responses keyed by form field_id (see breeze_list_form_fields). Breeze: GET /api/forms/list_form_entries.

tools.name: breeze_list_volunteers
tools.title: List volunteers
tools.description: Volunteers scheduled for one event instance: person_id, response, comment, rsvped_on and role_ids. Breeze: GET /api/volunteers/list.

tools.name: breeze_list_account_log
tools.title: List the account log
tools.description: The account's audit log for one action type (e.g. person_updated, tag_assign, contribution_added), optionally within a date range or by one user. Good for 'what changed since…' and incremental sync. Breeze: GET /api/account/list_log.

tools.name: breeze_list_funds
tools.title: List funds
tools.description: List giving funds (id, name, tax_deductible, is_default), optionally with the total given to each. Legacy endpoint: no longer shown on Breeze's current API reference; churches whose giving runs through Tithely may get an error. Breeze: GET /api/funds/list.

tools.name: breeze_list_contributions
tools.title: List contributions
tools.description: List recorded contributions (gifts) given within a date range, optionally narrowed by giver (with their family), amount, payment method, fund, envelope, batch or form. Read-only: this server never adds, edits or deletes gifts. Legacy endpoint: no longer shown on Breeze's current API reference; churches whose giving runs through Tithely may get an error. Breeze: GET /api/giving/list.

tools.name: breeze_add_person
tools.title: Add a person
tools.description: WRITE: create a new person profile with a first and last name, and optionally set profile fields in the same call (same field shape as breeze_update_person). Check breeze_list_people first to avoid duplicates. Returns the new profile including its id. Breeze: GET /api/people/add.

tools.name: breeze_update_person
tools.title: Update a person
tools.description: WRITE: set profile fields on an existing person — email, phone, address, dates, multiple-choice options, family role, and custom fields. Only the fields you pass change; the previous values are overwritten (read them first with breeze_get_person if you may need to restore them). field_id and option ids come from breeze_list_profile_fields. Breeze: GET /api/people/update.

tools.name: breeze_add_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: WRITE: create a new tag, at the top level or inside a folder. Returns the new tag with its id. Breeze: GET /api/tags/add_tag.

tools.name: breeze_assign_tag
tools.title: Assign a tag to a person
tools.description: WRITE: add a tag to one person (e.g. put them in a small group or list). Undo with breeze_unassign_tag. Breeze: GET /api/tags/assign.

tools.name: breeze_unassign_tag
tools.title: Remove a tag from a person
tools.description: WRITE: remove a tag from one person. The person and the tag both remain; re-assign with breeze_assign_tag. Breeze: GET /api/tags/unassign.

tools.name: breeze_add_event
tools.title: Add an event
tools.description: WRITE: create an event on the church calendar, optionally as another instance of an existing series. Times are Unix timestamps in seconds. This server cannot delete events, so a mistaken event must be removed in the Breeze app. Breeze: GET /api/events/add.

tools.name: breeze_record_attendance
tools.title: Check a person in or out
tools.description: WRITE: record attendance for one person at one event instance — check them in (default) or check them out (records when they left; checking out someone not checked in creates a record with matching in/out times). Breeze: GET /api/events/attendance/add.

tools.name: breeze_schedule_volunteer
tools.title: Schedule a volunteer
tools.description: WRITE: schedule one person as a volunteer for one event instance. Breeze: GET /api/volunteers/add.

tools.name: breeze_chms_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: breeze_chms_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Breeze ChMS tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Neon CRM
servers.description: Search Neon CRM accounts, donations, memberships and events; create accounts and activities.

tools.name: neon_get_organization_profile
tools.title: Get the organization profile
tools.description: Fetch the Neon CRM organization these credentials belong to — its name, org ID and app URL. A cheap way to confirm the org ID and API key work. Neon: GET /properties/organizationProfile.

tools.name: neon_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List constituent accounts (individuals and companies), optionally filtered by email, first or last name, or type. Returns accountId, names, email and userType. For richer queries use neon_search. Neon: GET /accounts.

tools.name: neon_get_account
tools.title: Get one account
tools.description: Fetch one account in full — returned as individualAccount or companyAccount with its primary contact, addresses, consent, custom fields, current membership status and timestamps. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: neon_list_search_fields
tools.title: List search or output fields
tools.description: Discover the field names neon_search accepts for a resource: kind=searchFields gives filterable fields with their allowed operators; kind=outputFields gives the columns you can return (standard field names plus custom fields with numeric ids). Call this before neon_search. Neon: GET /{resource}/search/searchFields or /outputFields.

tools.name: neon_search
tools.title: Search records
tools.description: Report-style search over accounts, donations (includes pledges and pledge payments), activities or events. Give filter criteria (field + operator + value), the output columns to return (standard field NAMES as strings, or custom-field IDS as integers — both from neon_list_search_fields), and 0-based pagination. Results come back as searchResults rows keyed by output field name, plus pagination totals. Neon allows only ONE concurrent search per endpoint. Neon: POST /{resource}/search.

tools.name: neon_list_account_donations
tools.title: List an account's donations
tools.description: List one account's donations (amount, date, fund, campaign, purpose, status, payments), newest first by default. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/donations.

tools.name: neon_list_account_memberships
tools.title: List an account's memberships
tools.description: List one account's membership history — level, term, start and end dates, fee, status (e.g. SUCCEEDED/FAILED) and auto-renewal. Filter to active or the primary active membership. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/memberships.

tools.name: neon_list_account_event_registrations
tools.title: List an account's event registrations
tools.description: List the event registrations one account has made, optionally for a single event. Neon: GET /accounts/{id}/eventRegistrations.

tools.name: neon_get_donation
tools.title: Get one donation
tools.description: Fetch one donation — amount, date, fund, campaign, purpose, source, tribute, soft-credit solicitor, payments and status. Neon: GET /donations/{id}.

tools.name: neon_get_membership
tools.title: Get one membership
tools.description: Fetch one membership — level, term, dates, fee, status, auto-renewal, sub-members and payments. Neon: GET /memberships/{membershipId}.

tools.name: neon_list_membership_levels
tools.title: List membership levels
tools.description: List the organization's membership levels (id, code, description, rank, type, status). Neon: GET /memberships/levels.

tools.name: neon_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List events, filterable by name, category, date window, published or archived state. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Only Neon's legacy events are exposed by the API. Neon: GET /events.

tools.name: neon_get_event
tools.title: Get one event
tools.description: Fetch one event — name, summary, dates, location, capacity, category, campaign, registration and financial settings. Neon: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: neon_list_event_registrations
tools.title: List an event's registrations
tools.description: List the registrations for one event — registrant account, tickets and attendees, amount, payments. Optionally only one registrant. Neon: GET /events/{id}/eventRegistrations.

tools.name: neon_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List fundraising campaigns (id, code, name, status). Neon: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: neon_get_campaign
tools.title: Get one campaign
tools.description: Fetch one campaign — dates, goal, fund, purpose, parent campaign, status, page URLs and fundraising statistics. Neon: GET /campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: neon_get_activity
tools.title: Get one activity
tools.description: Fetch one activity (a logged interaction or task) — subject, note, dates, linked accounts, assigned users, status and priority. Neon: GET /activities/{id}.

tools.name: neon_list_properties
tools.title: List lookup values
tools.description: List one of the organization's lookup lists — the ids other tools need: funds, purposes, sources, solicitation methods, activity statuses and system time zones (for neon_create_activity), system users, individual and company types, event categories, countries, states/provinces, genders, prefixes. Neon: GET /properties/{name}.

tools.name: neon_create_account
tools.title: Create an account
tools.description: Create a constituent account: an INDIVIDUAL (a person) or a COMPANY (with company_name, plus an optional primary contact). Neon's Account Match may merge it into an existing account with the same name and email, so check neon_list_accounts by email first. Returns the new id. Neon: POST /accounts.

tools.name: neon_update_account
tools.title: Update an account
tools.description: Change an account's name, email, job title, company name or do-not-solicit / email opt-out flags. Only the fields you pass are changed (PATCH). The type must match the account (see neon_get_account). Addresses are not edited here. Neon: PATCH /accounts/{id}.

tools.name: neon_create_activity
tools.title: Log an activity
tools.description: Create an activity — log an interaction with a constituent (call, meeting, note) or schedule a task. Needs a subject, a start date, a time zone id (neon_list_properties name=systemTimezones), a status id (name=activityStatuses) and a priority; link it to accounts and assign it to system users. Returns the new id. Neon: POST /activities.

tools.name: neon_update_activity
tools.title: Update an activity
tools.description: Change an activity's subject, note, status (e.g. mark it completed) or priority. Only the fields you pass are changed (PATCH). Neon: PATCH /activities/{id}.

tools.name: neon_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: neon_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Neon CRM tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Insightly
servers.description: Read and write Insightly contacts, organisations, leads, opportunities, tasks and notes.

tools.name: insightly_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the user the API key belongs to (USER_ID, name, email, admin flag). A cheap way to confirm the key and pod are right, and to get your own id for owner fields. Insightly: GET /Users/Me.

tools.name: insightly_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users in the Insightly instance — needed to resolve OWNER_USER_ID / RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID. Insightly: GET /Users.

tools.name: insightly_list_records
tools.title: List or search records
tools.description: List records of one type — Contacts, Organisations, Leads, Opportunities, Projects, Tasks, Events or Notes — optionally filtered by one field value and/or last-updated time. With field_name + field_value (both required together) or updated_after_utc this uses GET /<Object>/Search; otherwise GET /<Object>. Field names are Insightly's UPPER_SNAKE names, e.g. EMAIL_ADDRESS, LAST_NAME, ORGANISATION_NAME, OPPORTUNITY_STATE, LEAD_RATING, or a custom field such as Industry__c.

tools.name: insightly_get_record
tools.title: Get one record
tools.description: Fetch a single Contact, Organisation, Lead, Opportunity, Project, Task, Event or Note by id, with its custom fields, tags and links. Insightly: GET /<Object>/{id}.

tools.name: insightly_list_record_activity
tools.title: List a record's notes, tasks or events
tools.description: List the Notes, Tasks or Events attached to one Contact, Organisation, Lead, Opportunity or Project — the activity history of that record. Insightly: GET /<Object>/{id}/Notes | Tasks | Events.

tools.name: insightly_search_by_tag
tools.title: Find records by tag
tools.description: List Contacts, Organisations, Leads, Opportunities or Projects carrying a tag. Insightly: GET /<Object>/SearchByTag?tagName=.

tools.name: insightly_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the sales and project pipelines (PIPELINE_ID, name, whether for opportunities or projects). Insightly: GET /Pipelines.

tools.name: insightly_list_pipeline_stages
tools.title: List pipeline stages
tools.description: List every pipeline stage (STAGE_ID, PIPELINE_ID, name, order) — map an opportunity's or project's STAGE_ID to a stage name. Insightly: GET /PipelineStages.

tools.name: insightly_list_lead_statuses
tools.title: List lead statuses
tools.description: List the lead statuses defined in the instance (LEAD_STATUS_ID, name, type). Insightly: GET /LeadStatuses.

tools.name: insightly_list_lead_sources
tools.title: List lead sources
tools.description: List the lead sources defined in the instance (LEAD_SOURCE_ID, name). Insightly: GET /LeadSources.

tools.name: insightly_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact (first_name is required). Insightly: POST /Contacts.

tools.name: insightly_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Update a contact. Only the fields you pass are changed (v3.1 partial update). Insightly: PUT /Contacts with CONTACT_ID.

tools.name: insightly_create_organisation
tools.title: Create an organisation
tools.description: Create an organisation (company). Insightly: POST /Organisations.

tools.name: insightly_update_organisation
tools.title: Update an organisation
tools.description: Update an organisation. Only the fields you pass are changed. Insightly: PUT /Organisations with ORGANISATION_ID.

tools.name: insightly_create_lead
tools.title: Create a lead
tools.description: Create a lead (last_name is required). Insightly's schema also marks lead_status_id and lead_source_id as required — get valid ids from insightly_list_lead_statuses / insightly_list_lead_sources. Insightly: POST /Leads.

tools.name: insightly_update_lead
tools.title: Update a lead
tools.description: Update a lead. Only the fields you pass are changed. Insightly: PUT /Leads with LEAD_ID.

tools.name: insightly_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: Create a sales opportunity (opportunity_name is required). Insightly: POST /Opportunities.

tools.name: insightly_update_opportunity
tools.title: Update an opportunity
tools.description: Update an opportunity's value, probability, dates, owner or details. Only the fields you pass are changed. Insightly: PUT /Opportunities with OPPORTUNITY_ID.

tools.name: insightly_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task (title is required). Insightly requires OWNER_USER_ID and COMPLETED on a task: if owner_user_id is omitted it is filled with the API key's own user (via GET /Users/Me), and completed defaults to false. Insightly: POST /Tasks.

tools.name: insightly_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Update a task — mark it completed, change due date, status, assignee or details. Only the fields you pass are changed. Insightly: PUT /Tasks with TASK_ID.

tools.name: insightly_add_note
tools.title: Add a note to a record
tools.description: Add a note (title + body) to a Contact, Organisation, Lead, Opportunity or Project. Insightly: POST /<Object>/{id}/Notes.

tools.name: insightly_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: insightly_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Insightly tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Bookeo
servers.description: Check Bookeo availability and manage bookings, holds and customers; read payments.

tools.name: bookeo_get_api_key_info
tools.title: Get API key info
tools.description: Show which Bookeo account the credentials belong to and which permissions were granted (e.g. bookings_rw_all, customers_r_all, availability_r). A cheap way to confirm the setup works. Bookeo: GET /settings/apikeyinfo.

tools.name: bookeo_get_business
tools.title: Get the business
tools.description: Get the business's name, contact details, address, website and description. Bookeo: GET /settings/business.

tools.name: bookeo_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the bookable products (tours, classes, courses, appointments) with their ids, type (fixed, fixedCourse, flexibleTime), duration, participant limits per people category, default rates and options. Bookeo: GET /settings/products.

tools.name: bookeo_list_people_categories
tools.title: List people categories
tools.description: List the participant categories the account uses (default Adults/Children/Infants plus custom ones like Students), with their ids and seats taken. Needed for peopleNumbers. Bookeo: GET /settings/peoplecategories.

tools.name: bookeo_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List resource types and their resources (guides, instructors, rooms, boats...) with ids. Bookeo: GET /settings/resources.

tools.name: bookeo_get_availability_slots
tools.title: Get availability slots
tools.description: List available slots (eventId, start/end, seats available) for fixed and fixedCourse products in a time window of at most 31 days. Not for flexibleTime products — use bookeo_search_matching_slots for those. Bookeo: GET /availability/slots.

tools.name: bookeo_search_matching_slots
tools.title: Search matching slots
tools.description: Find slots that can take a given party (participant counts per category, options, resources), with an estimated price. Works for all product types, including flexibleTime appointments. Window max 31 days. To page through results pass only pageNavigationToken (+ pageNumber). Read-only. Bookeo: POST /availability/matchingslots, GET /availability/matchingslots/{pageNavigationToken}.

tools.name: bookeo_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings by start time (startTime+endTime) and/or by last change (lastUpdatedStartTime+lastUpdatedEndTime) — at least one pair is required, each spanning at most 31 days. Optionally filter by product, include canceled bookings, and expand customer/participant details. Bookeo: GET /bookings.

tools.name: bookeo_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by its booking number: product, times, participants, options, price, paid amount, status (canceled/accepted/noShow). Bookeo: GET /bookings/{bookingNumber}.

tools.name: bookeo_list_booking_payments
tools.title: List a booking's payments
tools.description: List the payments (and refunds, as negative amounts) received for one booking. Bookeo: GET /bookings/{bookingNumber}/payments.

tools.name: bookeo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers — by name, firstName, lastName or emailAddress — optionally only members/non-members or those created since a date. Bookeo: GET /customers.

tools.name: bookeo_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer: contact details, next/previous booking, number of bookings, cancellations and no-shows, membership and store credit. Bookeo: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: bookeo_list_customer_bookings
tools.title: List a customer's bookings
tools.description: List one customer's bookings, optionally between two dates. Bookeo: GET /customers/{id}/bookings.

tools.name: bookeo_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments received in a time period, optionally by payment method. Refunds are included with a negative amount. Bookeo: GET /payments.

tools.name: bookeo_get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Get one payment: amount, method, reason, received time, customer and gateway transaction id. Bookeo: GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: bookeo_create_hold
tools.title: Hold seats (price check)
tools.description: Temporarily reserve the seats/resources for a draft booking (default 300 s, max 600 s) and get the FINAL price, taxes and amount payable. The recommended step before bookeo_create_booking: pass the returned hold id as previousHoldId there. Holds expire automatically. Bookeo: POST /holds.

tools.name: bookeo_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Create a confirmed booking for an existing customer (customerId) or a new one (customer). fixed/fixedCourse products need an eventId from the availability tools; flexibleTime products take eventId or startTime. Pass previousHoldId to convert a hold. Does NOT record any payment. Reversible with bookeo_cancel_booking. Bookeo: POST /bookings.

tools.name: bookeo_update_booking
tools.title: Update a booking
tools.description: Change an existing booking — reschedule (eventId or startTime/endTime), change participant counts, options, resources or external reference. Fetches the current booking and sends it back with only your changes applied (Bookeo's PUT takes the full booking). Bookeo: GET then PUT /bookings/{bookingNumber}.

tools.name: bookeo_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking. It stays in the system (visible with includeCanceled) but frees its seats. The account's cancellation policy is NOT applied, so no cancellation fee is charged. Bookeo: DELETE /bookings/{bookingNumber}.

tools.name: bookeo_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer record. Not needed before booking — bookeo_create_booking can create the customer inline. Bookeo: POST /customers.

tools.name: bookeo_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Update a customer's contact details. Fetches the current record and sends it back with only your changes applied (Bookeo's PUT takes the full customer). Bookeo: GET then PUT /customers/{id}.

tools.name: bookeo_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: bookeo_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Bookeo tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Bloomerang
servers.description: Search Bloomerang constituents and donations; log interactions, notes and tasks.

tools.name: bloomerang_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the Bloomerang user the API key belongs to — name, email and permission level. A cheap way to confirm the key works and see what it may do. Bloomerang: GET /user/current.

tools.name: bloomerang_search_constituents
tools.title: Search constituents
tools.description: Full-text search across constituents (individuals and organizations) and households by name, email, etc. Start here to find a donor's Id. Bloomerang: GET /constituents/search.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_constituents
tools.title: List constituents
tools.description: List constituents with filters — by Id, type, favorites, last-modified date, or a custom field value — and sorting. Good for syncing recent changes. Bloomerang: GET /constituents.

tools.name: bloomerang_get_constituent
tools.title: Get one constituent
tools.description: Fetch one constituent's full profile — names, primary and secondary contact details, household, communication preferences, engagement score and custom values. Bloomerang: GET /constituent/{id}.

tools.name: bloomerang_get_constituent_timeline
tools.title: Get a constituent's timeline
tools.description: The activity timeline for a constituent — gifts, interactions, notes, tasks and more, newest first. Pass a household Id to get the timeline of every member. Bloomerang: GET /constituent/{id}/timeline.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_constituent_relationships
tools.title: List a constituent's relationships
tools.description: Relationships between this constituent and others (spouse, employer, board member ...), with the role on each side. Bloomerang: GET /constituent/{id}/relationships.

tools.name: bloomerang_get_household
tools.title: Get one household
tools.description: Fetch a household — its names, head of household (HeadId) and member constituent Ids. A constituent's HouseholdId points here. Bloomerang: GET /household/{id}.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions (gifts)
tools.description: List transactions — donations, pledges, pledge payments, recurring donations and their payments — with their designations (fund, campaign, appeal). Filter by constituent, amount range, type or last-modified date. Read only. Bloomerang: GET /transactions.

tools.name: bloomerang_get_transaction
tools.title: Get one transaction
tools.description: Fetch one transaction with its payment method, amounts, refund status and every designation (fund, campaign, appeal, tribute, acknowledgement status). Bloomerang: GET /transaction/{id}.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_funds
tools.title: List funds
tools.description: List the funds gifts can be designated to (e.g. General Operating, Scholarship). Bloomerang: GET /funds.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List fundraising campaigns with their goals and dates. Bloomerang: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_appeals
tools.title: List appeals
tools.description: List appeals — the specific asks (a year-end letter, a gala invitation) that gifts are attributed to. Bloomerang: GET /appeals.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_interactions
tools.title: List interactions
tools.description: List logged interactions (calls, emails, meetings, letters ...) — filter by constituent, channel or purpose. Bloomerang: GET /interactions.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally for specific constituents. Bloomerang: GET /notes.

tools.name: bloomerang_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (follow-ups) — filter by status, due-date range, assignee user, constituent, channel or purpose. Bloomerang: GET /tasks.

tools.name: bloomerang_create_constituent
tools.title: Create a constituent
tools.description: WRITE: create a new individual or organization constituent. For an individual give first_name/last_name; for an organization give full_name. Search first (bloomerang_search_constituents) to avoid creating a duplicate donor. Bloomerang: POST /constituent.

tools.name: bloomerang_update_constituent
tools.title: Update a constituent
tools.description: WRITE: update fields on an existing constituent's profile (names, job, status, primary address/email/phone). Only the fields you supply are sent. Bloomerang: PUT /constituent/{id}.

tools.name: bloomerang_create_interaction
tools.title: Log an interaction
tools.description: WRITE: log an interaction with a constituent — a call, email, meeting, letter, etc. — on their timeline. Bloomerang: POST /interaction.

tools.name: bloomerang_create_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a constituent's record. Bloomerang: POST /note.

tools.name: bloomerang_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: create a follow-up task, optionally tied to a constituent and assigned to a user (find user Ids via bloomerang_get_current_user or existing tasks). Bloomerang: POST /task.

tools.name: bloomerang_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: bloomerang_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Bloomerang tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Together AI
servers.description: Run Together AI chat, embeddings and images; manage fine-tunes, batches and endpoints.

tools.name: together_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Identify the API key: its organization, project and project slug. The project slug forms the `<project_slug>/<endpoint_slug>` model name for dedicated-endpoint inference. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Together: GET /whoami.

tools.name: together_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List Together's models with type (chat, language, code, image, embedding, moderation, rerank), context length, organization, license and per-token pricing. Together: GET /models.

tools.name: together_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List uploaded data files (fine-tune, eval and batch-api inputs, plus job outputs) with size, type, purpose and validation status. Together: GET /files.

tools.name: together_get_file
tools.title: Get one file
tools.description: Fetch one file's metadata, including its processing_status and validation_report (why a fine-tune training file was rejected). Together: GET /files/{id}.

tools.name: together_list_fine_tunes
tools.title: List fine-tuning jobs
tools.description: List fine-tuning jobs with status, base model, output model name and training settings. Together: GET /fine-tunes.

tools.name: together_get_fine_tune
tools.title: Get one fine-tuning job
tools.description: Fetch one fine-tuning job: status, progress, hyperparameters, token counts, cost and the output model name. Together: GET /fine-tunes/{id}.

tools.name: together_list_fine_tune_events
tools.title: List a fine-tuning job's events
tools.description: List the event log of one fine-tuning job (queued, started, checkpoint saved, epoch completed, errors). The first place to look when a job failed. Together: GET /fine-tunes/{id}/events.

tools.name: together_list_batches
tools.title: List batch jobs
tools.description: List batch inference jobs with status, progress, model and input/output/error file ids. Together: GET /batches.

tools.name: together_get_batch
tools.title: Get one batch job
tools.description: Fetch one batch job: status (VALIDATING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED), progress, and the output_file_id / error_file_id once done. Together: GET /batches/{id}.

tools.name: together_list_endpoints
tools.title: List endpoints
tools.description: List endpoints with model, owner and state (PENDING, STARTING, STARTED, STOPPING, STOPPED, ERROR). Use mine=true and type=dedicated to see what is running on your account and billing by the minute. Together: GET /endpoints.

tools.name: together_get_endpoint
tools.title: Get one endpoint
tools.description: Fetch one dedicated endpoint: state, model, hardware, autoscaling bounds and display name. Together: GET /endpoints/{endpointId}.

tools.name: together_list_hardware
tools.title: List hardware
tools.description: List hardware configurations for dedicated endpoints with GPU type/count/memory and price in cents per minute. Pass a model to get only compatible configurations with live availability. Together: GET /hardware.

tools.name: together_list_evaluations
tools.title: List evaluation jobs
tools.description: List LLM-as-a-judge evaluation jobs (classify, score, compare) with status, parameters and results once completed. Together: GET /evaluation.

tools.name: together_chat_completion
tools.title: Chat completion
tools.description: Run a chat completion on a Together model (billed per token). Non-streaming. For a dedicated endpoint pass its `<project_slug>/<endpoint_slug>` as the model. Together: POST /chat/completions.

tools.name: together_create_embeddings
tools.title: Create embeddings
tools.description: Generate vector embeddings for one or more texts (billed per token). Together: POST /embeddings.

tools.name: together_generate_image
tools.title: Generate an image
tools.description: Generate images from a prompt (billed per image/megapixel). Returns image URLs by default rather than base64, to keep responses small. Together: POST /images/generations.

tools.name: together_create_fine_tune
tools.title: Create a fine-tuning job
tools.description: Start a fine-tuning job on an uploaded training file (billed per token processed). Stop it with together_cancel_fine_tune. Together: POST /fine-tunes.

tools.name: together_cancel_fine_tune
tools.title: Cancel a fine-tuning job
tools.description: Cancel a running fine-tuning job. Cannot be resumed, but a new job can continue from its last checkpoint via from_checkpoint. Together: POST /fine-tunes/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: together_create_batch
tools.title: Create a batch job
tools.description: Start an asynchronous batch job over an uploaded JSONL input file (purpose batch-api), at a discount to real-time inference. Together: POST /batches.

tools.name: together_cancel_batch
tools.title: Cancel a batch job
tools.description: Cancel a batch job that has not finished. Together: POST /batches/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: together_create_endpoint
tools.title: Create a dedicated endpoint
tools.description: Deploy a model on dedicated GPUs. The endpoint STARTS AUTOMATICALLY and bills per minute of uptime until stopped — set inactive_timeout to auto-stop it, and use together_list_hardware for valid hardware ids. Together: POST /endpoints.

tools.name: together_start_endpoint
tools.title: Start a dedicated endpoint
tools.description: Start a stopped dedicated endpoint. It bills per minute of uptime until stopped. Reversible with together_stop_endpoint. Together: PATCH /endpoints/{endpointId} with state=STARTED.

tools.name: together_stop_endpoint
tools.title: Stop a dedicated endpoint
tools.description: Stop a running dedicated endpoint, which stops its per-minute billing. Requests to it fail until it is started again. Together: PATCH /endpoints/{endpointId} with state=STOPPED.

tools.name: together_ai_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: together_ai_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Together AI tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Eventbrite
servers.description: Manage Eventbrite events, ticket classes, venues and discounts; read attendees, orders and reports.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_me
tools.title: Get my user
tools.description: Fetch the Eventbrite user the token belongs to (name, emails). A cheap way to confirm the token works. Eventbrite: GET /users/me/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_organizations
tools.title: List my organizations
tools.description: List the organizations you are a member of. Almost every other tool needs an organization_id from here. Eventbrite: GET /users/me/organizations/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_events
tools.title: List an organization's events
tools.description: List the events of an organization, filterable by status, name and past/upcoming. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/events/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_event
tools.title: Get an event
tools.description: Fetch one event: name, summary, start/end, status, capacity, venue_id, listing settings. Use expand=venue,ticket_classes for more. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_event_description
tools.title: Get an event's full description
tools.description: Fetch the fully rendered HTML description of an event (summary plus the page modules). Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/description/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_ticket_classes
tools.title: List an event's ticket classes
tools.description: List the ticket types of an event with price, capacity, quantity_sold and sales window. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_venues
tools.title: List an organization's venues
tools.description: List the saved venues of an organization, with address and capacity. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/venues/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_attendees
tools.title: List attendees
tools.description: List attendees (one per sold ticket) of one event OR of all of an organization's events. Each attendee carries checked_in, cancelled, refunded, status, ticket_class_name, profile and barcodes (status unused/used). Pass exactly one of event_id / organization_id. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/attendees/ or GET /organizations/{organization_id}/attendees/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_attendee
tools.title: Get an attendee
tools.description: Fetch one attendee of an event, including check-in state (checked_in, barcodes[].status), answers and cost breakdown. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/attendees/{attendee_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders of one event OR of all of an organization's events: buyer name/email, status, costs. Pass exactly one of event_id / organization_id. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/orders/ or GET /organizations/{organization_id}/orders/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Fetch one order. Use expand=attendees,event to include its tickets and event. Eventbrite: GET /orders/{order_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_discounts
tools.title: List discounts
tools.description: Search an organization's discounts and access codes, with quantity_sold. scope=event needs event_id; multi_events = cross-event discounts; user = all of the organization's. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/discounts/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_capacity
tools.title: Get an event's capacity
tools.description: Fetch the event capacity tier: capacity_total, capacity_sold, capacity_pending, quantity_total and capacity holds. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/capacity_tier/.

tools.name: eventbrite_list_inventory_tiers
tools.title: List an event's inventory tiers
tools.description: List the inventory tiers of a tiered or reserved-seating event, with quantity_total, quantity_sold, quantity_pending and linked ticket_class_ids. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/inventory_tiers/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_sales_report
tools.title: Get a sales report
tools.description: Sales report for one or more events: gross, net, fees, royalty and quantity per time bucket, optionally grouped (by ticket, payment method, country, ...). Eventbrite: GET /reports/sales/.

tools.name: eventbrite_get_attendee_report
tools.title: Get an attendee report
tools.description: Attendee report for one or more events: number of attendees and orders per time bucket, optionally grouped. Eventbrite: GET /reports/attendees/.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_event
tools.title: Create a draft event
tools.description: Create a new event as a DRAFT (not visible or on sale until eventbrite_publish_event). Add tickets with eventbrite_create_ticket_class before publishing. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{organization_id}/events/.

tools.name: eventbrite_update_event
tools.title: Update an event
tools.description: Change fields of an existing event; only the fields you pass are sent. Changing start/end needs timezone too. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_copy_event
tools.title: Copy an event
tools.description: Duplicate an event (tickets, payment options, refund policy, tax settings) into a new event with a new ID, optionally with a new name and dates. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/copy/.

tools.name: eventbrite_publish_event
tools.title: Publish an event
tools.description: Make a draft event live so tickets go on sale. Needs a name, organizer, at least one ticket class and valid payment options. Undo with eventbrite_unpublish_event while there are no orders. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/publish/.

tools.name: eventbrite_unpublish_event
tools.title: Unpublish an event
tools.description: Take a published event back to unpublished. Only allowed while it has no pending or completed orders (or, for paid events, once completed and paid out). Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/unpublish/.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_ticket_class
tools.title: Create a ticket class
tools.description: Add a ticket type to an event. Paid: set cost like "USD,2500" and capacity. Free: free=true and capacity. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/.

tools.name: eventbrite_update_ticket_class
tools.title: Update a ticket class
tools.description: Change a ticket type (name, price, capacity, sales window, visibility); only the fields you pass are sent. The price cannot change after tickets are sold. Eventbrite: POST /events/{event_id}/ticket_classes/{ticket_class_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_venue
tools.title: Create a venue
tools.description: Save a new venue under an organization, to use as an event's venue_id. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{organization_id}/venues/.

tools.name: eventbrite_create_discount
tools.title: Create a discount or access code
tools.description: Create a promo code (type=coded), a public discount (type=public, single event) or an access code that unlocks hidden tickets (type=access). Scope: event_id (+ticket_class_ids) for one event, ticket_group_id for a group, neither for all the organization's events. Eventbrite: POST /organizations/{organization_id}/discounts/.

tools.name: eventbrite_update_discount
tools.title: Update a discount
tools.description: Change a discount or access code (amount, uses, dates, scope); only the fields you pass are sent. Eventbrite: POST /discounts/{discount_id}/.

tools.name: eventbrite_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: eventbrite_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Eventbrite tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Less Annoying CRM
servers.description: Read and write Less Annoying CRM contacts, notes, tasks, events, pipelines and groups.

tools.name: lacrm_get_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the user who owns this API key — UserId, name, email and timezone. A cheap way to confirm the key works, and the UserId to use for AssignedTo. LACRM: GetUser.

tools.name: lacrm_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users on the account that you can see (admins see all), with their UserIds — needed to assign contacts, tasks or filter by owner. LACRM: GetUsers.

tools.name: lacrm_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts and companies
tools.description: Search (or list) contacts and companies. With no search_terms, returns everything visible, paged. Returns { HasMoreResults, Results }. LACRM: GetContacts.

tools.name: lacrm_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact or company
tools.description: Fetch one contact or company record with all its fields (emails, phones, addresses, custom fields, owner). LACRM: GetContact.

tools.name: lacrm_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes, newest first by default — across the whole CRM, or for one contact. Filter by date range and author. LACRM: GetNotes.

tools.name: lacrm_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks due in a date range, optionally only incomplete/complete, for given users. If contact_id is given, ALL of that contact's tasks are returned regardless of dates or status. LACRM: GetTasks.

tools.name: lacrm_list_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List calendar events in a date range, filterable by user or calendar. If contact_id is given, all events attached to that contact are returned and other filters are ignored. LACRM: GetEvents.

tools.name: lacrm_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the account's pipelines (e.g. Sales Leads) with their statuses (StatusId, Name, IsActive) and optionally their custom fields. This is the setup, not the items — use lacrm_list_pipeline_items for those. LACRM: GetPipelines.

tools.name: lacrm_list_pipeline_items
tools.title: List pipeline items
tools.description: List the items in one pipeline (deals, leads...), optionally only in given statuses or for given users. An empty status filter returns items in all ACTIVE statuses. LACRM: GetPipelineItems.

tools.name: lacrm_get_contact_pipeline_items
tools.title: Get a contact's pipeline items
tools.description: All pipeline items attached to one contact or company, grouped by pipeline. LACRM: GetPipelineItemsAttachedToContact.

tools.name: lacrm_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the contact groups you can see (GroupId, Name, Sharing, Color), optionally with member counts. LACRM: GetGroups.

tools.name: lacrm_list_contacts_in_group
tools.title: List contacts in a group
tools.description: List the contacts that are members of one group. Identify the group by group_id (preferred) or group_name — not both. LACRM: GetContactsInGroup.

tools.name: lacrm_get_contact_groups
tools.title: Get a contact's groups
tools.description: List the groups one contact or company belongs to. LACRM: GetGroupsAttachedToContact.

tools.name: lacrm_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the account's field definitions (name, type, options) for contacts, companies or pipelines — use the Name values as keys in custom_fields when creating/editing contacts. LACRM: GetCustomFields.

tools.name: lacrm_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact or company
tools.description: Create a new contact (person) or company record. For a person, company_name links them to that company (creating it if needed). Company names must be unique. If assigned_to is omitted, the record is assigned to the API key's own user (one extra GetUser call). Returns { ContactId }. LACRM: CreateContact.

tools.name: lacrm_edit_contact
tools.title: Edit a contact or company
tools.description: Update fields on an existing contact or company. Only the fields you pass change; omitted fields are left alone. Multi-value fields (email, phone, address, website) are REPLACED by the list you pass. Set is_company=true when renaming a company. LACRM: EditContact.

tools.name: lacrm_create_note
tools.title: Add a note to a contact
tools.description: Attach a plain-text note to a contact or company's history (newlines kept, HTML/markdown escaped). Returns { NoteId }. LACRM: CreateNote.

tools.name: lacrm_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a to-do on a user's task list (date only, no time — use lacrm_create_event for timed things). Optionally attach it to a contact. Returns { TaskId }. LACRM: CreateTask.

tools.name: lacrm_edit_task
tools.title: Edit or complete a task
tools.description: Update a task — including marking it complete (is_complete=true) or re-opening it (false). Only passed fields change. LACRM: EditTask.

tools.name: lacrm_create_event
tools.title: Schedule a calendar event
tools.description: Create a timed (or all-day) event on your calendar, optionally with contacts/users as attendees. The timezone of start_date becomes the event's timezone. Returns { EventId }. LACRM: CreateEvent.

tools.name: lacrm_create_pipeline_item
tools.title: Add a contact to a pipeline
tools.description: Create a pipeline item (deal, lead...) on a contact in a given pipeline and status, with an optional note. Returns { PipelineItemId }. LACRM: CreatePipelineItem.

tools.name: lacrm_update_pipeline_item
tools.title: Move or annotate a pipeline item
tools.description: Move a pipeline item to another status (e.g. Prospect → Won) and/or add a note to its history. LACRM: EditPipelineItem.

tools.name: lacrm_add_contact_to_group
tools.title: Add a contact to a group
tools.description: Add a contact or company to a group (creates a group membership). Identify the group by group_id (preferred) or group_name — not both. LACRM: CreateGroupMembership.

tools.name: lacrm_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: lacrm_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Less Annoying CRM tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Workiz
servers.description: Manage Workiz jobs and leads: create, update, assign team members and convert leads to jobs.

tools.name: workiz_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs, most recently scheduled first (sorted by JobDateTime, descending). Filter by start date, open-only, and status; page with offset/records (max 100). Without start_date Workiz returns the last 14 days. Workiz: GET /job/all/.

tools.name: workiz_get_job
tools.title: Get one job
tools.description: Fetch one job by UUID: schedule, status, client contact and address, totals and amount due, notes, tags and assigned team. Workiz: GET /job/get/{UUID}/.

tools.name: workiz_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List leads, most recent first (sorted by LeadDateTime, descending). Filter by start date, open-only, and status; page with offset/records (max 100). Workiz: GET /lead/all/.

tools.name: workiz_get_lead
tools.title: Get one lead
tools.description: Fetch one lead by UUID: schedule, status, client contact and address, source, notes and assigned team. Workiz: GET /lead/get/{UUID}/.

tools.name: workiz_list_team
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the account's active team members: id, name, role, whether they are a field tech, email, service areas and skills. Use the name to assign people to jobs or leads. Workiz: GET /team/all/.

tools.name: workiz_get_team_member
tools.title: Get one team member
tools.description: Fetch one team member by user id: name, role, field-tech flag, email, service areas, skills and active status. Workiz: GET /team/get/{USER_ID}.

tools.name: workiz_list_time_off
tools.title: List upcoming time off
tools.description: List FUTURE time off (start, end, userName — 'Entire Business' for company-wide closures). Set all=true to include every user and company time off. Useful before scheduling. Workiz: GET /TimeOff/get/.

tools.name: workiz_get_user_time_off
tools.title: Get a team member's time off
tools.description: List one team member's FUTURE time off, by their name. Workiz: GET /TimeOff/get/{USER_NAME}.

tools.name: workiz_create_job
tools.title: Create a job
tools.description: WRITE: create a new job (schedule, client contact and address, type, source, notes). Returns the new job's UUID, ClientId and app link. Workiz: POST /job/create/.

tools.name: workiz_update_job
tools.title: Update a job
tools.description: WRITE: update fields on an existing job — status/sub-status, reschedule (JobDateTime/JobEndDateTime), contact, address, type, source, notes, tags. Only the fields you pass are sent. Workiz: POST /job/update/.

tools.name: workiz_assign_job
tools.title: Assign a team member to a job
tools.description: WRITE: assign a team member (by name) to a job. Reversible with workiz_unassign_job. Workiz: POST /job/assign/.

tools.name: workiz_unassign_job
tools.title: Unassign a team member from a job
tools.description: WRITE: remove a team member (by name) from a job. Reversible with workiz_assign_job. Workiz: POST /job/unassign/.

tools.name: workiz_create_lead
tools.title: Create a lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a new lead (client contact and address, requested time, job type, source, notes). Returns the new lead's UUID, ClientId and app link. Workiz: POST /lead/create/.

tools.name: workiz_update_lead
tools.title: Update a lead
tools.description: WRITE: update fields on an existing lead — status, schedule, contact, address, type, source, notes, tags. Only the fields you pass are sent. Workiz: POST /lead/update/.

tools.name: workiz_assign_lead
tools.title: Assign a team member to a lead
tools.description: WRITE: assign a team member (by name) to a lead. Reversible with workiz_unassign_lead. Workiz: POST /lead/assign/.

tools.name: workiz_unassign_lead
tools.title: Unassign a team member from a lead
tools.description: WRITE: remove a team member (by name) from a lead. Reversible with workiz_assign_lead. Workiz: POST /lead/unassign/.

tools.name: workiz_convert_lead_to_job
tools.title: Convert a lead to a job
tools.description: WRITE (no API undo): convert a lead into a job. Creates a new job from the lead and returns its UUID and link; the API cannot reverse the conversion. Workiz: POST /lead/convert/.

tools.name: workiz_mark_lead_lost
tools.title: Mark a lead as lost
tools.description: WRITE: mark a lead as lost. Reversible with workiz_activate_lead. Workiz: POST /lead/markLost/{UUID}/.

tools.name: workiz_activate_lead
tools.title: Reactivate a lost lead
tools.description: WRITE: change a lost lead back to active. Workiz: POST /lead/activate/{UUID}/.

tools.name: workiz_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: workiz_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Workiz tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Depot
servers.description: Inspect Depot builds, CI runs, job logs and Actions runners; retry or cancel CI runs.

tools.name: depot_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the organization's Depot projects. A project is an isolated container-build cache (region, hardware, cache policy). Use the returned projectId with the build and registry tools. Depot: ProjectService/ListProjects.

tools.name: depot_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one Depot project — name, region, hardware size, cache policy, build timeout and autoscaling. Depot: ProjectService/GetProject.

tools.name: depot_list_builds
tools.title: List builds for a project
tools.description: List container builds in a project, newest first: status (STATUS_RUNNING / FAILED / SUCCESS / ERROR / CANCELED), timestamps, build duration, time saved by cache, and cached vs total steps. Depot: core BuildService/ListBuilds.

tools.name: depot_get_build
tools.title: Get a build
tools.description: Get one container build's status, timestamps, duration, time saved and cached/total step counts. Depot: core BuildService/GetBuild.

tools.name: depot_get_build_steps
tools.title: List a build's steps
tools.description: List the BuildKit steps of a container build: name, digest, start/end time, cache state (CACHED / UNCACHED), any error, and whether it has logs. Find the failing step here, then pass its digest to depot_get_build_step_logs. Depot: build.v1 BuildService/GetBuildSteps.

tools.name: depot_get_build_step_logs
tools.title: Get a build step's logs
tools.description: Get the log lines (message + timestamp) of one container-build step, identified by its digest from depot_get_build_steps. Depot: build.v1 BuildService/GetBuildStepLogs.

tools.name: depot_list_registry_images
tools.title: List registry images
tools.description: List the images stored in a project's Depot Registry: tag, digest, pushedAt and sizeBytes. Depot: build.v1 RegistryService/ListImages.

tools.name: depot_get_usage
tools.title: Get organization usage
tools.description: Get the organization's Depot usage over a window: container builds per project (build count, minutes saved, minutes billed), GitHub Actions jobs per repo/workflow/runner (minutes elapsed and billed), storage, and agent sandboxes. Depot: UsageService/GetUsage.

tools.name: depot_ci_list_runs
tools.title: List Depot CI runs
tools.description: List Depot CI runs, newest first. Filter by status (default: running + queued — pass ["failed"] to find failures), repo, commit SHA prefix, trigger event, or pull request number (requires repo). Depot: CIService/ListRuns.

tools.name: depot_ci_get_run_status
tools.title: Get a CI run's status tree
tools.description: Get a Depot CI run's status with its nested workflows, jobs and attempts (ids, keys, statuses, error messages). This is how to find the workflowId / jobId / attemptId for the log, diagnosis and retry tools. Depot: CIService/GetRunStatus.

tools.name: depot_ci_list_workflows
tools.title: List Depot CI workflows
tools.description: List Depot CI workflows across runs, newest first, with per-status job counts. Filter by name/path text, repo, status, trigger, SHA prefix or PR number. Depot: CIService/ListWorkflows.

tools.name: depot_ci_get_job
tools.title: Get a CI job
tools.description: Get one Depot CI job: status, conclusion, error message, timestamps, runner config (labels, image, CPUs, memory), matrix values, parent run/workflow context, dependencies and attempt history. Depot: CIService/GetJob.

tools.name: depot_ci_get_job_logs
tools.title: Get a CI job's logs
tools.description: Get persisted log lines for a Depot CI job attempt, oldest first (step key/name, timestamp, line number, body). Pass job_id to read the job's latest attempt, or attempt_id for a specific one — exactly one. Pass nextPageToken back as page_token for more lines. Depot: CIService/GetJobAttemptLogs.

tools.name: depot_ci_get_failure_diagnosis
tools.title: Diagnose a CI failure
tools.description: Get Depot's failure diagnosis for a CI run, workflow, job or attempt. For runs and workflows, identical failures are grouped by error fingerprint; for a job or attempt it is a focused diagnosis with evidence. Empty when no failure evidence is found. The best first call when a run failed. Depot: CIService/GetFailureDiagnosis.

tools.name: depot_gha_list_jobs
tools.title: List GitHub Actions jobs on Depot runners
tools.description: List GitHub Actions jobs that ran on Depot-managed runners, newest first: status, conclusion, runner label, requested CPU/memory, duration, billable time and GitHub URL. Defaults to the last 30 days (max window 90 days). Depot: GithubActionsService/ListGithubActionsJobs.

tools.name: depot_gha_search_logs
tools.title: Search GitHub Actions logs
tools.description: Search GitHub Actions log lines from Depot runners, newest match first (job, workflow, step, timestamp, body, lineId). Defaults to the last hour (max window 30 days). Filter by repository, workflow, runner label, action or compute id. Depot: GithubActionsService/SearchGithubActionsLogs.

tools.name: depot_gha_get_analytics
tools.title: Get GitHub Actions analytics
tools.description: Get time-bucketed GitHub Actions analytics for Depot runners: job counts (successful/failed/cancelled), failure rate, elapsed and billable seconds, average duration — as totals plus hourly or daily buckets. Defaults to the last 30 days (max 90). Depot: GithubActionsService/GetGithubActionsAnalytics.

tools.name: depot_gha_list_recommendations
tools.title: List runner-size recommendations
tools.description: List Depot's runner-size recommendations from job CPU and memory metrics: SIZE_UP when average CPU or memory reaches 90%, SIZE_DOWN when both averages stay ≤30% and peaks ≤70%, with current vs suggested size and per-minute price. Defaults to the last 30 days. Depot: GithubActionsService/ListGithubActionsRecommendations.

tools.name: depot_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: WRITE. Create a Depot container-build project (an isolated build cache). Idempotent by name: if an active project with the same name exists, that project is returned. Defaults: cache 50 GB / 14 days, hardware HARDWARE_16X32 on AWS builders. Depot: ProjectService/CreateProject.

tools.name: depot_ci_retry_job
tools.title: Retry a CI job
tools.description: WRITE — starts compute. Retry one failed or cancelled Depot CI job, plus any skipped jobs that depend on it. Fails if a dependent job already started; use depot_ci_retry_failed_jobs then. Depot: CIService/RetryJob.

tools.name: depot_ci_retry_failed_jobs
tools.title: Retry a workflow's failed jobs
tools.description: WRITE — starts compute. Retry only the failed and cancelled jobs in a Depot CI workflow, plus skipped jobs that depend on them. Jobs that succeeded are left alone. Depot: CIService/RetryFailedJobs.

tools.name: depot_ci_cancel_run
tools.title: Cancel a CI run
tools.description: WRITE — stops work in progress. Cancel a queued or running Depot CI run and all of its unfinished workflows, jobs and attempts. Cancelled jobs can be retried afterwards with depot_ci_retry_failed_jobs. Depot: CIService/CancelRun.

tools.name: depot_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: depot_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Depot tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Mindbody
servers.description: Read Mindbody classes, schedules, clients, staff and sales; book clients and appointments.

tools.name: mindbody_list_sites
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List the Mindbody sites (businesses) your developer account can access, or details for specific site ids. A cheap way to confirm the API key works. Mindbody: GET /site/sites.

tools.name: mindbody_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the business's locations (studios / branches) with address, phone and amenities. Location ids are needed to book appointments. Mindbody: GET /site/locations.

tools.name: mindbody_list_session_types
tools.title: List session types
tools.description: List the session types (the bookable kinds of class or appointment, e.g. '60-min massage') used at the site. Session type ids drive appointment availability and booking. Mindbody: GET /site/sessiontypes.

tools.name: mindbody_list_classes
tools.title: List scheduled classes
tools.description: List scheduled class occurrences in a date range — time, class description, teacher, location, capacity, booked/waitlist counts and cancellation status. Mindbody: GET /class/classes.

tools.name: mindbody_list_class_schedules
tools.title: List class schedules
tools.description: List recurring class schedules (the templates that generate class occurrences) — days, times, teacher, location and date span. Mindbody: GET /class/classschedules.

tools.name: mindbody_get_class_visits
tools.title: Get a class's visits (roster)
tools.description: Get one class with its visits — the roster of clients booked into it, with sign-in / late-cancel status. Mindbody: GET /class/classvisits.

tools.name: mindbody_list_bookable_items
tools.title: Find bookable appointment slots
tools.description: Find appointment availability — which staff can deliver the given session types, where, and in which time windows. Use before mindbody_add_appointment. Mindbody: GET /appointment/bookableitems.

tools.name: mindbody_list_staff_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List booked appointments in a date range, by staff member, client or appointment id — the appointment book. Mindbody: GET /appointment/staffappointments.

tools.name: mindbody_list_clients
tools.title: Search clients
tools.description: Search or fetch client records by name/email text or by client ids (max 20 ids) — contact details, status, alerts, home location. Requires a staff user token. Mindbody: GET /client/clients.

tools.name: mindbody_list_client_visits
tools.title: List a client's visits
tools.description: List a client's past and scheduled visits (class and appointment attendance) in a date range, optionally only unpaid ones. Mindbody: GET /client/clientvisits.

tools.name: mindbody_list_client_memberships
tools.title: List a client's active memberships
