tools.description: List a client's active memberships (auto-renewing pricing options) with remaining counts and expiry. Mindbody: GET /client/activeclientmemberships.

tools.name: mindbody_get_client_account_balances
tools.title: Get client account balances
tools.description: Get the account balance for one or more clients (what they owe or hold in credit), optionally as of a date. Mindbody: GET /client/clientaccountbalances.

tools.name: mindbody_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List staff members (instructors, practitioners). Filter by role, or find who is available for a session type at a location and time (session_type_id + location_id + start_date_time together). Without a staff token only public fields return. Mindbody: GET /staff/staff.

tools.name: mindbody_list_services
tools.title: List pricing options
tools.description: List the pricing options (services — class packs, drop-ins, intro offers) for sale at the site, with price, online price, count and expiry. Read only. Mindbody: GET /sale/services.

tools.name: mindbody_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List completed sales at the site in a date/time range — purchased items, payments and client. Read only. Mindbody: GET /sale/sales.

tools.name: mindbody_add_client_to_class
tools.title: Book a client into a class
tools.description: Book a client into a class (or onto its waiting list). Does not take payment: by default no pricing option is required; set require_payment to insist the client has a usable one on account. Undo from the Mindbody front desk. Pass test: true to validate only. Mindbody: POST /class/addclienttoclass.

tools.name: mindbody_add_appointment
tools.title: Book an appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment for a client with a staff member at a location. Find a slot first with mindbody_list_bookable_items. No card is charged; apply_payment (Mindbody's default is true) only applies a pricing option already on the client's account. Pass test: true to validate only. Requires a staff user token. Mindbody: POST /appointment/addappointment.

tools.name: mindbody_update_appointment
tools.title: Update an appointment
tools.description: Reschedule or edit an appointment (start/end time, staff, session type, notes — the only fields Mindbody lets you change) and/or move it through its status: confirm, unconfirm, arrive, unarrive, complete. Cancel and late-cancel are deliberately not offered (a late cancel can charge the client). Pass test: true to validate only. Requires a staff user token. Mindbody: POST /appointment/updateappointment.

tools.name: mindbody_add_client
tools.title: Add a client
tools.description: Create a new client record (first and last name required; the site may require more — Mindbody reports which). No card or billing data is accepted. Pass test: true to validate only. Mindbody: POST /client/addclient.

tools.name: mindbody_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Update fields on an existing client record — only the fields you pass change. No card or billing data is accepted. cross_regional_update (Mindbody default: true) also updates the client's profiles at the region's other sites. Pass test: true to validate only. Mindbody: POST /client/updateclient.

tools.name: mindbody_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: mindbody_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Mindbody tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Buildium
servers.description: Read Buildium properties, units, leases, tenants, balances and bills; manage work orders.

tools.name: buildium_list_rental_properties
tools.title: List rental properties
tools.description: List rental properties (buildings) with address, unit count, type/subtype and manager. Filter by location (city/state contains), type, subtype, status, rental owner or property ids. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals.

tools.name: buildium_get_rental_property
tools.title: Get a rental property
tools.description: Fetch one rental property by id. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals/{propertyId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_rental_units
tools.title: List rental units
tools.description: List rental units with unit number, bedrooms/bathrooms, size, market rent and whether each unit is listed or occupied. Filter by property. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals/units.

tools.name: buildium_get_rental_unit
tools.title: Get a rental unit
tools.description: Fetch one rental unit by id. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals/units/{unitId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_rental_owners
tools.title: List rental owners
tools.description: List rental owners (the landlords you manage for) with contact details, management-agreement dates and the property ids they own. Buildium: GET /v1/rentals/owners.

tools.name: buildium_list_leases
tools.title: List leases
tools.description: List leases with unit, dates, lease type/status, current tenants, rent/deposit account details and eviction flag. Filter by property, owner, unit number, tenant name, dates, lease type or status (Active/Past/Future). Buildium: GET /v1/leases.

tools.name: buildium_get_lease
tools.title: Get a lease
tools.description: Fetch one lease by id, including tenants, cosigners, account details and move-out data. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/{leaseId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_outstanding_balances
tools.title: List lease outstanding balances
tools.description: Delinquency report: leases that owe money, with aged buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days), total balance, past-due-email and eviction-pending dates. Leases with zero or credit balances are not returned. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/outstandingbalances.

tools.name: buildium_list_lease_transactions
tools.title: List lease transactions
tools.description: Read a lease's ledger: charges, payments, credits, refunds, deposits and other transactions with date, type, total amount and journal lines. Read-only — this server never posts to a ledger. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/{leaseId}/transactions.

tools.name: buildium_list_tenants
tools.title: List tenants
tools.description: List rental tenants with contact details, emergency contact, address and leases. Filter by name, email, phone, unit number, property, owner, unit ids or lease term status. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/tenants.

tools.name: buildium_get_tenant
tools.title: Get a tenant
tools.description: Fetch one rental tenant by id. Buildium: GET /v1/leases/tenants/{tenantId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_applicants
tools.title: List applicants
tools.description: List rental applicants with contact details, status and their applications. Filter by application status, unit, name, email, submission date or entity. Buildium: GET /v1/applicants.

tools.name: buildium_list_work_orders
tools.title: List work orders
tools.description: List work orders with title, status, priority, due date, vendor, amount, line items, linked task and bill ids. Filter by entity, status, priority, task type, unit, vendor, assignee, dates, amount, billed flag or title. Buildium: GET /v1/workorders.

tools.name: buildium_get_work_order
tools.title: Get a work order
tools.description: Fetch one work order by id. Buildium: GET /v1/workorders/{workOrderId}.

tools.name: buildium_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List all tasks/requests — contact requests, resident requests, rental owner requests and to-dos — with category, property, unit, requester, assignee, status, priority and due date. Buildium: GET /v1/tasks.

tools.name: buildium_list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: List vendors (contractors, suppliers) with contact details, category, insurance and default expense GL account. Filter by name, email, phone, website, status or insurance expiration. Buildium: GET /v1/vendors.

tools.name: buildium_list_bills
tools.title: List bills
tools.description: List vendor bills (accounts payable) with dates, memo, vendor, linked work order, reference number, approval status and lines. Read-only. Buildium: GET /v1/bills.

tools.name: buildium_list_gl_accounts
tools.title: List general ledger accounts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts: GL accounts with number, name, type/subtype, sub-accounts and bank/credit-card flags. Useful for finding the gl_account_id for work order line items. Buildium: GET /v1/glaccounts.

tools.name: buildium_list_associations
tools.title: List associations
tools.description: List community/HOA associations with address, manager, reserve, fiscal year and operating bank account. Buildium: GET /v1/associations.

tools.name: buildium_create_work_order
tools.title: Create a work order
tools.description: Create a work order for a vendor. Attach it to an existing task (task_id) or create a new task with it (task: title, priority, status, assigned staff user, optional due date/property/unit). vendor_id and entry_allowed are required. Line items are optional (quantity x unit price, optional GL account). Buildium: POST /v1/workorders.

tools.name: buildium_update_work_order
tools.title: Update a work order
tools.description: Update a work order's details. Buildium's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the current work order first and only changes the fields you pass — everything else (including line items and entry contacts) is preserved. Passing line_items REPLACES all existing line items. Status/priority/due date live on the linked task. Buildium: GET then PUT /v1/workorders/{workOrderId}.

tools.name: buildium_create_todo_task
tools.title: Create a to-do task
tools.description: Create an internal to-do task assigned to a staff user, optionally tied to a property/unit and category, with a due date. Buildium: POST /v1/tasks/todorequests.

tools.name: buildium_update_todo_task
tools.title: Update a to-do task
tools.description: Update a to-do task — change status (e.g. mark Completed), priority, assignee, due date, title or category, optionally with an update message. Buildium's PUT replaces the whole record, so this reads the current task first and only changes the fields you pass. Buildium: GET then PUT /v1/tasks/todorequests/{toDoTaskId}.

tools.name: buildium_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: buildium_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Buildium tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Housecall Pro
servers.description: Manage Housecall Pro customers, jobs, estimates and leads; schedule and dispatch jobs.

tools.name: housecall_get_company
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: Fetch the Housecall Pro company this key belongs to — name, contact details, address, time zone, service-area zip codes and (multi-location) its locations. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Housecall Pro: GET /company.

tools.name: housecall_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers, with their phone numbers, tags and addresses. `q` searches name, email, mobile number and address. Housecall Pro: GET /customers.

tools.name: housecall_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by id, including their addresses (whose ids you need to create a job or estimate). Housecall Pro: GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: housecall_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs, filterable by scheduled window, customer, assigned employees and work status. Each job carries its customer, address, notes, schedule, assigned employees and totals. Housecall Pro: GET /jobs.

tools.name: housecall_get_job
tools.title: Get one job
tools.description: Fetch a single job by id — customer, address, work status and timestamps, schedule, assigned employees, notes and totals. Housecall Pro: GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: housecall_list_job_line_items
tools.title: List a job's line items
tools.description: List the line items (services, materials, labor, discounts) on one job, with unit price, cost, quantity and amount in cents. Housecall Pro: GET /jobs/{job_id}/line_items.

tools.name: housecall_list_job_invoices
tools.title: List a job's invoices
tools.description: List the invoices raised for one job, with status, amounts, due and paid dates, items, taxes, discounts and payments. Housecall Pro: GET /jobs/{job_id}/invoices.

tools.name: housecall_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices across the company, filterable by status, customer, and created / due / paid date ranges — e.g. everything open and overdue. Amounts are in cents. Housecall Pro: GET /invoices.

tools.name: housecall_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates, filterable by scheduled window, customer, assigned employees and work status. Each carries its customer, address, schedule and options. Housecall Pro: GET /estimates.

tools.name: housecall_get_estimate
tools.title: Get one estimate
tools.description: Fetch a single estimate by id, including its options and each option's approval status. Housecall Pro: GET /estimates/{estimate_id}.

tools.name: housecall_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the company's active employees with their role, contact details and permissions. Use their ids to assign or dispatch jobs. Housecall Pro: GET /employees.

tools.name: housecall_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List leads, filterable by status (open / won / lost), customer, assigned employees, tags and lead source. Housecall Pro: GET /leads.

tools.name: housecall_get_lead
tools.title: Get one lead
tools.description: Fetch a single lead by id — its customer, address, lead source, tags, assigned employee, status and pipeline status. Housecall Pro: GET /leads/{id}.

tools.name: housecall_list_job_types
tools.title: List job types
tools.description: List the company's job types (e.g. Repair, Install, Maintenance). Use an id as job_type_id when creating a job or estimate. Housecall Pro: GET /job_fields/job_types.

tools.name: housecall_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags defined in the company. Housecall Pro: GET /tags.

tools.name: housecall_list_price_book_services
tools.title: List price book services
tools.description: List or search the price book's services — name, task number, price and cost (cents), taxable and online-booking flags; optionally with their materials and labor rates. Housecall Pro: GET /api/price_book/services.

tools.name: housecall_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a new customer, optionally with one or more addresses. Housecall Pro: POST /customers.

tools.name: housecall_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Change a customer's name, contact details, tags, lead source, notes or notification setting. Only the fields you pass are sent. Housecall Pro: PUT /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: housecall_create_customer_address
tools.title: Add an address to a customer
tools.description: Add a service address to an existing customer. Returns the address id to use when creating a job or estimate. Housecall Pro: POST /customers/{customer_id}/addresses.

tools.name: housecall_create_job
tools.title: Create a job
tools.description: Create a job for an existing customer at one of their existing addresses, optionally scheduled, assigned, tagged and with line items (prices in cents). Get address ids from housecall_get_customer. Housecall Pro: POST /jobs.

tools.name: housecall_update_job_schedule
tools.title: Reschedule a job
tools.description: Set or change a job's scheduled start/end and arrival window, optionally dispatching employees and notifying the customer and/or the pro. Jobs with more than one appointment (multi-day) cannot be rescheduled here. Housecall Pro: PUT /jobs/{job_id}/schedule.

tools.name: housecall_dispatch_job
tools.title: Dispatch a job to employees
tools.description: Set which employees a job is dispatched to. This REPLACES the current dispatch list — pass everyone who should be on the job. Housecall Pro: PUT /jobs/{job_id}/dispatch.

tools.name: housecall_add_job_note
tools.title: Add a note to a job
tools.description: Add a text note to a job. Housecall Pro: POST /jobs/{job_id}/notes.

tools.name: housecall_create_estimate
tools.title: Create an estimate
tools.description: Create an estimate for a customer with one or more options (e.g. Good / Better / Best), each with line items priced in cents. Give an existing address_id or a new address. Housecall Pro: POST /estimates.

tools.name: housecall_create_lead
tools.title: Create a lead
tools.description: Create a lead, either for an existing customer (customer_id) or with a new customer inline (customer). Optionally with an address, lead source, assigned employee, tags, note and line items priced in cents. Housecall Pro: POST /leads.

tools.name: housecall_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: housecall_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Housecall Pro tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Hostaway
servers.description: Manage Hostaway listings, reservations, calendar, guest messages, reviews and tasks.

tools.name: hostaway_list_listings
tools.title: List listings
tools.description: List the account's properties (listings) with name, address, capacity, base price, fees and check-in times. Filter by name, city, country, property type, availability for a date range and guest count, or active/archived status. Hostaway: GET /v1/listings.

tools.name: hostaway_get_listing
tools.title: Get one listing
tools.description: Fetch a single listing by id — full details including description, house rules, amenities, images, fees, taxes, cancellation policy and access info (door code, wifi). Hostaway: GET /v1/listings/{listingId}.

tools.name: hostaway_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations across all channels (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, direct…) with guest, dates, status, price and channel. Filter by listing, channel, arrival/departure window, guest name or email, unread messages, and more. Default order is newest first; for large accounts page with afterId (the id of the last reservation on the previous page). Channel ids: 2000 direct, 2018 airbnbOfficial, 2002 homeaway/Vrbo, 2005 bookingcom, 2007 expedia, 2013 bookingengine, 2019 marriott, 2020 partner, 2022 google. Hostaway: GET /v1/reservations.

tools.name: hostaway_get_reservation
tools.title: Get one reservation
tools.description: Fetch a single reservation by its Hostaway id — guest contact details, dates, guest counts, price breakdown, payment state, door code, notes, channel and cancellation policy. Hostaway: GET /v1/reservations/{reservationId}.

tools.name: hostaway_get_reservation_logs
tools.title: Get reservation change history
tools.description: The audit trail for one reservation: every field change with previous and new value, when, and by which user (most recent first). Useful for 'who changed these dates / this price?'. Hostaway: GET /v1/reservations/{reservationId}/logs.

tools.name: hostaway_get_calendar
tools.title: Get listing calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day availability and pricing for one listing over a date range: status (available, blocked, reserved, pending), nightly price, min/max stay, closed-to-arrival/departure and notes. Set includeResources to see the reservations occupying each day. Hostaway: GET /v1/listings/{listingId}/calendar.

tools.name: hostaway_calculate_price
tools.title: Quote a stay
tools.description: Calculate what a stay at a listing would cost — total price plus the component breakdown (base rate, cleaning fee, taxes, discounts). A calculation only: nothing is booked or held. Hostaway: POST /v1/listings/{listingId}/calendar/priceDetails (version 2).

tools.name: hostaway_list_conversations
tools.title: List guest conversations
tools.description: List guest conversations (the unified inbox across channels), each with its latest message and linked reservation. Filter to one reservation. Hostaway: GET /v1/conversations.

tools.name: hostaway_list_conversation_messages
tools.title: Read a conversation
tools.description: The messages in one guest conversation — body, direction (isIncoming), channel/email/SMS type, send status and timestamps. By default only sent messages; set includeScheduledMessages to also see scheduled, paused or failed ones. Hostaway: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.

tools.name: hostaway_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews
tools.description: List guest-to-host and host-to-guest reviews with rating (0-10), public review, private feedback and the host's reply. Filter by listings, reservation, type, status, rating range, dates, guest name, or whether the host has replied. Hostaway: GET /v1/reviews.

tools.name: hostaway_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List operational tasks (cleaning, maintenance, check-in/out) with assignee, status, time window and cost. Filter by reservation, status, text match, channel, or start/deadline windows. Hostaway: GET /v1/tasks.

tools.name: hostaway_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses and extras
tools.description: List expenses (negative amounts) and extras (positive amounts) recorded against listings and reservations, with date, concept, categories and the owner statements they appear on. Hostaway: GET /v1/expenses.

tools.name: hostaway_list_owner_statements
tools.title: List owner statements
tools.description: List the account's owner statements (id and name). Hostaway: GET /v1/ownerStatements.

tools.name: hostaway_get_owner_statement
tools.title: Get one owner statement
tools.description: Fetch one owner statement — the filter it was generated with (listings, date range), summary and per-reservation financial data, grand totals, expenses, and owner / property-manager details. Hostaway: GET /v1/ownerStatement/{ownerStatementId}.

tools.name: hostaway_create_reservation
tools.title: Create a reservation
tools.description: Create a new reservation on a listing (it blocks the calendar and syncs to connected channels). Only channelId 2000 (direct, the default), 2002 (homeaway) or 2020 (partner) are accepted. To price it correctly, call hostaway_calculate_price first and pass its total as totalPrice. Overbooking protection is always left on. Hostaway: POST /v1/reservations.

tools.name: hostaway_update_reservation
tools.title: Update a reservation
tools.description: Change fields on an existing reservation — guest details and counts, dates, check-in/out hours, door code, host note or comment. Send only the fields to change. The listing cannot be changed, and this tool never cancels or reprices a booking. Date changes on channel bookings may be overwritten by the channel. Hostaway: PUT /v1/reservations/{reservationId}.

tools.name: hostaway_update_calendar
tools.title: Update listing calendar
tools.description: Change availability and/or pricing for a date range on one listing, pushed to every connected channel: block (isAvailable=false) or open days, set the nightly price, min/max stay, closed-to-arrival/departure, or a note. For multi-unit listings set desiredUnitsToSell instead of isAvailable (0 blocks). Hostaway: PUT /v1/listings/{listingId}/calendar.

tools.name: hostaway_send_message
tools.title: Send a guest message
tools.description: Send a message to the guest in a conversation — it is delivered immediately and cannot be recalled. Delivered by email by default, or via the booking channel, SMS or WhatsApp. Attachments are not supported. Rate-limited by Hostaway to 30 messages per minute. Hostaway: POST /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.

tools.name: hostaway_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create an operational task — e.g. a cleaning after a checkout or a maintenance job — optionally tied to a listing and reservation, assigned to a user, with a time window, category and cost. Hostaway: POST /v1/tasks.

tools.name: hostaway_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Update a task — change its status (e.g. completed), reassign it, move its window, or add a resolution note. Send only the fields to change. Hostaway: PUT /v1/tasks/{taskId}.

tools.name: hostaway_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hostaway_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Hostaway tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Invoice Ninja
servers.description: Manage Invoice Ninja clients, invoices, quotes, expenses, tasks and projects.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients with balances and contacts, optionally searched by name, email or number. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/clients.

tools.name: invoiceninja_get_client
tools.title: Get one client
tools.description: Fetch one client by id, with contacts, address, balance and paid-to-date. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/clients/{id}.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filterable by client and payment status (paid / unpaid / overdue). status_id on each invoice: 1 draft, 2 sent, 3 partial, 4 paid, 5 cancelled, 6 reversed. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/invoices.

tools.name: invoiceninja_get_invoice
tools.title: Get one invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice by id — line items, totals, balance, dates, status and invitations. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: List quotes (estimates), filterable by client and quote status. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/quotes.

tools.name: invoiceninja_get_quote
tools.title: Get one quote
tools.description: Fetch one quote by id — line items, totals, status and the invoice it was converted to (invoice_id), if any. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/quotes/{id}.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products / services in the catalog with price, cost and default taxes. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/products.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments received, with amount, date, refunded/applied totals and the invoices each was applied to (paymentables). Read-only: this server never records or refunds payments. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/payments.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List expenses, filterable by client and invoicing/payment state. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/expenses.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: List vendors (suppliers) with contacts and address. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/vendors.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks / time entries with their time_log, duration, rate and linked client, project and invoice. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/tasks.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects with client, budgeted hours, task rate, current hours and due date. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/projects.

tools.name: invoiceninja_list_recurring_invoices
tools.title: List recurring invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoice schedules with frequency, next send date and remaining cycles. Read-only. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/recurring_invoices.

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client, optionally with contacts. Give at least a name or one contact. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/clients.

tools.name: invoiceninja_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Update a client's details; only the fields you pass change. Passing contacts replaces the contact list. Invoice Ninja: PUT /api/v1/clients/{id}.

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT invoice for a client. It is not sent or emailed — use invoiceninja_mark_invoice_sent or invoiceninja_email_invoice afterwards. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/invoices.

tools.name: invoiceninja_update_invoice
tools.title: Update an invoice
tools.description: Edit an invoice; only the fields you pass change, but line_items (if passed) replace every existing line. Does not send anything. Invoice Ninja: PUT /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: invoiceninja_mark_invoice_sent
tools.title: Mark an invoice sent
tools.description: Mark a draft invoice as sent WITHOUT emailing it. This moves it out of draft and adds its amount to the client's balance. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}/mark_sent.

tools.name: invoiceninja_email_invoice
tools.title: Email an invoice to the client
tools.description: OUTWARD-FACING: sends a real email with the invoice to the client's invited contacts, and marks the invoice sent. Cannot be unsent — confirm with the user first. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/invoices/bulk with action=email.

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_quote
tools.title: Create a quote
tools.description: Create a DRAFT quote (estimate) for a client. Nothing is emailed. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/quotes.

tools.name: invoiceninja_convert_quote_to_invoice
tools.title: Convert a quote to an invoice
tools.description: Convert a quote into a new invoice (the quote is marked converted and links to it). Returns the new invoice. Invoice Ninja: GET /api/v1/quotes/{id}/convert_to_invoice.

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_expense
tools.title: Create an expense
tools.description: Log an expense, optionally tied to a vendor, client or project and flagged to be re-invoiced. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/expenses.

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_task
tools.title: Create a task / log time
tools.description: Create a task, optionally with logged time entries, for a client or project. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/tasks.

tools.name: invoiceninja_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Create a project for a client, with an optional hourly task rate, budget and due date. Invoice Ninja: POST /api/v1/projects.

tools.name: invoiceninja_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: invoiceninja_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Invoice Ninja tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Atera
servers.description: Check devices, alerts and tickets in Atera, and open tickets, comment or resolve alerts.

tools.name: atera_get_account
tools.title: Get the account
tools.description: Fetch the Atera account this key belongs to — company name, plan, country and timezone. A cheap way to confirm the key works. Atera: GET /api/v3/account.

tools.name: atera_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers (client companies) managed in Atera, paginated. Atera: GET /api/v3/customers.

tools.name: atera_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by id — address, domain, phone, notes. Atera: GET /api/v3/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: atera_list_agents
tools.title: List agents (devices)
tools.description: List Atera agents — the managed machines — with online status, last seen, OS, hardware and logged-in user. Pass customer_id to list only one customer's devices. Atera: GET /api/v3/agents or GET /api/v3/agents/customer/{customerId}.

tools.name: atera_get_agent
tools.title: Get one agent (device)
tools.description: Fetch a single agent by its AgentID — full device inventory, online status, IPs, OS build and last reboot. Atera: GET /api/v3/agents/{agentId}.

tools.name: atera_find_agents_by_machine
tools.title: Find agents by machine name
tools.description: Find the agent(s) installed on a machine by its machine name, e.g. DESKTOP-4F2K9. Atera: GET /api/v3/agents/machine/{machineName}.

tools.name: atera_get_agent_patches
tools.title: Get an agent's patches
tools.description: List the Windows/OS patches on one device — either those still AVAILABLE (missing) or those already INSTALLED. Takes the device's DeviceGuid (from atera_list_agents / atera_get_agent), not the AgentID. Atera: GET /api/v3/agents/{deviceGuid}/available-patches or /installed-patches.

tools.name: atera_list_alerts
tools.title: List alerts
tools.description: List monitoring alerts (disk, CPU, availability, hardware...) with severity, device, customer and linked ticket. Filter by status. Atera: GET /api/v3/alerts.

tools.name: atera_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List helpdesk tickets with priority, status, type, end user, technician, SLA durations and last comments. Filter by customer and/or status. Atera: GET /api/v3/tickets.

tools.name: atera_get_ticket
tools.title: Get one ticket
tools.description: Fetch a single ticket by its TicketID. Atera: GET /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: atera_list_ticket_comments
tools.title: List a ticket's comments
tools.description: List the comment thread on one ticket — end-user and technician replies, with internal notes flagged. Atera: GET /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.

tools.name: atera_list_ticket_work_hours
tools.title: List a ticket's work hours
tools.description: List the time entries logged on one ticket — technician, start/end, billable, on-site, rate. Atera: GET /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}/workhoursrecords.

tools.name: atera_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List end-user contacts, optionally searching by whole or partial email or phone number. Atera: GET /api/v3/contacts.

tools.name: atera_list_contracts
tools.title: List contracts
tools.description: List service contracts (retainer, block hours, hourly, remote monitoring...) with their rates and billing periods. Pass customer_id for one customer's contracts. Atera: GET /api/v3/contracts or GET /api/v3/contracts/customer/{customerId}.

tools.name: atera_list_kb_articles
tools.title: List knowledge-base articles
tools.description: List knowledge-base articles with their product, keywords, section, category and ratings. Atera: GET /api/v3/knowledgebases.

tools.name: atera_create_ticket
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Open a new helpdesk ticket. Give either end_user_id (an existing contact's EndUserID) or all of end_user_first_name, end_user_last_name and end_user_email to create a new contact with it. Atera: POST /api/v3/tickets.

tools.name: atera_update_ticket
tools.title: Update a ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's title, status, type, priority, impact or assigned technician. Only the fields you pass are sent. Atera: PUT /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: atera_add_ticket_comment
tools.title: Comment on a ticket
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket, either as a technician (technician_id, with is_internal=true for a private note or false for a reply the end user sees) or on behalf of an end user (enduser_id). Atera: POST /api/v3/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.

tools.name: atera_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a new end-user contact under an existing customer (give customer_id or customer_name). Atera: POST /api/v3/contacts.

tools.name: atera_resolve_alert
tools.title: Resolve an alert
tools.description: Mark one monitoring alert as resolved. If the underlying condition persists, Atera raises it again on the next check. Atera: PUT /api/v3/alerts/{alertId}.

tools.name: atera_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: atera_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Atera tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Beds24
servers.description: Check bookings, quote stays, read guest messages and reviews, and update calendars in Beds24.

tools.name: beds24_get_token_details
tools.title: Get token details
tools.description: Check the configured Beds24 token: whether it is valid, its scopes, owner id, expiry, and whether it is restricted to one property. A cheap way to confirm setup and see which scopes are granted. Note Beds24 answers HTTP 200 with validToken=false for a bad token. Beds24: GET /authentication/details.

tools.name: beds24_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties in the account with their address, currency, check-in times and room types (roomTypes). Optional flags include texts, pictures, offers, unit details and all rooms. Requires the properties scope. Beds24: GET /properties.

tools.name: beds24_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: Search bookings by arrival/departure date range, booking or modified time, property, room, channel, status, or a free-text search over guest name, email, booking id and API reference. With NO filters Beds24 returns only upcoming bookings. `filter` shortcuts: arrivals (arriving today), departures (departing today), new (created in the last 24h), current (in-house). Guest data needs the bookings-personal scope, invoice items bookings-financial. Beds24: GET /bookings.

tools.name: beds24_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Fetch one booking by id with its invoice items, info items and additional guests. Works for any status, including cancelled. Beds24: GET /bookings?id=<id>.

tools.name: beds24_list_booking_messages
tools.title: List booking messages
tools.description: Read the guest conversation on bookings — messages from guests, host replies, internal notes and system messages — across channels (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, direct). Filter by booking, property, room, read/unread, source and age. Beds24: GET /bookings/messages.

tools.name: beds24_list_booking_invoices
tools.title: List booking invoices
tools.description: List invoices and their line items (charges and payments) for bookings. Requires the bookings-financial scope. Beds24 marks this endpoint Alpha. Beds24: GET /bookings/invoices.

tools.name: beds24_get_room_offers
tools.title: Get room offers (quote)
tools.description: Quote a stay: bookable offers with total price and units available per room for given dates and guests. Use before creating a booking. Beds24: GET /inventory/rooms/offers.

tools.name: beds24_get_room_availability
tools.title: Get room availability
tools.description: Per-date availability (true/false) for rooms over a range of nights. endDate is the LAST NIGHT (the day before check-out). Beds24: GET /inventory/rooms/availability.

tools.name: beds24_get_unit_bookings
tools.title: Get unit bookings (occupancy grid)
tools.description: Which units of each room type are booked on each date — an occupancy grid keyed by date. endDate is the last night. Beds24 marks this endpoint Beta. Beds24: GET /inventory/rooms/unitBookings.

tools.name: beds24_get_room_calendar
tools.title: Get room calendar
tools.description: Per-day calendar values for rooms: units available, min/max stay, multiplier, override (blackout, no check-in, ...) and the price slots price1..price16, as date ranges. Choose fields with the include flags; if none are set this tool asks for numAvail, minStay, maxStay, override and prices. Beds24: GET /inventory/rooms/calendar.

tools.name: beds24_list_fixed_prices
tools.title: List fixed prices
tools.description: List fixed price rules (seasonal rates): date span, min/max nights, per-room and per-person prices, discounts, allowed arrival days and channel export. Beds24: GET /inventory/fixedPrices.

tools.name: beds24_list_booking_com_reviews
tools.title: List Booking.com reviews
tools.description: Guest reviews from Booking.com for one property, made on or after a date: scores, content, reviewer and any reply. At most 100 per call. Beds24 marks this endpoint Alpha. Beds24: GET /channels/booking/reviews.

tools.name: beds24_list_airbnb_reviews
tools.title: List Airbnb reviews
tools.description: Guest reviews from Airbnb for one room: overall and category ratings, public review, private feedback and the host response. At most 100 per call. Beds24 marks this endpoint Beta. Beds24: GET /channels/airbnb/reviews.

tools.name: beds24_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Create a new booking in a room for given dates and guest details. It immediately blocks inventory and is synced to connected channels. Set checkAvailability=true to refuse the booking if the room is not free, and notifyGuest / notifyHost to send confirmation emails. Undo by setting status cancelled with beds24_update_booking. Requires a token with bookings write access. Beds24: POST /bookings.

tools.name: beds24_update_booking
tools.title: Update a booking
tools.description: Change an existing booking: dates, room/unit, guest counts, guest details, notes, flag, price, or status (e.g. confirmed, or cancelled to cancel — reversible by setting it back). Only the fields you pass change. Optionally add info items (code/text pairs). Changes sync to channels where allowed. Beds24: POST /bookings with the booking id.

tools.name: beds24_send_booking_message
tools.title: Send a booking message
tools.description: Send a message on a booking's conversation. With source host (default) it is delivered to the GUEST through their channel (Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, email) and cannot be unsent; with source internalNote it is a private host note. Beds24: POST /bookings/messages.

tools.name: beds24_mark_messages_read
tools.title: Mark messages read
tools.description: Mark one or more booking messages as read (or unread with read=false). Beds24: POST /bookings/messages with [{ id, read }].

tools.name: beds24_update_room_calendar
tools.title: Update room calendar
tools.description: Set per-day calendar values for ONE room over a date range: units available (numAvail), minStay, maxStay, multiplier, override (none, blackout, exception, noCheckIn, noCheckOut, noCheckInOrCheckOut) and price slots price1..price16. Set a price to null to remove it. These values sync to channels. Read the current values first with beds24_get_room_calendar so you can restore them. Beds24: POST /inventory/rooms/calendar.

tools.name: beds24_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: beds24_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Beds24 tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Booqable
servers.description: Browse rental orders, customers, products and availability, and create bookings in Booqable.

tools.name: booqable_get_company
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: Fetch the Booqable account this token belongs to — name, currency, default timezone, address. A cheap way to confirm the slug and token work. Booqable: GET /api/4/companies/current.

tools.name: booqable_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List rental orders. Filter by free-text search (order number, customer name/email/address, tags, custom fields), status, payment status, customer, or rental-period range. Booqable: GET /api/4/orders.

tools.name: booqable_get_order
tools.title: Get one order
tools.description: Fetch one order with its totals, deposit and payment state, sideloading the customer and order lines by default (override with include, e.g. customer,lines,payments,documents,notes). Booqable: GET /api/4/orders/{id}.

tools.name: booqable_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally searched by name/email or filtered by email, tag or archived state. Booqable: GET /api/4/customers.

tools.name: booqable_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer with order count, revenue and balance due, sideloading their properties (addresses, phone, custom fields) by default. Booqable: GET /api/4/customers/{id}.

tools.name: booqable_list_product_groups
tools.title: List product groups
tools.description: List product groups — the catalogue entries (name, SKU, product type, tracking type, pricing). A group holds one or more bookable products (variations). Booqable: GET /api/4/product_groups.

tools.name: booqable_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List bookable products (the variations inside product groups). Use a product id for availability checks and booking. Booqable: GET /api/4/products.

tools.name: booqable_check_inventory_availability
tools.title: Check inventory availability
tools.description: How many units of one or more products can be booked for an exact period at a location. Returns `available` and `plannable` (plannable can exceed available when shortage is allowed). Get location ids from booqable_list_locations. Booqable: GET /api/4/inventory_availabilities.

tools.name: booqable_get_availability_calendar
tools.title: Get a product's availability calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day availability for one product over a month: status (available/partial/unavailable) and bookable quantity per day. Booqable: GET /api/4/availabilities with subject_type=item.

tools.name: booqable_list_plannings
tools.title: List plannings
tools.description: List plannings — which product is booked on which order, how many, when, and how many are started (out) or stopped (returned). Filter by order, product, or reservation window. Booqable: GET /api/4/plannings.

tools.name: booqable_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List invoices, quotes and contracts, with totals and payment status. Filter by type, order, customer or status. Booqable: GET /api/4/documents.

tools.name: booqable_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments (charges, authorizations and refunds) with amount, deposit, currency, provider and status. Filter by order, customer or payment type. Read only — this server never moves money. Booqable: GET /api/4/payments.

tools.name: booqable_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List pickup/return locations (warehouses, stores) with address and pickup/delivery capability. Location ids are needed for availability checks and orders. Booqable: GET /api/4/locations.

tools.name: booqable_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List internal notes attached to a customer, order, product or other record. Booqable: GET /api/4/notes.

tools.name: booqable_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a new customer. Booqable: POST /api/4/customers.

tools.name: booqable_update_customer
tools.title: Update a customer
tools.description: Update a customer's name, email, legal type, tags, default discount or marketing consent. Only the fields you pass change. Booqable: PUT /api/4/customers/{id}.

tools.name: booqable_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Create an EMPTY order for a rental period (status new or draft). Then add products with booqable_book_product and reserve it with booqable_transition_order_status. Locations default to the first active location. Booqable: POST /api/4/orders.

tools.name: booqable_update_order
tools.title: Update an order
tools.description: Change an order's rental period, customer, locations or tags. Moving dates can cause a shortage: the call then fails with the shortage details, and a shortage *warning* can be accepted by retrying with confirm_shortage: true. Booqable: PUT /api/4/orders/{id}.

tools.name: booqable_book_product
tools.title: Book a product on an order
tools.description: Add a quantity of a product to an order, allocating inventory (creates a planning and a line). By default adds to an existing planning for the same product if there is one. Booqable: POST /api/4/order_fulfillments with a book_product action.

tools.name: booqable_transition_order_status
tools.title: Change an order's status
tools.description: Move an order between statuses: new→draft, draft→reserved (reserves the items and assigns an order number), stopped→archived, or back to an earlier status with revert: true. Canceling is deliberately NOT offered (Booqable cannot un-cancel). started/stopped are reached by picking up/returning items, so they are only valid here with revert: true. Booqable: POST /api/4/order_status_transitions.

tools.name: booqable_create_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: Attach an internal note to a customer, order, product or other record. Booqable: POST /api/4/notes.

tools.name: booqable_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: booqable_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Booqable tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Boulevard
servers.description: Look up appointments, clients, services, staff and orders, and update clients in Boulevard.

tools.name: boulevard_get_business
tools.title: Get the business
tools.description: Fetch the Boulevard business the credentials act for — name, timezone, address, phone, website. A cheap way to confirm the setup works. GraphQL: business.

tools.name: boulevard_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the business's locations with id, name, timezone and address. Most other tools need a location id from here. GraphQL: locations.

tools.name: boulevard_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments at one location, optionally for one client and filtered by a query such as a date range or staff member. Each appointment includes its client, services, staff, state and cancellation. GraphQL: appointments.

tools.name: boulevard_get_appointment
tools.title: Get one appointment
tools.description: Fetch one appointment by id — time, state, notes, client, each booked service with its staff and price (in cents), cancellation details and tags. GraphQL: appointment.

tools.name: boulevard_list_clients
tools.title: List or search clients
tools.description: List the business's clients, or find them by email, id list, or a query (e.g. name = 'Jane Doe', mobilePhone = '+15551234567'). GraphQL: clients.

tools.name: boulevard_get_client
tools.title: Get one client
tools.description: Fetch one client by id, including contact details, appointment count, account balance (cents), scheduling alert, tags and notes. GraphQL: client.

tools.name: boulevard_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the service menu — name, category, default duration (minutes) and default price (cents), and whether it is an add-on. GraphQL: services.

tools.name: boulevard_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List staff members with their role, locations, contact details and whether they are bookable online, optionally filtered by a query. GraphQL: staff.

tools.name: boulevard_list_shifts
tools.title: List staff shifts
tools.description: List staff working shifts at one location for a date range — clock-in/out times, weekday, availability and recurrence. GraphQL: shifts.

tools.name: boulevard_list_timeblocks
tools.title: List timeblocks
tools.description: List blocked time on staff calendars at one location (breaks, meetings, personal time). GraphQL: timeblocks.

tools.name: boulevard_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List checkout orders at one location with totals (cents: subtotal, discount, tax, gratuity, total, refunds), optionally filtered e.g. by closedAt range or clientId. GraphQL: orders.

tools.name: boulevard_get_order
tools.title: Get one order
tools.description: Fetch one order by id with its totals and line items (services, products, gratuity, gift cards), amounts in cents. GraphQL: order.

tools.name: boulevard_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List retail products — brand, SKU, barcode, unit price and cost (cents), category. Set include_inactive to include retired products. GraphQL: products.

tools.name: boulevard_list_memberships
tools.title: List memberships
tools.description: List client memberships sold by the business — status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, PAST_DUE, CANCELLED), client, price (cents), interval, term and next charge date. GraphQL: memberships.

tools.name: boulevard_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags defined for the business (ids to use with boulevard_add_tag). GraphQL: tags.

tools.name: boulevard_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a new client profile. Check boulevard_list_clients by email or phone first to avoid a duplicate. GraphQL: createClient.

tools.name: boulevard_update_client
tools.title: Update a client
tools.description: Change a client's name, email, mobile phone, date of birth, pronoun or external id. Only the fields you pass change. GraphQL: updateClient.

tools.name: boulevard_create_client_note
tools.title: Add a client note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a client's profile (visible to staff, e.g. formulas, preferences, allergies). GraphQL: createClientNote.

tools.name: boulevard_update_appointment
tools.title: Update an appointment
tools.description: Replace an appointment's internal notes and/or move its state to BOOKED, CONFIRMED, ARRIVED or ACTIVE (e.g. confirm, or check the client in). Does not cancel or reschedule. GraphQL: updateAppointment.

tools.name: boulevard_create_timeblock
tools.title: Block staff time
tools.description: Block time on one staff member's calendar at a location (a break, meeting or personal time) so it cannot be booked. One-off only. GraphQL: createTimeblock.

tools.name: boulevard_add_tag
tools.title: Apply a tag
tools.description: Apply an existing tag (from boulevard_list_tags) to a taggable record such as a client or appointment. GraphQL: addTag.

tools.name: boulevard_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: boulevard_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Boulevard tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: bunny.net
servers.description: Inspect pull zones, storage, DNS and video libraries on bunny.net, and purge caches.

tools.name: bunny_list_pull_zones
tools.title: List pull zones
tools.description: List the CDN pull zones on the account. By default returns a compact view per zone (id, name, origin URL, enabled/suspended, hostnames, linked storage zone, bandwidth and charges this month); set full=true for every setting. bunny.net: GET /pullzone.

tools.name: bunny_get_pull_zone
tools.title: Get a pull zone
tools.description: Fetch one pull zone with all its settings: origin, hostnames, caching, security, edge rules (with their GUIDs, needed by bunny_set_edge_rule_enabled), blocked IPs, limits and usage. Secrets (token-auth key, AWS signing secret, certificate private keys) are redacted. bunny.net: GET /pullzone/{id}.

tools.name: bunny_list_storage_zones
tools.title: List storage zones
tools.description: List the edge storage zones on the account: region, replication regions, storage used, file count, tier and connected pull zones. Storage passwords are redacted. bunny.net: GET /storagezone.

tools.name: bunny_get_storage_zone
tools.title: Get a storage zone
tools.description: Fetch one edge storage zone: hostname, region, replication, storage used, files stored, 404 handling and connected pull zones. Storage passwords are redacted. bunny.net: GET /storagezone/{id}.

tools.name: bunny_get_storage_zone_statistics
tools.title: Get storage zone statistics
tools.description: Daily charts of storage used and file count for one storage zone. bunny.net: GET /storagezone/{id}/statistics.

tools.name: bunny_list_dns_zones
tools.title: List DNS zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones hosted on bunny.net, with nameserver detection, DNSSEC and logging status. bunny.net: GET /dnszone.

tools.name: bunny_get_dns_zone
tools.title: Get a DNS zone
tools.description: Fetch one DNS zone with its settings and records. bunny.net: GET /dnszone/{id}.

tools.name: bunny_list_dns_records
tools.title: List DNS records
tools.description: List the records in one DNS zone, optionally filtered by type or search term. Record Type comes back as bunny.net's integer code (0=A, 1=AAAA, 2=CNAME, 3=TXT, 4=MX, 5=Redirect, 6=Flatten, 7=PullZone, 8=SRV, 9=CAA, 10=PTR, 11=Script, 12=NS, 13=SVCB, 14=HTTPS, 15=TLSA). bunny.net: GET /dnszone/{zoneId}/records.

tools.name: bunny_export_dns_zone
tools.title: Export a DNS zone
tools.description: Export one DNS zone as a BIND zone file (plain text) — handy for review, diffing or backup before a change. bunny.net: GET /dnszone/{id}/export.

tools.name: bunny_list_video_libraries
tools.title: List video libraries
tools.description: List the Stream video libraries: video count, storage and traffic usage, linked pull/storage zones and player/encoding settings. Library API keys are redacted. bunny.net: GET /videolibrary.

tools.name: bunny_get_video_library
tools.title: Get a video library
tools.description: Fetch one Stream video library with its full configuration (resolutions, DRM, referrer rules, transcribing, watermark). Library API keys are redacted. bunny.net: GET /videolibrary/{id}.

tools.name: bunny_get_statistics
tools.title: Get CDN statistics
tools.description: CDN traffic statistics for the account or one pull zone: total bandwidth, origin traffic, requests served, cache hit rate and average origin response time, plus optional charts (bandwidth, requests, origin traffic, response times, 3xx/4xx/5xx errors, geographic distribution). bunny.net: GET /statistics.

tools.name: bunny_list_regions
tools.title: List edge regions
tools.description: List bunny.net's edge regions with their IDs, codes, location and per-GB traffic price. A cheap way to confirm the API key works. bunny.net: GET /region.

tools.name: bunny_get_billing
tools.title: Get billing details
tools.description: The account balance, this month's charges broken down by product (traffic per continent, storage, DNS, Stream, scripting, Shield, ...) and recent billing records. Payment-method tokens are redacted. bunny.net: GET /billing.

tools.name: bunny_get_audit_log
tools.title: Get the audit log
tools.description: Who changed what on one day: the account audit log (timestamp, product, resource, action, actor and a diff). Paginate with continuation_token. bunny.net: GET /user/audit/{date}.

tools.name: bunny_purge_pull_zone_cache
tools.title: Purge a pull zone's cache
tools.description: WRITE. Purge the cached content of one pull zone — everything, or only files carrying a cache tag. Nothing is lost (the CDN refetches from the origin) but the origin takes the refill load. bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{id}/purgeCache.

tools.name: bunny_purge_url
tools.title: Purge a URL from cache
tools.description: WRITE. Purge one URL from the CDN cache. A URL ending in '/' purges everything under it unless exact_path is true; a '*' wildcard is also accepted. The CDN refetches from the origin. bunny.net: POST /purge.

tools.name: bunny_add_dns_record
tools.title: Add a DNS record
tools.description: WRITE. Add a record to a DNS zone. Takes effect on live DNS. bunny.net: PUT /dnszone/{zoneId}/records.

tools.name: bunny_update_dns_record
tools.title: Update a DNS record
tools.description: WRITE. Update an existing DNS record. Takes effect on live DNS. Read the record first with bunny_list_dns_records and pass its type, name and value along with any other fields you want to keep or change. bunny.net: POST /dnszone/{zoneId}/records/{id}.

tools.name: bunny_set_edge_rule_enabled
tools.title: Enable or disable an edge rule
tools.description: WRITE. Turn one edge rule on a pull zone on or off (reversible — the rule is kept). Get the rule's GUID from bunny_get_pull_zone (EdgeRules[].Guid). bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{pullZoneId}/edgerules/{edgeRuleId}/setEdgeRuleEnabled.

tools.name: bunny_add_blocked_ip
tools.title: Block an IP on a pull zone
tools.description: WRITE. Block an IP address from a pull zone (undo with bunny_remove_blocked_ip). bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{id}/addBlockedIp.

tools.name: bunny_remove_blocked_ip
tools.title: Unblock an IP on a pull zone
tools.description: WRITE. Remove an IP address from a pull zone's block list. bunny.net: POST /pullzone/{id}/removeBlockedIp.

tools.name: bunny_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: bunny_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED bunny.net tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Civo
servers.description: List Civo instances, Kubernetes clusters, networks and DNS; reboot instances, add rules.

tools.name: civo_list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the Civo regions available to the account, with which one is the default, whether each is out of capacity, and the features each supports (IaaS, Kubernetes, object store, load balancers, GPU, databases). A cheap way to confirm the API key works. Civo: GET /v2/regions.

tools.name: civo_get_quota
tools.title: Get account quota
tools.description: The account's limits and current usage: instances, CPU cores, RAM, disk, volumes, snapshots, public IPs, networks, firewalls and rules, load balancers, object storage and databases. Answers 'can I launch another one?'. Civo: GET /v2/quota.

tools.name: civo_list_charges
tools.title: List charges
tools.description: List billable usage for a period: each resource's product code, label, region, time span and hours (size_gb for volumes). The range may be at most 31 days; defaults to the start of the current month until now. Civo: GET /v2/charges.

tools.name: civo_list_instance_sizes
tools.title: List sizes
tools.description: List the sizes (plans) that can be launched — instances, Kubernetes nodes and databases — with CPU cores, RAM, disk, transfer allowance and GPU. Civo: GET /v2/sizes.

tools.name: civo_list_instances
tools.title: List instances
tools.description: List compute instances in a region, optionally filtered by tags. Paginated: returns {page, per_page, pages, items}. Passwords are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/instances.

tools.name: civo_get_instance
tools.title: Get one instance
tools.description: Fetch one instance: status, size, CPU/RAM/disk, public and private IPs, network, firewall, tags, attached volumes and source image. Passwords are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/instances/{id}.

tools.name: civo_list_kubernetes_clusters
tools.title: List Kubernetes clusters
tools.description: List the Kubernetes (K3s/Talos) clusters in a region with status, version, node pools, API endpoint and installed applications. Paginated: {page, per_page, pages, items}. Kubeconfigs are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/kubernetes/clusters.

tools.name: civo_get_kubernetes_cluster
tools.title: Get one Kubernetes cluster
tools.description: Fetch one Kubernetes cluster: status, readiness, conditions, version and available upgrade, pools and their instances, network, firewall, CNI and installed marketplace apps. The kubeconfig is redacted. Civo: GET /v2/kubernetes/clusters/{id}.

tools.name: civo_list_networks
tools.title: List networks
tools.description: List the private networks in a region: label, CIDR, whether it is the default network, status and nameservers. Civo: GET /v2/networks.

tools.name: civo_list_firewalls
tools.title: List firewalls
tools.description: List the firewalls in a region with their network, rule count and how many instances, clusters and load balancers use each. Civo: GET /v2/firewalls.

tools.name: civo_list_firewall_rules
tools.title: List a firewall's rules
tools.description: List the rules of one firewall: protocol, port range, CIDRs, direction (ingress/egress), action (allow/deny) and label — the answer to 'what is exposed to the internet?'. Civo: GET /v2/firewalls/{id}/rules.

tools.name: civo_list_load_balancers
tools.title: List load balancers
tools.description: List the load balancers in a region: algorithm, backends (IP, protocol, source/target ports), public IP, state and the Kubernetes service each fronts. Civo: GET /v2/loadbalancers.

tools.name: civo_list_volumes
tools.title: List volumes
tools.description: List the block-storage volumes in a region: size, status, type, and the instance or cluster each is attached to (unattached volumes still bill). Civo: GET /v2/volumes.

tools.name: civo_list_databases
tools.title: List databases
tools.description: List the managed databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) in a region: software and version, size, nodes, IPs, port, network, firewall and status. Paginated: {page, per_page, pages, items}. Passwords are redacted. Civo: GET /v2/databases.

tools.name: civo_list_dns_domains
tools.title: List DNS domains
tools.description: List the domains whose DNS Civo hosts for the account. Civo: GET /v2/dns.

tools.name: civo_list_dns_records
tools.title: List DNS records
tools.description: List the records of one hosted domain (name, type, value, priority, TTL), optionally filtered by type or name. Civo: GET /v2/dns/{domain_id}/records.

tools.name: civo_reboot_instance
tools.title: Reboot an instance
tools.description: Reboot one instance. `soft` (default) asks the OS to restart cleanly; `hard` cuts power and boots it again, like pulling the plug — use only when soft does not work. Causes brief downtime. Civo: POST /v2/instances/{id}/soft_reboots or /hard_reboots.

tools.name: civo_stop_instance
tools.title: Stop an instance
tools.description: Power off one instance. Anything it serves goes offline until it is started again with civo_start_instance. A stopped instance is still billed. Civo: PUT /v2/instances/{id}/stop.

tools.name: civo_start_instance
tools.title: Start an instance
tools.description: Boot a stopped instance. Undoes civo_stop_instance. Civo: PUT /v2/instances/{id}/start.

tools.name: civo_set_instance_tags
tools.title: Set an instance's tags
tools.description: REPLACE the full tag list of one instance (tags are used for filtering and by load-balancer instance pools, so changing them can move an instance in or out of a pool). Pass the complete desired list; an empty list clears all tags. Civo: PUT /v2/instances/{id}/tags.

tools.name: civo_create_firewall_rule
tools.title: Add a firewall rule
tools.description: Add one rule to a firewall — e.g. allow TCP 443 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0. This changes what is reachable on every instance, cluster and load balancer using the firewall, so prefer narrow CIDRs. Undo by deleting the rule in the Civo dashboard or CLI. Civo: POST /v2/firewalls/{id}/rules.

tools.name: civo_create_dns_record
tools.title: Add a DNS record
tools.description: Add one record to a Civo-hosted domain. Live DNS changes propagate to the world; undo by deleting the record in the Civo dashboard or CLI. Civo: POST /v2/dns/{domain_id}/records.

tools.name: civo_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: civo_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Civo tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Current RMS
servers.description: Browse opportunities, products, stock, availability and invoices, and create quotes in Current RMS.

tools.name: current_rms_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List members — Current RMS's single record type for Organisations, Contacts, Venues and Users. Free-text search covers name, street, work phone, work email and tags. Defaults to active records; filtermode can be active, inactive, all, organisation, contact, venue, user, with_pending_activities, with_live_opportunities, bookable. Current RMS: GET /members.

tools.name: current_rms_get_member
tools.title: Get one member
tools.description: Fetch one member (organisation, contact, venue or user) with its addresses, emails, phones, links, linked parent/child members and custom fields. Current RMS: GET /members/{id}.

tools.name: current_rms_list_opportunities
tools.title: List opportunities
tools.description: List opportunities — the enquiries, drafts, quotations and orders for a rental job — with their dates, state and charge totals. Free-text search covers subject, description, number, customer name and tags. filtermode e.g. live, all, inactive, enquiries, drafts, quotations, orders, invoiced, not_invoiced, needing_prep. Line items are NOT included here: use current_rms_get_opportunity or current_rms_list_opportunity_items. Max 25 per page. Current RMS: GET /opportunities.

tools.name: current_rms_get_opportunity
tools.title: Get one opportunity
tools.description: Fetch one opportunity with its dates, state (0 Enquiry, 1 Draft, 2 Quotation, 3 Order), status and charge/cost totals. Associations (customer, venue, line items, assets, participants) are only returned when named in include. Current RMS: GET /opportunities/{id}.

tools.name: current_rms_list_opportunity_items
tools.title: List an opportunity's line items
tools.description: List the line items on one opportunity — products, services and groups, with quantity, rate, discount, dates and charge totals. Current RMS: GET /opportunities/{opportunity_id}/opportunity_items.

tools.name: current_rms_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (rental and sale items) with their group, stock method, rates, weight and barcode. Free-text search covers name, product group name and tags. filtermode: active (default), inactive, all. Current RMS: GET /products.

tools.name: current_rms_get_product
tools.title: Get one product
tools.description: Fetch one product with its rates, stock settings and custom fields. Current RMS: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: current_rms_list_product_inventories
tools.title: List product inventory
tools.description: Stock snapshot per product: rental quantity held, booked, unavailable, on sub-rent and AVAILABLE, plus sale stock and prices. Pass starts_at/ends_at to compute rental availability for a job's dates instead of today, and store_id to restrict to one store. filtermode: active, inactive, all, rental, sale. Current RMS: GET /product_inventories.

tools.name: current_rms_check_product_availability
tools.title: Check a product's availability
tools.description: Rental availability for ONE product over a date range: arrays of quantity held, booked, unavailable, available, on sub-rent and quoted — one entry per availability period (hour, quarter day, half day or day depending on the range and system setting) — plus the opportunities that book it. Read-only, even though the API uses POST. Current RMS: POST /availability/product.

tools.name: current_rms_list_stock_levels
tools.title: List stock levels
tools.description: List stock levels — the individual serialised assets (asset number, serial number, location, store) or bulk stock quantities held. Pass product_id for one product's stock, or use filters such as {"asset_number_eq": "ABC-1234"} to find an asset. Current RMS: GET /stock_levels or GET /products/{product_id}/stock_levels.

tools.name: current_rms_list_stores
tools.title: List stores
tools.description: List the account's stores (warehouses/depots) with their ids and addresses — needed for store_id when creating an opportunity. Current RMS: GET /stores.

tools.name: current_rms_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices and credit notes
tools.description: List invoices and credit notes with number, dates, status and totals. Free-text search covers subject, number, description, customer name and tags. filtermode: live, inactive, all, invoices, credits. To find one opportunity's invoices pass filters {"invoice_items_source_type_eq": "Opportunity", "invoice_items_source_id_eq": <opportunity id>} with filtermode all. Current RMS: GET /invoices.

tools.name: current_rms_get_invoice
tools.title: Get one invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice or credit note with its status, due date and totals; include invoice_items for the lines. Current RMS: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: current_rms_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects — groups of related opportunities for one customer or event. Free-text search covers name, customer name and tags. filtermode: active (default), inactive, all. Current RMS: GET /projects.

tools.name: current_rms_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List activities — calls, meetings, tasks and notes logged against members, opportunities and projects. filtermode: pending, completed, all. Example filters for one person's busy time in a window: {"time_status_eq": 1, "starts_at_lt": "2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z", "ends_at_gteq": "2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z", "participants_member_id_eq": [123]}. Current RMS: GET /activities.

tools.name: current_rms_create_member
tools.title: Create a member
tools.description: Create an Organisation, Contact or Venue. To link a new Contact to its Organisation, pass parent_member_id. Current RMS: POST /members.

tools.name: current_rms_update_member
tools.title: Update a member
tools.description: Update fields on an existing member. Only the fields you pass are sent. Emails and phones passed here are ADDED (existing ones are kept). When updating custom_fields, also pass the member's membership_type. Current RMS: PUT /members/{id}.

tools.name: current_rms_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: Create an opportunity (a rental job) as an Enquiry, Draft or Quotation. store_id is required (see current_rms_list_stores); set member_id for the customer and starts_at/ends_at for the job dates. Line items are added in Current RMS. Current RMS: POST /opportunities.

tools.name: current_rms_update_opportunity
tools.title: Update an opportunity
tools.description: Update header fields on an existing opportunity — subject, customer, venue, dates, reference, instructions, tags, custom fields. Only the fields you pass are sent. State changes (convert to quote/order, cancel, mark lost) are deliberately not available. Current RMS: PUT /opportunities/{id}.

tools.name: current_rms_create_activity
tools.title: Log an activity
tools.description: Log an activity (call, meeting, task, note) against a member, opportunity or project, optionally with participants. Current RMS: POST /activities.

tools.name: current_rms_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: current_rms_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Current RMS tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Deputy
servers.description: See rosters, timesheets, leave and staff in Deputy, and create shifts, leave and memos.

tools.name: deputy_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the Deputy user the token belongs to — name, employee id, company and permissions. A cheap way to confirm DEPUTY_INSTALL and the token are right. Deputy: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: deputy_list_locations
