tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the install's locations (workplaces). Deputy calls a location a Company; its Id is what other tools take as location_id. Deputy: GET /api/v1/resource/Company.

tools.name: deputy_list_areas
tools.title: List areas
tools.description: List areas (Deputy OperationalUnits — the rosterable sections of a location, e.g. Kitchen, Front of house). Shifts and timesheets belong to an area. Optionally only one location's areas. Deputy: GET /api/v1/resource/OperationalUnit, or POST .../OperationalUnit/QUERY when filtered.

tools.name: deputy_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: Search employees by name, location or active status. Returns Id, DisplayName, Company (main location), Active, StartDate, Role and more. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Employee/QUERY.

tools.name: deputy_get_employee
tools.title: Get one employee
tools.description: Fetch one employee's details as a supervisor sees them — contact, locations, role and employment. Deputy: GET /api/v1/supervise/employee/{id}.

tools.name: deputy_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: Search the roster (scheduled shifts) by time window, employee, area, and published/open state. Each record has StartTime/EndTime (unix), StartTimeLocalized, Employee (0 or null when open), OperationalUnit (area), Published, Open, Cost and _DPMetaData with names. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Roster/QUERY.

tools.name: deputy_get_shift
tools.title: Get one shift
tools.description: Fetch one shift (Roster record) by id. Deputy: GET /api/v1/resource/Roster/{id}.

tools.name: deputy_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: Search timesheets (actual worked time) by time window, employee, area and approval state. Each record has StartTime/EndTime (unix; EndTime null while in progress), TotalTime (hours), Cost, TimeApproved, PayRuleApproved, IsInProgress, IsLeave, Roster (linked shift) and Exported. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Timesheet/QUERY.

tools.name: deputy_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get one timesheet
tools.description: Fetch one timesheet's full details, including breaks and approval state. Deputy: GET /api/v1/supervise/timesheet/{id}/details.

tools.name: deputy_list_leave
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: Search leave requests by employee, location, status and time window. Status: 0 awaiting approval, 1 approved, 2 declined, 3 cancelled, 4 date approved without pay, 5 pay approved without date. Start/End are unix; LeaveRule is the leave type id. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Leave/QUERY.

tools.name: deputy_get_employee_unavailability
tools.title: Get an employee's unavailability
tools.description: List the times one employee has marked themselves (or been marked) unavailable to work — check before rostering them. Deputy: GET /api/v1/supervise/unavail/{employeeId}.

tools.name: deputy_query_resource
tools.title: Query any Deputy resource
tools.description: Run a Resource API search on any business object (leave types, pay rules, public holidays, memos, events, shift templates, pay lines, availability, sales data, …). `search` is Deputy's clause map, e.g. {"s1":{"field":"Employee","data":12,"type":"eq"}}; operators: eq ne gt lt ge le is 'is not' in 'not in' starts contains. Use deputy_describe_resource to see an object's fields and joins. Read-only. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/{Object}/QUERY.

tools.name: deputy_describe_resource
tools.title: Describe a Deputy resource
tools.description: Return a Resource API object's field list, field types and joinable associations — what deputy_query_resource can filter, sort and join on. Deputy: GET /api/v1/resource/{Object}/INFO.

tools.name: deputy_create_shift
tools.title: Create a shift
tools.description: Add a shift to the roster, assigned to an employee or left open. Created as a DRAFT unless publish is true (publishing can notify the employee). Deputy returns an empty 200 on success — use deputy_list_shifts to find the new shift's id. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/roster.

tools.name: deputy_update_shift
tools.title: Update a shift
tools.description: Change an existing shift's times, area, employee, break or comment. Send the full intended shift (same fields as create) — Deputy's update is the add call with the shift id. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/roster with intRosterId.

tools.name: deputy_publish_shifts
tools.title: Publish shifts
tools.description: Publish draft shifts so employees see them, choosing how they are notified: 1 SMS and email, 2 SMS, 3 email, 4 no notification, 5 confirmation required. Only the listed shift ids are published. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/roster/publish.

tools.name: deputy_create_leave_request
tools.title: Create a leave request
tools.description: Add a leave request for an employee. By default it waits for manager approval (status 0); pass status 1 only when your system is the source of truth and the leave is already approved. Deputy tracks leave in hours, so give exact start and end times. Find leave type ids with deputy_query_resource on LeaveRules. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Leave.

tools.name: deputy_add_unavailability
tools.title: Add unavailability for an employee
tools.description: Record a time an employee cannot work (one-off, or recurring with an RFC 5545-style rule such as FREQ WEEKLY, INTERVAL 1, BYDAY MO). Auto-scheduling then skips them. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/unavail.

tools.name: deputy_create_memo
tools.title: Post a memo
tools.description: Post a memo to a location's news feed, optionally requiring staff to confirm they read it, or targeted to specific locations or users. Visible to staff immediately. Deputy: PUT /api/v1/supervise/memo.

tools.name: deputy_update_timesheet
tools.title: Update a timesheet
tools.description: Correct an existing timesheet's start/end time, area, meal break or supervisor comment. Times cannot be in the future. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/timesheet/update.

tools.name: deputy_approve_timesheet
tools.title: Approve a timesheet
tools.description: Approve one timesheet's times as a supervisor. Approved timesheets flow toward payroll export, so check it first with deputy_get_timesheet. Deputy: POST /api/v1/supervise/timesheet/approve.

tools.name: deputy_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: deputy_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Deputy tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Deskpro
servers.description: Search tickets, people, organizations and KB articles in Deskpro, and create tickets and replies.

tools.name: deskpro_get_me
tools.title: Get the authenticated agent
tools.description: Return who the API key acts as — the auth method, the bound person id and their profile. A cheap way to confirm the helpdesk URL and key are right. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/me.

tools.name: deskpro_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List tickets, filtered by status, assigned agent, requester, organization, department or labels, and sorted. Returns ticket objects (id, ref, subject, ticket_status, agent, person, department, urgency, labels, dates) plus pagination meta. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/tickets.

tools.name: deskpro_get_ticket
tools.title: Get one ticket
tools.description: Fetch a single ticket by id, with its subject, status, assignment, requester, labels, custom fields, SLA state and timing. A merged ticket redirects to the ticket it was merged into. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/tickets/{id}.

tools.name: deskpro_list_ticket_messages
tools.title: List a ticket's messages
tools.description: List the conversation on one ticket — every reply and agent note, with its author, date, is_agent_note flag and HTML body. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/tickets/{id}/messages.

tools.name: deskpro_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people (end users and agents), searchable by name and filterable by email, organization or agent flag. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/people.

tools.name: deskpro_get_person
tools.title: Get one person
tools.description: Fetch a single person by id — name, emails, phone numbers, organization, labels, custom fields and ticket count. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/people/{id}.

tools.name: deskpro_list_person_tickets
tools.title: List a person's tickets
tools.description: List the tickets raised by one person — their support history. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/people/{id}/tickets.

tools.name: deskpro_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List customer organizations, filterable by name or labels. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/organizations.

tools.name: deskpro_get_organization
tools.title: Get one organization
tools.description: Fetch a single organization by id — name, summary, email domains, labels, custom fields and ticket count. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/organizations/{id}.

tools.name: deskpro_list_organization_tickets
tools.title: List an organization's tickets
tools.description: List the tickets belonging to one organization. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/organizations/{id}/tickets.

tools.name: deskpro_list_articles
tools.title: List knowledgebase articles
tools.description: List knowledgebase articles, filterable by category, status and author. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/articles.

tools.name: deskpro_get_article
tools.title: Get one article
tools.description: Fetch a single knowledgebase article by id — title, content, status, categories and labels. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/articles/{id}.

tools.name: deskpro_list_departments
tools.title: List ticket departments
tools.description: List the ticket departments (id, title, parent, whether tickets/chat are enabled) — needed to route a new ticket. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/ticket_departments.

tools.name: deskpro_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List the helpdesk's agents (id, name, email, online state) — needed to assign a ticket. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/agents.

tools.name: deskpro_list_ticket_statuses
tools.title: List ticket statuses
tools.description: List the ticket statuses and custom sub-statuses (status_type, status_code, title) configured on the helpdesk. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/ticket_statuses.

tools.name: deskpro_search
tools.title: Search the helpdesk
tools.description: Quick search across tickets, people, organizations, articles, news, downloads, community topics and chats; results are grouped by type. Deskpro: GET /api/v2/search.

tools.name: deskpro_create_ticket
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Open a new ticket for a requester (by person id, or by email — Deskpro creates the person if the email is new) with a first message. Depending on the helpdesk's triggers this may email the requester. Returns the created ticket. Deskpro: POST /api/v2/tickets.

tools.name: deskpro_update_ticket
tools.title: Update a ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's subject, status, assignment, department, organization, urgency, hold state or labels. Only the fields you pass are sent. Reversible by updating again. Cannot set the hidden (deleted/spam) status. Deskpro: PUT /api/v2/tickets/{id}.

tools.name: deskpro_add_ticket_message
tools.title: Reply to a ticket or add a note
tools.description: Add a message to a ticket as the key's agent. With is_note=true it is an internal agent note (not shown to the requester); with is_note=false it is a REPLY that the helpdesk emails to the requester — that cannot be unsent. Deskpro: POST /api/v2/tickets/{id}/messages.

tools.name: deskpro_create_organization
tools.title: Create an organization
tools.description: Create a customer organization. Email domains auto-associate people with matching addresses. Deskpro: POST /api/v2/organizations.

tools.name: deskpro_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: deskpro_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Deskpro tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Elvanto
servers.description: Look up people, groups, service rosters, songs, follow-up flows and giving in Elvanto.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people in the church database, optionally filtered by category and by suspended / contact / archived status. Paginated (the response carries page, per_page, total). Elvanto: people/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_search_people
tools.title: Search people
tools.description: Find people matching field values, e.g. {"email":"john@example.com"} or {"lastname":"Smith","volunteer":"yes"}. Searchable keys: firstname, preferred_name, lastname, email, phone, mobile, category_id, archived, contact, deceased, volunteer, gender, birthday, anniversary, marital_status, school_grade, security_code, receipt_name, giving_number, groups, date_added / date_modified / last_login (UTC, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss; matched as on-or-after), and custom_<field id>. Use only one of archived / contact / deceased at a time. Elvanto: people/search.

tools.name: elvanto_get_person
tools.title: Get one person
tools.description: Fetch one person by id, optionally with extra fields (birthday, addresses, departments, locations, family, custom fields...). Elvanto: people/getInfo.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_categories
tools.title: List people categories
tools.description: List the people categories (e.g. New People, Church Members, Inactive) with their ids. Elvanto: people/categories/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom person fields
tools.description: List the church's custom person fields (id, name, type and allowed values). Use the id as custom_<id> in fields / search. Elvanto: people/customFields/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List small groups / ministries with meeting day, time, place and frequency; add fields=["people"] to include members and leaders. Elvanto: groups/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_get_group
tools.title: Get one group
tools.description: Fetch one group by id, optionally with its members (fields=["people"]). Elvanto: groups/getInfo.

tools.name: elvanto_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List services (upcoming by default). Add fields such as volunteers (the roster), plans (order of service) and songs to answer 'who is serving Sunday?' or 'what are we singing?'. Elvanto: services/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_get_service
tools.title: Get one service
tools.description: Fetch one service by id with optional detail: service/rehearsal times, plan (order of service), volunteers roster, songs, files, notes. Elvanto: services/getInfo.

tools.name: elvanto_list_songs
tools.title: List songs
tools.description: List or search the song library by title, artist or lyrics (with CCLI number, categories and locations). Elvanto: songs/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_song_arrangements
tools.title: List a song's arrangements
tools.description: List the arrangements of one song — sequence, BPM, keys, lyrics and chord chart (optionally transposed). Elvanto: songs/arrangements/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List the church's calendars with their ids. Elvanto: calendar/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_calendar_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List calendar events between two dates, optionally for specific calendars (use "services" as a calendar to include services). Elvanto: calendar/events/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_flows
tools.title: List people flows
tools.description: List people flows — the church's follow-up pipelines (e.g. First Time Guest Follow Up) — with their steps and admins. Elvanto: peopleFlows/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_flow_steps
tools.title: List a people flow's steps
tools.description: List the steps of one people flow with descriptions, instructions, due rules and admins. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_flow_step_people
tools.title: List people in a flow step
tools.description: List the people currently in one people-flow step, with status, due date and assigned admin — e.g. who still needs a follow-up call. Not paginated. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/people.

tools.name: elvanto_list_financial_categories
tools.title: List financial categories
tools.description: List giving / chart-of-accounts categories (funds) with ids; status 1 = active, 0 = archived. Elvanto: financial/categories/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_transactions
tools.title: List giving transactions
tools.description: List giving transactions between two dates, optionally for one fund — donor, date, method, batch and per-fund amounts. Read-only: this server never writes financial records. Elvanto: financial/transactions/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_create_person
tools.title: Create a person
tools.description: Add a new person to the church database (e.g. a first-time guest). Returns the new person id and family id. Does not create a login. Elvanto: people/create.

tools.name: elvanto_update_person
tools.title: Update a person
tools.description: Edit an existing person's details — name, contact info, category, flags, family, or extra fields. Only the fields you pass change. Cannot touch username, password or login status. Elvanto: people/edit.

tools.name: elvanto_add_person_to_group
tools.title: Add a person to a group
tools.description: Add a person to a group, optionally as Leader or Assistant Leader. Undoable by removing them from the group in Elvanto. Elvanto: groups/addPerson.

tools.name: elvanto_add_person_to_flow_step
tools.title: Add a person to a people-flow step
tools.description: Put a person into a people-flow step (e.g. start a new guest's follow-up), optionally assigning a step admin. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/addPerson.

tools.name: elvanto_create_calendar_event
tools.title: Create a calendar event
tools.description: Create an event on a calendar, optionally repeating. Times are 24-hour GMT. Use status "draft" to stage it unpublished. Elvanto: calendar/events/create.

tools.name: elvanto_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: elvanto_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)

servers.name: Follow Up Boss
servers.description: Search Follow Up Boss leads, review calls and deals, and add notes, tasks and deal updates.

tools.name: fub_get_identity
tools.title: Get identity
tools.description: Who the credential belongs to: the account (id, domain, owner) and the authenticated user. A cheap way to confirm the API key works. FUB: GET /v1/identity.

tools.name: fub_search_people
tools.title: Search people (contacts/leads)
tools.description: Search contacts and leads. Criteria combine with AND. Name filters are partial matches. Newest first by default. People in the Trash stage are excluded unless includeTrash is true. Not every field is returned by default — pass `fields` (e.g. "allFields" or a comma list) for more. FUB: GET /v1/people.

tools.name: fub_get_person
tools.title: Get one person
tools.description: Fetch one contact by id. Pass fields="allFields" to include custom fields and everything else. FUB: GET /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: fub_check_duplicate_person
tools.title: Check whether a person exists
tools.description: Check if a contact with this email or phone already exists anywhere in the account (even ones this user cannot see) and who it is assigned to. Use before adding a lead. FUB: GET /v1/people/checkDuplicate.

tools.name: fub_list_events
tools.title: List lead events
tools.description: Lead activity: registrations, inquiries, viewed/saved properties, website visits, etc. Filter by person or type. Some events are only visible in the FUB app. FUB: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: fub_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: Logged phone calls with outcome, direction and duration. Filter by person or number. FUB: GET /v1/calls.

tools.name: fub_list_text_messages
tools.title: List text messages
tools.description: Text messages for a person or a phone number (message bodies may be hidden by FUB for privacy). FUB: GET /v1/textMessages.

tools.name: fub_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: Tasks (follow-ups, calls, showings…). Filter by person, assignee, type, completion, or due window (due="today"|"overdue"|"upcoming"). FUB: GET /v1/tasks.

tools.name: fub_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: Calendar appointments with invitees, type and outcome. Filter by person, user, or a start+end window (both required together). FUB: GET /v1/appointments.

tools.name: fub_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: Deals (transactions) with stage, price, people, agents and commission. Filter by pipeline, user, person or status. The response metadata includes totalByStageId. FUB: GET /v1/deals.

tools.name: fub_list_pipelines
tools.title: List deal pipelines
tools.description: Deal pipelines with their stages (the stage ids that fub_create_deal / fub_update_deal take). FUB: GET /v1/pipelines.

tools.name: fub_list_stages
tools.title: List contact stages
tools.description: Contact lifecycle stages (Lead, Nurture, Past Client, Trash…) with people counts — the names fub_search_people and fub_update_person take as "stage". FUB: GET /v1/stages.

tools.name: fub_list_users
tools.title: List users (agents)
tools.description: Users in the account (agents, brokers, lenders) — the ids to assign people, tasks and deals to. FUB: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: fub_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: The account's contact custom fields: label, API name (customXxx), type and dropdown choices. Use the name as a key in customFields. FUB: GET /v1/customFields.

tools.name: fub_send_lead_event
tools.title: Send in a lead / lead event
tools.description: Add a new lead or record activity on an existing one — FUB's documented way to create leads. FUB de-duplicates by email/phone (or use person.id to target a contact), routes the lead per Lead Flow, notifies the agent and runs action plans for Registration / Inquiry types. A 204 means the lead flow for this source is archived and the event was ignored. FUB: POST /v1/events.

tools.name: fub_update_person
tools.title: Update a person
tools.description: Update a contact's fields. CAUTION: `tags` REPLACES all tags unless mergeTags is true; `phones` and `emails` REPLACE the full list (send existing ones too). Setting contacted=true pauses action plans. source/sourceUrl cannot be changed after creation. FUB: PUT /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: fub_add_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: Add a note to a contact's timeline. FUB: POST /v1/notes.

tools.name: fub_log_call
tools.title: Log a call
tools.description: Record a phone call made or received outside FUB, with its outcome. Does not place a call. FUB: POST /v1/calls.

tools.name: fub_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task on a contact, assigned to a user (assignedUserId or assignedTo is required). FUB: POST /v1/tasks.

tools.name: fub_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Update a task — mark it complete, rename, retype or reassign it. FUB: PUT /v1/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: fub_create_deal
tools.title: Create a deal
tools.description: Create a deal in a pipeline stage (stage ids from fub_list_pipelines). Include userIds — a deal with no users is invisible to agents. FUB: POST /v1/deals.

tools.name: fub_update_deal
tools.title: Update a deal
tools.description: Update a deal — move it to another stage, change price, dates, people or agents. peopleIds/userIds replace the full list. FUB: PUT /v1/deals/{id}.

tools.name: fub_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: fub_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Follow Up Boss tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Formstack
servers.description: Browse Formstack forms, submissions and webhooks, search responses, and create submissions.

tools.name: formstack_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms in the account, with submission counts, live URL and folder. Filter by name or folder and sort. Formstack: GET /forms.

tools.name: formstack_get_form
tools.title: Get one form
tools.description: Fetch a form's details — name, URL, submission counts, settings — optionally with its full field list. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}.

tools.name: formstack_list_form_fields
tools.title: List a form's fields
tools.description: List every field on a form — id, label, type, required flag, options and logic. Use this to learn field IDs before searching or creating submissions. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/fields.

tools.name: formstack_list_form_submissions
tools.title: List a form's submissions
tools.description: List a form's submissions, newest or oldest first, filtered by keyword, date range or specific field values. Set include_data to get the answers. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions.

tools.name: formstack_count_form_submissions
tools.title: Count a form's submissions
tools.description: Count a form's submissions, with a per-day breakdown over a lookback window of up to 7 days. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions/count.

tools.name: formstack_search_submissions
tools.title: Search submissions across all forms
tools.description: Full-text search for submissions across every form in the account, e.g. by a person's email or name. Formstack: GET /submissions.

tools.name: formstack_get_submission
tools.title: Get one submission
tools.description: Fetch a single submission with every field's label, type, display value and parsed value, plus payment, approval and workflow status. Formstack: GET /submissions/{submissionId}.

tools.name: formstack_list_partial_submissions
tools.title: List a form's partial submissions
tools.description: List entries respondents started but did not finish (Save & Resume / abandoned), with the same filters as submissions. Formstack: GET /form/{formId}/partialsubmission.

tools.name: formstack_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List the account's form folders and their subfolders. Formstack: GET /folders.

tools.name: formstack_get_folder
tools.title: Get one folder
tools.description: Fetch a folder with its parent, permissions and direct subfolders. Formstack: GET /folders/{folderId}.

tools.name: formstack_list_webhooks
tools.title: List a form's webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks that push a form's submissions to external URLs, with their payload settings. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/webhooks.

tools.name: formstack_list_notification_emails
tools.title: List a form's notification emails
tools.description: List the notification emails that alert your team when a form is submitted — recipients, subject, sender and logic. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/notifications.

tools.name: formstack_list_confirmation_emails
tools.title: List a form's confirmation emails
tools.description: List the confirmation emails sent to the person who submits a form — sender, subject, message and delay. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/confirmations.

tools.name: formstack_list_submit_actions
tools.title: List a form's submit actions
tools.description: List what happens after a form is submitted — default processing, a custom message, or a redirect URL — with conditional logic. Formstack: GET /forms/{formId}/submitactions.

tools.name: formstack_create_submission
tools.title: Create a submission
tools.description: Submit an entry to a form on someone's behalf. This is a real submission: it counts toward the form and can fire its notification emails, webhooks and integrations. Formstack: POST /forms/{formId}/submissions.

tools.name: formstack_update_submission
tools.title: Update a submission
tools.description: Change field values on an existing submission, or mark it read/unread. Only the fields you pass are changed. Formstack: PUT /submissions/{submissionId}.

tools.name: formstack_create_prefill_url
tools.title: Create a prefilled form link
tools.description: Generate a link to a live form with some fields already filled in — e.g. to send a customer a form with their name and account number pre-entered. Formstack stores the prefill and returns prefilledUrl. Formstack: POST /forms/{formId}/prefill.

tools.name: formstack_update_form
tools.title: Update a form's settings
tools.description: Rename a form, move it to a folder, change its submit-button text, timezone or language, or activate/deactivate it (with a message shown while inactive). Reversible. Formstack: PUT /forms/{formId}.

tools.name: formstack_create_folder
tools.title: Create a folder
tools.description: Create a folder for organising forms, at the root or inside a parent folder. Formstack: POST /folders.

tools.name: formstack_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a webhook
tools.description: Add a webhook that POSTs each new submission of a form to your URL. Formstack: POST /forms/{formId}/webhooks.

tools.name: formstack_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: formstack_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Formstack tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: TeamUp
servers.description: Check classes, attendance, customers, memberships and invoices in TeamUp and register customers.

tools.name: goteamup_get_authenticated_application
tools.title: Get the authenticated application
tools.description: Show the API application this token belongs to and the businesses (providers) it can reach, with their numeric ids — a cheap way to confirm the token works and to find the value for GOTEAMUP_PROVIDER_ID. TeamUp: GET /auth/application.

tools.name: goteamup_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Search and list the business's customers (members and leads). Filter by free text (email and name), CRM status, active memberships, age or family. Deferred fields such as field_values, credit_balance or sms_account can be added with expand. TeamUp: GET /customers.

tools.name: goteamup_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer by id: name, email, family role, lead flag, CRM status, created date. Use expand for deferred fields, e.g. field_values,credit_balance,staff_assignments. TeamUp: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: goteamup_list_events
tools.title: List events (classes and appointments)
tools.description: List scheduled sessions — classes and appointments — with start/end time, status, capacity, attending and waitlist counts, instructors, venue and offering type. Filter by time window, instructor, venue, offering type, status or occupancy. TeamUp: GET /events.

tools.name: goteamup_get_event
tools.title: Get one event
tools.description: Fetch one class or appointment by id, including capacity, attending/waiting counts, registration open/close and late-cancel deadlines. TeamUp: GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: goteamup_list_attendances
tools.title: List attendances (bookings)
tools.description: List bookings: who is registered for, attended, no-showed or late-cancelled which event, and with which customer membership. Filter by customer, event, venue, offering type, status or event start window. Use expand=customer,event for names. TeamUp: GET /attendances.

tools.name: goteamup_list_customer_memberships
tools.title: List customer memberships
tools.description: List memberships held by customers — status (active, hold, complete, cancelled), start/expiration/renewal dates, billed price, active hold. Filter by customer, membership plan, type, status, dates or holds. TeamUp: GET /customer_memberships.

tools.name: goteamup_get_customer_membership
tools.title: Get one customer membership
tools.description: Fetch one customer membership by id. Use expand=usage_summary,next_billing_date,shared_with for usage, next bill and sharing. TeamUp: GET /customer_memberships/{id}.

tools.name: goteamup_list_memberships
tools.title: List memberships (plans)
tools.description: List the membership products the business sells — packs, recurring and prepaid plans — with price, duration, allotment, active member count and visibility. TeamUp: GET /memberships.

tools.name: goteamup_list_offering_types
tools.title: List offering types (class types)
tools.description: List offering types — the kinds of classes, appointments and courses the business runs — with schedule type, drop-in price, age limits, visibility and status. TeamUp: GET /offering_types.

tools.name: goteamup_list_instructors
tools.title: List instructors
tools.description: List the business's instructors (coaches, trainers) with name, bio and linked staff id. TeamUp: GET /instructors.

tools.name: goteamup_list_venues
tools.title: List venues
tools.description: List the business's venues (physical locations and online venues) with address, timezone and rooms. TeamUp: GET /venues.

tools.name: goteamup_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with status (open, paid, failed, voided, upcoming, …), due date, amount due, payer and receipt URL. Filter by status or a customer membership. TeamUp: GET /invoices.

tools.name: goteamup_get_invoice
tools.title: Get one invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice by id. Use expand=line_items,charges,discounts,taxes,applied_credits for the breakdown. TeamUp: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: goteamup_list_crm_interactions
tools.title: List CRM interactions
tools.description: List logged CRM interactions (calls, emails, meetings, contacted) with notes and who logged them, optionally for one customer. Requires a super_admin-level token. TeamUp: GET /crm/interactions.

tools.name: goteamup_create_customer
tools.title: Create (invite) a customer
tools.description: Add a new customer to the business as staff. By default TeamUp emails them an invitation to claim the profile; set send_invitation_email=false to add them silently. TeamUp: POST /customers.

tools.name: goteamup_register_customer_for_event
tools.title: Book a customer into an event
tools.description: Register a customer for a class or appointment, optionally using a specific customer membership, or comped (free). Returns the attendance id. Undo with goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/register.

tools.name: goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event
tools.title: Remove a customer from an event
tools.description: Cancel a customer's booking for a class or appointment. is_late_cancel=true records it as a LATE cancel, which can trigger the business's penalty rules — leave it unset unless asked. The response says whether it counted as late. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/unregister.

tools.name: goteamup_confirm_attendance
tools.title: Check a customer in
tools.description: Confirm that a customer attended an event (check them in). Returns the updated attendance. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/confirm_attendance.

tools.name: goteamup_log_crm_interaction
tools.title: Log a CRM interaction
tools.description: Record a call, email, meeting or contact with a customer or lead, with an optional note and call outcome. Requires a super_admin-level token. TeamUp: POST /crm/interactions.

tools.name: goteamup_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: goteamup_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED TeamUp tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: HappyFox
servers.description: Triage HappyFox tickets, contacts and KB articles, run reports, and reply or add private notes.

tools.name: happyfox_list_tickets
tools.title: List or search tickets
tools.description: List tickets, newest activity first, with optional filters and HappyFox's search syntax. Paginated (page_info + data). Search `q` examples: `status:"New","In Progress"`, `priority:"High"`, `assignee:none`, `tag:"billing"`, `contact:"jane@example.com"`, `unresponded:true`, `breached:true`, `duedate:overdue`, `created-after:"2026/01/31"`, `last-modified-on-or-after:"2026/09/01"`, `"Custom Field":"value"`. Separate several filters with a space. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/tickets/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_ticket
tools.title: Get one ticket
tools.description: Fetch a ticket with its full conversation: status, priority, category, contact, assignee, custom fields, SLA breaches and every update (messages, private notes, property changes, attachment links that expire in 5 minutes). HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers), paginated, or search them. Search `q` fields: name, email, phone (digits only, no +), updated_since, created_since — e.g. `name:adam email:adam@example.com` (space-separated, all must match). HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/users/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_contact
tools.title: Get one contact
tools.description: Fetch a contact by id or by email address — phones, contact groups, ticket counts and custom fields. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/user/<id or email>/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_contact_groups
tools.title: List contact groups
tools.description: List contact groups (typically customer companies) with their tagged email domains. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/contact_groups/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_contact_group
tools.title: Get one contact group
tools.description: Fetch a contact group and its member contacts. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/contact_group/<id>/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List ticket categories (queues) with their ids — needed to create a ticket or filter tickets. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/categories/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_staff
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List agents (staff) with their ids, roles, categories and active flag — the `staff` id every reply/note needs, and assignee ids. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/staff/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_statuses
tools.title: List statuses
tools.description: List ticket statuses with ids and behaviour (pending / completed) — ids used to change a ticket's status. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/statuses/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_priorities
tools.title: List priorities
tools.description: List ticket priorities with ids — ids used to set a ticket's priority. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/priorities/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields
tools.title: List ticket custom fields
tools.description: List ticket custom fields: id, type, choices (with choice ids), required flags and categories. Use the ids as t-cf-<id>. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/ticket_custom_fields/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_contact_custom_fields
tools.title: List contact custom fields
tools.description: List contact custom fields: id, type, choices and required flag. Use the ids as c-cf-<id>. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/user_custom_fields/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the saved reports (id, name, description) from the Reports module. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/reports/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_report_summary
tools.title: Get a report summary
tools.description: Summary counts for a saved report: ticket, completed, assigned, pending and unassigned counts. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/report/<id>/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_report_tabular_data
tools.title: Get a report's ticket rows
tools.description: The tabular view of a saved report — one row per ticket (display_id, subject, status, assignee, due date), paginated. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/report/<id>/tabulardata/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_kb_articles
tools.title: Export knowledge-base articles
tools.description: Export the knowledge base: external (customer-facing) articles by default, or internal (agent-only) articles. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/kb/articles/ or /kb/internal-articles/.

tools.name: happyfox_create_ticket
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Open a new ticket on behalf of a contact (created if the email is new). Needs a category id (a public category), a subject and a message in `text` or `html`. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/tickets/.

tools.name: happyfox_add_staff_reply
tools.title: Reply to a ticket as an agent
tools.description: Add an agent reply to a ticket and/or change its status, priority, assignee, due date or tags. The contact is emailed ONLY if update_customer is true (HappyFox default: false). With no message it just updates properties. Moving to a completed status may require the category's compulsory custom fields. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/staff_update/.

tools.name: happyfox_add_private_note
tools.title: Add a private note to a ticket
tools.description: Add an internal note (never sent to the contact), optionally alerting agents and changing status, priority, assignee, due date or tags. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/staff_pvtnote/.

tools.name: happyfox_update_ticket_tags
tools.title: Add or remove ticket tags
tools.description: Add and/or remove tags on a ticket without touching anything else. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/update_tags/.

tools.name: happyfox_update_ticket_custom_fields
tools.title: Edit a ticket's custom fields
tools.description: Set ticket custom-field values (t-cf-<id>, ids from happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields). HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/update_custom_fields/.

tools.name: happyfox_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact. HappyFox treats this as create-or-edit keyed on email: if the email already exists that contact is updated, and any contact custom field NOT passed is reset — use happyfox_update_contact to edit an existing contact. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/users/.

tools.name: happyfox_update_contact
tools.title: Edit a contact
tools.description: Edit an existing contact's name, email or contact custom fields (c-cf-<id>). Phone numbers are edited via happyfox_create_contact with the phone id. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/user/<id>/.

tools.name: happyfox_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: happyfox_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED HappyFox tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Hostfully
servers.description: Check properties, calendars, leads, quotes, guests and messages in Hostfully, and send replies.

tools.name: hostfully_list_agencies
tools.title: List agencies
tools.description: List the agencies this API key can access, with their UIDs, currency and default check-in/out times. Start here to find the agency_uid other tools need. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/agencies.

tools.name: hostfully_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List an agency's properties (rentals) with name, address, type, bedrooms, active flag and pricing/availability settings. Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/properties.

tools.name: hostfully_get_property
tools.title: Get one property
tools.description: Fetch one property's full details — address, time zone, rooms, pricing and availability settings, channel data, booking notes and cancellation policy. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/properties/{propertyUid}.

tools.name: hostfully_get_property_calendar
tools.title: Get a property's calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day availability and pricing for one property over a date range — the direct answer to 'is it free, and at what price?'. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/property-calendar/{propertyUid}.

tools.name: hostfully_get_pricing_periods
tools.title: Get pricing periods
tools.description: The nightly price, minimum stay and check-in/check-out availability set for each date of one property over a range. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/pricing-periods.

tools.name: hostfully_search_leads
tools.title: Search leads and bookings
tools.description: Search leads — Hostfully's word for bookings, inquiries, booking requests and calendar blocks — by agency, property or UIDs, and by check-in/check-out date. Returns status, type, channel, dates and guest info. Give at least one of agency_uid (or the default), property_uid, or lead_uids. Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/leads.

tools.name: hostfully_get_lead
tools.title: Get one lead or booking
tools.description: Fetch one lead (booking, inquiry, booking request or block) by UID — status, channel, dates, guest information, notes and assignee. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/leads/{leadUid}.

tools.name: hostfully_calculate_quote
tools.title: Calculate a stay quote
tools.description: Price a prospective stay at one property: rent, fees, taxes, security deposit and total for the given dates and party. Computes only — creates nothing. Hostfully: POST /api/v3.3/quotes.

tools.name: hostfully_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders — the money side of a booking: rent, fees, services, adjustments, taxes, channel commission and total. Filter by lead, property, guest or update time (at least one is required). Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/orders.

tools.name: hostfully_list_threads
tools.title: List message threads
tools.description: List guest-messaging threads for an agency or one lead, with participants and read status. Give lead_uid, or agency_uid (or the default). Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/threads.

tools.name: hostfully_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: Read guest messages (Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com, email, SMS, WhatsApp, in-app) for a lead, a thread or a whole agency, with sender type, status and content. Give lead_uid, thread_uid, or agency_uid (or the default). Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/messages.

tools.name: hostfully_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List the agency's guest records — names, email, phone, address and profile notes. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/guests/{agencyUid}.

tools.name: hostfully_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List operational jobs (cleanings, greetings, maintenance and other services) scheduled in a date window, optionally for given properties and statuses, sorted by start date. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/jobs.

tools.name: hostfully_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services an agency offers or schedules (cleaning, transportation, greeting, cooking, tours ...), with provider, price and duration. A service UID is what hostfully_create_job needs. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/services.

tools.name: hostfully_list_reviews
tools.title: List guest reviews
tools.description: List guest reviews for a property or a lead — rating, title, content, source, private feedback and the host response. Cursor-paginated. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/reviews.

tools.name: hostfully_list_owners
tools.title: List property owners
tools.description: List the agency's property owners — contact details, business name, commission rate and permissions — optionally filtered by a search string. Hostfully: GET /api/v3.3/owners.

tools.name: hostfully_create_lead
tools.title: Create a calendar block or inquiry
tools.description: Create a lead at one property: status BLOCKED puts an owner/maintenance block on the calendar; status NEW records a guest inquiry (which does not confirm a booking or take payment). Blocks can later be removed in Hostfully; inquiries go through the normal pipeline. Dates are local to the property. Hostfully: POST /api/v3.3/leads.

tools.name: hostfully_update_lead
tools.title: Update a lead's notes or guest details
tools.description: Partially update a lead's notes, extra notes and guest details (name, contact, address, arrival/departure times). Does NOT change dates, party size, property or status. Hostfully may ignore personal-data fields the key is not allowed to edit. Hostfully: PATCH /api/v3.3/leads/{leadUid}.

tools.name: hostfully_send_message
tools.title: Send a message to a guest
tools.description: Send a message to the guest of a lead, by EMAIL or as a DIRECT_MESSAGE on the booking channel (Airbnb, VRBO or Booking.com leads only). This reaches a real guest and cannot be unsent — confirm the text first. Hostfully: POST /api/v3.3/messages.

tools.name: hostfully_create_job
tools.title: Schedule a job
tools.description: Schedule a job (e.g. a cleaning or a guest greeting) for a service at a property, optionally tied to a lead. Times are property-local. hostfully_list_services gives the service UID. Hostfully: POST /api/v3.3/jobs.

tools.name: hostfully_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: hostfully_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Hostfully tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Humanitix
servers.description: Read Humanitix events, orders, tickets and live check-in counts, and check tickets in or out.

tools.name: humanitix_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List your events, newest first, with dates, ticket types, pricing and capacity. Filter to upcoming events or events changed since a date. Paged (total/page/pageSize in the response). Humanitix: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: humanitix_get_event
tools.title: Get one event
tools.description: Fetch one event: name, description, URL, dates (each date's _id is the event_date_id other tools take), ticket types, packaged tickets, pricing, location, capacity and publish state. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}.

tools.name: humanitix_get_check_in_count
tools.title: Get check-in count
tools.description: How many attendees have checked in for one date of an event, in total and per ticket type (ticket types with sales only, most check-ins first). BETA endpoint. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/check-in-count.

tools.name: humanitix_list_orders
tools.title: List an event's orders
tools.description: List the orders for an event (optionally one date of it): buyer name/email, financial status, totals, discounts, payment type and sales channel. Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/orders.

tools.name: humanitix_get_order
tools.title: Get one order
tools.description: Fetch one order of an event, with its totals breakdown, answers to checkout questions and buyer details. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: humanitix_list_tickets
tools.title: List an event's tickets
tools.description: List the tickets (attendees) for an event, optionally one date of it and complete or cancelled only: attendee name, ticket type, price, check-in state and seating. Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets.

tools.name: humanitix_get_ticket
tools.title: Get one ticket
tools.description: Fetch one ticket of an event, including its check-in history and any swap history. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: humanitix_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags you use to group events (events carry them in tagIds). Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/tags.

tools.name: humanitix_get_tag
tools.title: Get one tag
tools.description: Fetch one tag by id. Humanitix: GET /v1/tags/{tagId}.

tools.name: humanitix_list_global_events
tools.title: List platform-wide events
tools.description: List public events from across the whole Humanitix platform, filterable by type, category and subcategory. Requires a special permission Humanitix activates on your account (403 otherwise). Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/global/events.

tools.name: humanitix_list_global_event_dates
tools.title: List platform-wide event dates
tools.description: List individual event dates from across the platform — one row per date — with the public on-sale status of every ticket type. Requires a special permission Humanitix activates on your account (403 otherwise). Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/global/event-dates.

tools.name: humanitix_check_in_ticket
tools.title: Check in a ticket
tools.description: Mark a ticket as checked in at the door. Returns any scanning messages configured for that ticket. Undo with humanitix_check_out_ticket. Humanitix: POST /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/check-in.

tools.name: humanitix_check_out_ticket
tools.title: Check out a ticket
tools.description: Mark a checked-in ticket as checked out (e.g. to undo a mistaken check-in or track re-entry). Humanitix: POST /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/check-out.

tools.name: humanitix_create_event
tools.title: Create an event
tools.description: Create a base event (name, description, timezone, one or more date ranges, location, keywords, classification). Ticket types are then set up in the Humanitix console. Requires a special permission Humanitix activates on your account (403 otherwise). Humanitix: POST /v1/events.

tools.name: humanitix_update_event
tools.title: Update an event
tools.description: Update an event's name, description, timezone, location, keywords or classification, and add or reschedule dates (date operations CREATE and UPDATE; deleting dates is not exposed). Only fields you pass are sent. Requires a special permission Humanitix activates on your account (403 otherwise). Humanitix: PATCH /v1/events/{eventId}.

tools.name: humanitix_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: humanitix_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Humanitix tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: IntakeQ
servers.description: Search clients, appointments, intakes, notes and invoices in IntakeQ, and book or cancel visits.

tools.name: intakeq_list_clients
tools.title: Search clients
tools.description: Search the practice's clients (patients) by name, email or client number, by created/updated date range, by external id, or by a custom field. Without include_profile it returns Name, Email, Phone and ClientNumber; with include_profile=true it returns the full profile (address, insurance, tags, custom fields, linked clients). Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /clients.

tools.name: intakeq_get_client_diagnoses
tools.title: Get a client's diagnoses
tools.description: List the diagnoses recorded for one client: code, description, start/end date and the treatment note they came from. IntakeQ: GET /client/{clientId}/diagnoses.

tools.name: intakeq_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: Query appointments by client name/email, date range, status, practitioner or last-modified date. Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /appointments.

tools.name: intakeq_get_appointment
tools.title: Get one appointment
tools.description: Fetch one appointment: client, practitioner, service, location, start/end, status, price, invoice, telehealth link and cancellation details. IntakeQ: GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: intakeq_get_booking_settings
tools.title: Get booking settings
tools.description: List the scheduler's locations, services (with duration and price) and practitioners — the ids you need to create an appointment. IntakeQ: GET /appointments/settings.

tools.name: intakeq_list_intakes
tools.title: List intake forms
tools.description: Query submitted intake questionnaires (summaries: client, status, questionnaire, practitioner, dates). By default only completed forms; set all=true for every status (Sent, Partial, Completed, Offline). Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /intakes/summary.

tools.name: intakeq_get_intake
tools.title: Get a full intake form
tools.description: Fetch one intake questionnaire with every question and answer, its consent forms and linked appointment. IntakeQ: GET /intakes/{id}.

tools.name: intakeq_list_questionnaires
tools.title: List questionnaire templates
tools.description: List the intake questionnaire templates in the account (id, name, archived, anonymous) — the ids you need to send one. IntakeQ: GET /questionnaires.

tools.name: intakeq_list_practitioners
tools.title: List practitioners
tools.description: List the practitioners in the account (id, name, email, external id). IntakeQ: GET /practitioners.

tools.name: intakeq_list_notes
tools.title: List treatment notes
tools.description: Query treatment note summaries by client, lock status, date range or last-updated date. Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /notes/summary.

tools.name: intakeq_get_note
tools.title: Get a full treatment note
tools.description: Fetch one treatment note with every question and answer and its linked appointment. IntakeQ: GET /notes/{id}.

tools.name: intakeq_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Query invoices by client, issue date range, status, practitioner or last-updated range. Each invoice includes items, payments and amounts due/paid. Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /invoices.

tools.name: intakeq_get_invoice
tools.title: Get one invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice: line items, taxes, discounts, payments, totals and amount due. IntakeQ: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: intakeq_save_client
tools.title: Create or update a client
tools.description: Create a client, or update one. With ClientId the existing client is updated. WITHOUT ClientId IntakeQ still tries to match an existing client by first name + email (or first name + phone) and updates that one instead of creating a duplicate. For updates, fetch the full profile first (intakeq_list_clients with include_profile=true) and send it back with your changes, so no field is unintentionally cleared. Field names are IntakeQ's own. Dates are Unix timestamps in milliseconds. IntakeQ: POST /clients.

tools.name: intakeq_add_client_tag
tools.title: Tag a client
tools.description: Add a tag to a client. The tag is created if it does not exist; adding one the client already has is a no-op. IntakeQ: POST /clientTags.

tools.name: intakeq_create_appointment
tools.title: Create an appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment in the PracticeQ scheduler. Get PractitionerId, ServiceId and LocationId from intakeq_get_booking_settings. All fields are required by IntakeQ. Status must be Confirmed or WaitingConfirmation; SendClientEmailNotification may be true only when Status is Confirmed. IntakeQ: POST /appointments.

tools.name: intakeq_update_appointment
tools.title: Update or reschedule an appointment
tools.description: Change an appointment's time, service, location, status or reminder type. Id and UtcDateTime are required (send the current time to keep it); include only the other fields you are changing. The client and practitioner cannot be changed, and a Confirmed appointment cannot go back to WaitingConfirmation. IntakeQ: PUT /appointments.

tools.name: intakeq_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel an appointment
tools.description: Cancel an appointment, with an optional reason. This changes the client's booking and cannot be undone through the API — book a new appointment to replace it. IntakeQ: POST /appointments/cancellation.

tools.name: intakeq_send_questionnaire
tools.title: Send an intake questionnaire
tools.description: Send an intake questionnaire to a client by email or SMS. This MESSAGES THE CLIENT. Identify the client by ClientId, or by ClientName plus ClientEmail and/or ClientPhone (omit ClientEmail to force SMS). PractitionerId is optional. Returns the new intake. IntakeQ: POST /intakes/send.

tools.name: intakeq_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: intakeq_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED IntakeQ tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: JobNimbus
servers.description: Manage JobNimbus contacts, jobs, tasks, estimates and invoices from chat.

tools.name: jobnimbus_get_account_settings
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Fetch the account's configuration: contact and job workflows with their statuses, task types, activity (note) types, file types and lead sources. Use it to find the exact record_type_name / status_name / source_name values the create and update tools need. Pass field (e.g. groups) to get just one setting. JobNimbus: GET /account/settings.

tools.name: jobnimbus_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the account's JobNimbus users (team members) with name, email, id and whether they are active. The id is what owners, sales_rep and owner_ids take. JobNimbus: GET /account/users.

tools.name: jobnimbus_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, leads, adjusters, subcontractors…), newest first by default, optionally filtered with an ElasticSearch-style query. Returns {count, results}. JobNimbus: GET /contacts.

tools.name: jobnimbus_get_contact
tools.title: Get one contact
tools.description: Fetch a single contact by jnid: name, company, phones, email, address, workflow status, lead source, sales rep and custom fields. JobNimbus: GET /contacts/{jnid}.

tools.name: jobnimbus_list_jobs
tools.title: List or search jobs
tools.description: List jobs (projects), newest first by default, optionally filtered — e.g. by status {"must":[{"term":{"status_name":"Lead"}}]} or by the related contact via related_id. Returns {count, results}. JobNimbus: GET /jobs.

tools.name: jobnimbus_get_job
tools.title: Get one job
tools.description: Fetch a single job by jnid: name, number, workflow and status, address, sales rep, owners, related contacts and custom fields. JobNimbus: GET /jobs/{jnid}.

tools.name: jobnimbus_list_tasks
tools.title: List or search tasks
tools.description: List tasks and appointments, optionally for one contact or job (related_id) or filtered, e.g. open ones: {"must":[{"term":{"is_completed":false}}]}. Returns {count, results}. JobNimbus: GET /tasks.

tools.name: jobnimbus_get_task
tools.title: Get one task
tools.description: Fetch a single task or appointment by jnid: title, type, start/end, priority, completion, owners and related records. JobNimbus: GET /tasks/{jnid}.

tools.name: jobnimbus_list_activities
tools.title: List activity and notes
tools.description: List activity entries — notes plus system events such as status changes and record creation — optionally for one contact or job (related_id). Returns {count, activity}. JobNimbus: GET /activities.

tools.name: jobnimbus_list_files
tools.title: List file attachments
tools.description: List file attachments (photos, documents) with filename, content type, size, file type and the contact/job they belong to — optionally for one record (related_id). Metadata only; file bytes are not downloaded. Returns {count, files}. JobNimbus: GET /files.

tools.name: jobnimbus_list_estimates
tools.title: List estimates
tools.description: List estimates with number, status, line items, subtotal, tax, total, margin, e-sign state and related job/contact. Returns {count, results}; count is the account total. JobNimbus: GET /v2/estimates.

tools.name: jobnimbus_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with number, status, line items, total, total_paid, amount due, due date and related job/contact. Returns {count, results}; count is the account total. JobNimbus: GET /v2/invoices.

tools.name: jobnimbus_get_invoice
tools.title: Get one invoice
tools.description: Fetch a single invoice by jnid, including line items, payments applied, total, total_paid and due. JobNimbus: GET /v2/invoices/{jnid}.

tools.name: jobnimbus_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact. Give at least one of first_name, last_name, display_name or company. record_type_name (a contact workflow, e.g. Customer) and status_name (a status in that workflow, e.g. Lead) are required and must match the account settings (jobnimbus_get_account_settings). Workflow automations may fire. JobNimbus: POST /contacts.

tools.name: jobnimbus_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Edit fields on an existing contact — only the fields you pass change. Changing status_name moves it along its workflow (automations may fire). Cannot delete or archive. JobNimbus: PUT /contacts/{jnid}.

tools.name: jobnimbus_create_job
tools.title: Create a job
tools.description: Create a job (project). name, record_type_name (a job workflow, e.g. Residential) and status_name (a status in it, e.g. Lead) are required and must match the account settings. Link the homeowner with primary_contact_id. Workflow automations may fire. JobNimbus: POST /jobs.

tools.name: jobnimbus_update_job
tools.title: Update a job
tools.description: Edit fields on an existing job — e.g. move it to a new status_name, change the address, sales rep or dates. Only the fields you pass change; if JobNimbus rejects a status change, pass record_type_name alongside status_name. Automations may fire. Cannot delete or archive. JobNimbus: PUT /jobs/{jnid}.

tools.name: jobnimbus_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task or appointment on a contact or job. title, date_start (unix seconds) and record_type_name (a task type from the account settings, e.g. Task or Appointment) are required; related_id links it to the contact/job. JobNimbus: POST /tasks.

tools.name: jobnimbus_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Edit an existing task — reschedule it, change the title or priority, reassign it, or mark it complete with is_completed=true (reopen with false). Only the fields you pass change. Cannot delete. JobNimbus: PUT /tasks/{jnid}.

tools.name: jobnimbus_create_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: Add a note (activity entry) to a contact or job's activity feed. record_type_name defaults to Note; use another activity type from the account settings if needed. JobNimbus: POST /activities.

tools.name: jobnimbus_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: jobnimbus_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED JobNimbus tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Kayako
servers.description: Search Kayako cases, replies, customers and help-center articles, and reply to or create cases.

tools.name: kayako_get_me
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Fetch the Kayako user these credentials belong to (name, role, teams, locale). A cheap way to confirm the subdomain and credentials work. Kayako: GET /api/v1/me.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_cases
tools.title: List cases
tools.description: List cases (conversations / tickets), newest-updated first. Filter by status type, tags, max priority level, or a requester identity (email, Twitter screen name, Facebook username, phone); or fetch specific ids. Nested resources are references unless `include` expands them. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases.json.

tools.name: kayako_get_case
tools.title: Get a case
tools.description: Fetch one case (conversation) by id: subject, requester, assignee, status, priority, type, SLA metrics, custom fields, last post preview. Use include (e.g. 'user,case_status,case_priority,team') to expand references and fields='+tags' for tags. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{id}.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_case_posts
tools.title: List a case's posts
tools.description: Read a case's timeline: customer messages, agent replies and internal notes (newest first). By default activities are excluded; filters='NOTES' for internal notes only, 'MESSAGES' for messages, 'ALL' to include activities. Paginate with before_id / after_id (one at a time). Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{id}/posts.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_channels
tools.title: List reply channels
tools.description: List the channels (MAIL mailbox, TWITTER, FACEBOOK, NOTE) usable for a reply on an existing case (pass case_id) or for a new case (omit case_id; optionally pass the requester's user_id). A channel's account.id is the channel_id to pass to kayako_reply_to_case / kayako_create_case. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{id}/reply/channels.json or GET /api/v1/cases/channels.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_case_options
tools.title: List case statuses, priorities or types
tools.description: List the instance's case statuses (id, label, type), priorities (id, label, level) or types (id, label, type) — the ids needed for status_id / priority_id / type_id when creating, updating or replying to a case. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{statuses|priorities|types}.json.

tools.name: kayako_search
tools.title: Search cases, users and organizations
tools.description: Unified search across conversations (cases), users and organizations. Returns id, title, snippet, relevance and resource type; pass fields='*' to get each full resource inline. Max 30 results. Kayako: GET /api/v1/search.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (customers, collaborators, agents, admins), newest first, optionally by role type or specific ids. To find a user by email or name use kayako_search. Kayako: GET /api/v1/users.json.

tools.name: kayako_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Fetch one user by id: name, role, organization, teams, identities (emails, phones, social), custom fields. include='identity_email,organization' expands references. Kayako: GET /api/v1/users/{id}.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List customer organizations (name, domains, phone, custom fields), oldest first. To find one by name use kayako_search with resources=['ORGANIZATIONS']. Kayako: GET /api/v1/organizations.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_organization_cases
tools.title: List an organization's cases
tools.description: List the cases (conversations) raised by members of one organization, newest-updated first. Kayako: GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}/cases.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List agent teams (id, title, member count) — the ids for assigned_team_id. Kayako: GET /api/v1/teams.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List user roles (id, title, type OWNER/ADMIN/AGENT/COLLABORATOR/CUSTOMER) — the role_id needed by kayako_create_user. Kayako: GET /api/v1/roles.json.

tools.name: kayako_list_articles
tools.title: List help-center articles
tools.description: List knowledge-base articles, optionally by section, tags, or PUBLISHED / PINNED. Titles and contents are locale references unless include='locale_field'. Kayako: GET /api/v1/articles.json.

tools.name: kayako_get_article
tools.title: Get a help-center article
tools.description: Fetch one knowledge-base article with its localized titles and contents expanded (include defaults to 'locale_field'), status, section, tags, votes and help-center URL. Kayako: GET /api/v1/articles/{id}.json.

tools.name: kayako_search_help_center
tools.title: Search the help center
tools.description: Search the help center's articles and/or public conversations. Returns references (e.g. {id, resource_type: 'article'}); read an article with kayako_get_article. Kayako: GET /api/v1/helpcenter/search.json.

tools.name: kayako_create_case
tools.title: Create a case
tools.description: WRITE: open a new case (conversation) for a requester. channel MAIL sends the first message to the customer by email from the mailbox given as channel_id; channel NOTE creates it with an internal note and emails nobody. Get channel ids from kayako_list_channels and status/priority/type ids from kayako_list_case_options. Kayako: POST /api/v1/cases.json.

tools.name: kayako_update_case
tools.title: Update a case
tools.description: WRITE: change a case's subject, requester, assignee (team/agent), status, priority, type, brand, form, tags or custom fields. Sends nothing to the customer. `tags` sets the case's tag list (use kayako_add_case_tags to append). Trashing is deliberately not exposed. Kayako: PUT /api/v1/cases/{id}.json.

tools.name: kayako_reply_to_case
tools.title: Reply to a case or add an internal note
tools.description: WRITE: add a post to a case. channel NOTE adds an INTERNAL note visible only to agents (no channel_id needed). channel MAIL/TWITTER/FACEBOOK sends a PUBLIC reply to the customer — get channel_id from kayako_list_channels with case_id. Can also set status/priority/assignee in the same call. Kayako: POST /api/v1/cases/{id}/reply.json.

tools.name: kayako_add_case_tags
tools.title: Add tags to a case
tools.description: WRITE: add tags to a case, keeping its existing tags. Kayako: POST /api/v1/cases/{id}/tags.json.

tools.name: kayako_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: WRITE: create a user — typically a CUSTOMER to use as requester_id on a new case. role_id comes from kayako_list_roles. Collaborator/agent/admin roles also require email and team_ids. No password is set by this tool. Kayako: POST /api/v1/users.json.

tools.name: kayako_usage_status
tools.title: Usage status (free-tier meter)
tools.description: Report the caller's current free-tier usage this month: calls used, monthly limit, remaining, and whether the cap is reached. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

tools.name: kayako_upgrade
tools.title: Upgrade to Pro (unlimited)
tools.description: Subscribe to the Pro plan for UNLIMITED Kayako tool calls (the free tier caps monthly usage). Choose monthly ($9/month) or yearly ($90/year — 2 months free) billing. Returns a Stripe Checkout link to open in your browser; after payment your account upgrades automatically. Read-only; does not count against the meter.

servers.name: Kickserv
servers.description: Look up Kickserv customers, jobs, notes and time entries, and create jobs, tasks and charges.

tools.name: kickserv_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers, 30 per page. Every filter is an exact match on that field. Use `only` to keep the response small. Kickserv: GET /{account}/customers.xml.

tools.name: kickserv_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer by customer number, optionally with related contacts, jobs, tasks and notes. The result's `id` is what job/task create calls need as `customer_id`. Kickserv: GET /{account}/customers/{customer_number}.xml.

tools.name: kickserv_list_customer_jobs
tools.title: List a customer's jobs
tools.description: List the jobs for one customer, 30 per page. Kickserv: GET /{account}/customers/{customer_number}/jobs.xml.

tools.name: kickserv_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (work orders, estimates, invoices), 30 per page, filterable by schedule window, status, assigned employee, category (job type) or job status. Kickserv: GET /{account}/jobs.xml.

tools.name: kickserv_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Fetch one job by job number, optionally with its customer, assigned employees, job charges (line items), time entries and notes. Kickserv: GET /{account}/jobs/{job_number}.xml.

tools.name: kickserv_list_customer_notes
tools.title: List a customer's notes
tools.description: List the notes on one customer. Kickserv: GET /{account}/customers/{customer_number}/notes.xml.

tools.name: kickserv_list_job_notes
tools.title: List a job's notes
tools.description: List the notes on one job. Kickserv: GET /{account}/jobs/{job_number}/notes.xml.

tools.name: kickserv_list_job_time_entries
tools.title: List a job's time entries
tools.description: List the time entries (hours logged by technicians) on one job. Kickserv: GET /{account}/jobs/{job_number}/time_entries.xml.
